164. ## 4. State Machine Changes
165. 
166. ### 4.1 New Triggers in Code
167. 
168. | From | Trigger | To | Guard |
169. |---|---|---|---|
170. | `INITIAL_REVIEW_COMPLETED` | `evaluateThreshold` (auto) | `PENDING_REREVIEW` | `score > qualityThreshold` |
171. | `INITIAL_REVIEW_COMPLETED` | `closeWithoutRereview` (manual) | `CLOSED` | actor = HOSPITAL_MANAGER |
172. | `INITIAL_REVIEW_COMPLETED` | `sendToRereview` (manual) | `PENDING_REREVIEW` | actor = HOSPITAL_MANAGER |
173. | `PENDING_REREVIEW` | `assignRereviewer` | `PENDING_REREVIEW` | state guard only |
174. | `PENDING_REREVIEW` | `startRereview` | `REREVIEW_IN_PROGRESS` | actorId = rereviewerId |
175. | `PENDING_REREVIEW` | `cancel` | `CANCELLED` | (already exists) |
176. | `REREVIEW_IN_PROGRESS` | `submitRereview` | `CLOSED` | submission = SUBMITTED |
177. 
178. ### 4.2 State Machine Doc Updates
179. 
180. 1. **New trigger `sendToRereview`:** INITIAL_REVIEW_COMPLETED → PENDING_REREVIEW (manual, HOSPITAL_MANAGER)
181. 2. **Modified `closeWithoutRereview` guard:** Changed from `score <= qualityThreshold` to `HOSPITAL_MANAGER manual trigger` (auto threshold handled by evaluateThreshold in completeInitialReview)
182. 3. **Design principle §2.9:** Updated from "最終分數由複審醫師決定" to "最終分數為初審與複審分數之加權平均"

273. 
274. ```yaml
275. actor: HOSPITAL_MANAGER
276. input: caseId, rereviewerId, dueAt
277. steps:
278.   1. actor.requireRole(HOSPITAL_MANAGER)
279.   2. Load ReviewCase
280.   3. actor.requireHospitalScope(case.hospitalId)
281.   4. case.reassignRereviewer(rereviewerId, dueAt)

286. ### 6.5 StartRereviewUseCase
287. 
288. ```yaml
289. actor: REREVIEWER (assigned re-reviewer)
290. input: caseId
291. steps:
292.   1. Load ReviewCase
293.   2. Verify actor.userId == case.rereviewerAssignment.reviewerId
294.   3. case.startRereview(actor.userId)
295.   4. Load ScoreSheetSnapshot for the case
296.   5. Create REREVIEW draft submission via ReviewSubmission.createRereviewDraft()
297.   6. Save case + submission
298.   7. Publish RereviewStartedEvent
299. ```
300. 
301. ### 6.6 SaveRereviewDraftUseCase
302. 
303. ```yaml
304. actor: REREVIEWER (assigned re-reviewer)
305. input: caseId, answers[], comment
306. steps:
307.   1. Load ReviewCase
308.   2. Verify actor.userId == case.rereviewerAssignment.reviewerId
309.   3. Verify case.status == REREVIEW_IN_PROGRESS
310.   4. Load current REREVIEW draft submission
311.   5. Load ScoreSheetSnapshot
312.   6. Calculate scores via ScoreCalculationService
313.   7. submission.updateDraft(answers, calculatedScore, comment)
314.   8. Save submission
315. ```
316. 
317. ### 6.7 SubmitRereviewUseCase
318. 
319. ```yaml
320. actor: REREVIEWER (assigned re-reviewer)
321. input: caseId, submissionId
322. steps:
323.   1. Load ReviewCase
324.   2. Verify actor.userId == case.rereviewerAssignment.reviewerId
325.   3. Load ReviewSubmission (verify stage=REREVIEW, status=DRAFT)
326.   4. submission.submit()
327.   5. Load ProjectVersion → get initialReviewWeight, rereviewWeight
328.   6. case.completeRereview(submission.totalScore, initialWeight, rereviewWeight)
329.   7. Save case + submission
330.   8. Publish RereviewCompletedEvent, ReviewCaseClosedEvent
331. ```
332. 
333. ### 6.8 ReviseRereviewUseCase
334. 
335. ```yaml
336. actor: REREVIEWER (original re-reviewer)
337. input: caseId, submissionId, answers[], comment
338. steps:
339.   1. Load ReviewCase
340.   2. Verify case is not CANCELLED (CLOSED is allowed per D-021)
341.   3. Load current SUBMITTED REREVIEW submission
342.   4. Verify actor.userId == case.rereviewerAssignment.reviewerId
343.   5. Load ScoreSheetSnapshot
344.   6. Calculate scores via ScoreCalculationService
345.   7. previousSubmission.markSuperseded()
346.   8. Create new revision via createRereviewRevision()
347.   9. Load ProjectVersion → get weights
348.   10. case.updateFinalScoreOnRereviewRevision(newScore, initialWeight, rereviewWeight)
349.   11. Save case + old submission + new submission
350.   12. Publish RereviewSubmissionRevisedEvent
351. ```
352. 
353. **Note:** Unlike initial review revision, rereview revision IS allowed on CLOSED cases (D-021). This is because rereview submission auto-closes the case, making CLOSED the only state where rereview revision can occur. The revision does not change the case state — only finalScore is recalculated.
354. 
355. ### 6.9 GetRereviewRevisionHistoryUseCase
356. 
357. ```yaml
358. actor: multiple roles (per permission matrix)
359. input: caseId
360. steps:
361.   1. Load all REREVIEW stage submissions for caseId
362.   2. Return ordered by revisionNo
363.   3. Apply visibility rules per permission matrix
364. ```
365. 
366. ### 6.10 Modified: SubmitInitialReviewUseCase
367. 
368. ```yaml
369. changes:
370.   - After submission.submit(), load ProjectVersion to get qualityThreshold
371.   - Call case.completeInitialReview(submission.totalScore, qualityThreshold) instead of case.completeInitialReview(submission.totalScore)
372.   - Domain decides state transition based on threshold comparison
373. ```

package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission;

import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.DomainStateConflictException;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Aggregate root for a review submission.
 * B3a: shell with getters only.
 * B3b: full business methods — createDraft, updateDraft, submit.
 */
public class ReviewSubmission {

    private String submissionId;
    private String caseId;
    private ReviewStage stage;
    private String reviewerId;
    private SubmissionStatus status;
    private int revisionNo;
    private List<AnswerItem> answerSet;
    private BigDecimal totalScore;
    private String comment;
    private LocalDateTime submittedAt;
    private String basedOnScoreSheetVersionId;
    private String supersededBySubmissionId;
    private String attachmentRefsJson;
    private LocalDateTime createdAt;
    private LocalDateTime updatedAt;

    protected ReviewSubmission() {
        // for persistence / reconstitution
    }

    /**
     * Create an initial review draft submission.
     * Called by StartInitialReviewUseCase.
     */
    public static ReviewSubmission createInitialDraft(
            String submissionId, String caseId, String reviewerId,
            String scoreSheetVersionId) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(submissionId, "submissionId must not be null");
        Objects.requireNonNull(caseId, "caseId must not be null");
        Objects.requireNonNull(reviewerId, "reviewerId must not be null");
        Objects.requireNonNull(scoreSheetVersionId, "scoreSheetVersionId must not be null");

        ReviewSubmission sub = new ReviewSubmission();
        sub.submissionId = submissionId;
        sub.caseId = caseId;
        sub.stage = ReviewStage.INITIAL;
        sub.reviewerId = reviewerId;
        sub.status = SubmissionStatus.DRAFT;
        sub.revisionNo = 1;
        sub.answerSet = new ArrayList<>();
        sub.totalScore = BigDecimal.ZERO;
        sub.basedOnScoreSheetVersionId = scoreSheetVersionId;
        sub.createdAt = LocalDateTime.now();
        sub.updatedAt = sub.createdAt;
        return sub;
    }

    /**
     * Reconstitute from persistence. No business validation.
     */
    public static ReviewSubmission reconstitute(
            String submissionId, String caseId, ReviewStage stage,
            String reviewerId, SubmissionStatus status, int revisionNo,
            List<AnswerItem> answerSet, BigDecimal totalScore,
            String comment, LocalDateTime submittedAt,
            String basedOnScoreSheetVersionId,
            String supersededBySubmissionId,
            String attachmentRefsJson,
            LocalDateTime createdAt, LocalDateTime updatedAt) {
        ReviewSubmission sub = new ReviewSubmission();
        sub.submissionId = submissionId;
        sub.caseId = caseId;
        sub.stage = stage;
        sub.reviewerId = reviewerId;
        sub.status = status;
        sub.revisionNo = revisionNo;
        sub.answerSet = answerSet != null ? new ArrayList<>(answerSet) : new ArrayList<>();
        sub.totalScore = totalScore;
        sub.comment = comment;
        sub.submittedAt = submittedAt;
        sub.basedOnScoreSheetVersionId = basedOnScoreSheetVersionId;
        sub.supersededBySubmissionId = supersededBySubmissionId;
        sub.attachmentRefsJson = attachmentRefsJson;
        sub.createdAt = createdAt;
        sub.updatedAt = updatedAt;
        return sub;
    }

    /**
     * Update draft answers and score. Can be called multiple times while in DRAFT.
     */
    public void updateDraft(List<AnswerItem> scoredAnswers, BigDecimal totalScore, String comment) {
        requireDraft();
        Objects.requireNonNull(scoredAnswers, "scoredAnswers must not be null");
        Objects.requireNonNull(totalScore, "totalScore must not be null");
        this.answerSet = new ArrayList<>(scoredAnswers);
        this.totalScore = totalScore;
        this.comment = comment;
        this.updatedAt = LocalDateTime.now();
    }

    /**
     * Submit this draft. Transitions DRAFT → SUBMITTED. Irreversible.
     */
    public void submit() {
        requireDraft();
        this.status = SubmissionStatus.SUBMITTED;
        this.submittedAt = LocalDateTime.now();
        this.updatedAt = LocalDateTime.now();
    }

    /**
     * Create a revision from an existing SUBMITTED submission.
     * The new submission is directly SUBMITTED (no DRAFT phase for revisions).
     */
    public static ReviewSubmission createRevision(
            String newSubmissionId,
            ReviewSubmission oldSubmission,
            List<AnswerItem> scoredAnswers,
            BigDecimal totalScore,
            String comment) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(newSubmissionId, "newSubmissionId must not be null");
        Objects.requireNonNull(oldSubmission, "oldSubmission must not be null");
        Objects.requireNonNull(scoredAnswers, "scoredAnswers must not be null");
        Objects.requireNonNull(totalScore, "totalScore must not be null");

        if (oldSubmission.status != SubmissionStatus.SUBMITTED) {
            throw new DomainStateConflictException("SUBMISSION_NOT_SUBMITTED",
                    "Can only revise a SUBMITTED submission. Current: " + oldSubmission.status);
        }

        ReviewSubmission rev = new ReviewSubmission();
        rev.submissionId = newSubmissionId;
        rev.caseId = oldSubmission.caseId;
        rev.stage = oldSubmission.stage;
        rev.reviewerId = oldSubmission.reviewerId;
        rev.status = SubmissionStatus.SUBMITTED;
        rev.revisionNo = oldSubmission.revisionNo + 1;
        rev.answerSet = new ArrayList<>(scoredAnswers);
        rev.totalScore = totalScore;
        rev.comment = comment;
        rev.submittedAt = LocalDateTime.now();
        rev.basedOnScoreSheetVersionId = oldSubmission.basedOnScoreSheetVersionId;
        rev.createdAt = LocalDateTime.now();
        rev.updatedAt = rev.createdAt;
        return rev;
    }

    /**
     * Mark this submission as SUPERSEDED by a newer revision.
     * Only SUBMITTED submissions can be superseded.
     */
    public void markSuperseded(String newSubmissionId) {
        if (this.status != SubmissionStatus.SUBMITTED) {
            throw new DomainStateConflictException("SUBMISSION_NOT_SUBMITTED",
                    "Can only supersede a SUBMITTED submission. Current: " + this.status);
        }
        Objects.requireNonNull(newSubmissionId, "newSubmissionId must not be null");
        this.supersededBySubmissionId = newSubmissionId;
        this.status = SubmissionStatus.SUPERSEDED;
        this.updatedAt = LocalDateTime.now();
    }

    private void requireDraft() {
        if (this.status != SubmissionStatus.DRAFT) {
            throw new DomainStateConflictException("SUBMISSION_NOT_DRAFT",
                    "Submission must be in DRAFT status. Current: " + this.status);
        }
    }

    // --- Getters ---

    public String getSubmissionId() { return submissionId; }
    public String getCaseId() { return caseId; }
    public ReviewStage getStage() { return stage; }
    public String getReviewerId() { return reviewerId; }
    public SubmissionStatus getStatus() { return status; }
    public int getRevisionNo() { return revisionNo; }
    public List<AnswerItem> getAnswerSet() { return Collections.unmodifiableList(answerSet != null ? answerSet : Collections.emptyList()); }
    public BigDecimal getTotalScore() { return totalScore; }
    public String getComment() { return comment; }
    public LocalDateTime getSubmittedAt() { return submittedAt; }
    public String getBasedOnScoreSheetVersionId() { return basedOnScoreSheetVersionId; }
    public String getSupersededBySubmissionId() { return supersededBySubmissionId; }
    public String getAttachmentRefsJson() { return attachmentRefsJson; }
    public LocalDateTime getCreatedAt() { return createdAt; }
    public LocalDateTime getUpdatedAt() { return updatedAt; }
}

package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.event;

import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.DomainEvent;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;

/**
 * Published when a reviewer is assigned (or when a case is reopened to PENDING_INITIAL_REVIEW).

package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common;

import org.springframework.context.ApplicationEvent;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Abstract base class for all domain events.
 * Extends Spring ApplicationEvent for direct integration with Spring's event mechanism.
 *
 * Subclasses should provide concrete event types (e.g., ReviewProjectCreatedEvent).
 * The AuditTrailListener automatically persists all DomainEvent subclasses.
 */
public abstract class DomainEvent extends ApplicationEvent {

    private final String eventId;
    private final Instant occurredAt;
    private final String actorUserId;
    private final String actorUserName;
    private final String hospitalId;
    private final String entityType;
    private final String entityId;
    private final String action;
    private final String detail;

    /**
     * @param source        the object that published this event (typically the application service)
     * @param actorUserId   the authenticated user who triggered the action
     * @param actorUserName display name of the actor
     * @param hospitalId    hospital context (nullable — null for global operations)
     * @param entityType    aggregate type name (e.g., "ReviewProject")
     * @param entityId      aggregate root ID
     * @param action        action name (e.g., "CREATED", "PUBLISHED")
     * @param detail        optional JSON detail (nullable)
     */
    protected DomainEvent(Object source, String actorUserId, String actorUserName,
                          String hospitalId, String entityType, String entityId,
                          String action, String detail) {
        super(source);
        this.eventId = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
        this.occurredAt = Instant.now();
        this.actorUserId = actorUserId;
        this.actorUserName = actorUserName;
        this.hospitalId = hospitalId;
        this.entityType = entityType;
        this.entityId = entityId;
        this.action = action;
        this.detail = detail;
    }

    public String getEventId() { return eventId; }
    public Instant getOccurredAt() { return occurredAt; }
    public String getActorUserId() { return actorUserId; }
    public String getActorUserName() { return actorUserName; }
    public String getHospitalId() { return hospitalId; }
    public String getEntityType() { return entityType; }
    public String getEntityId() { return entityId; }
    public String getAction() { return action; }
    public String getDetail() { return detail; }
}

package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import java.util.Base64;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Generates unsigned test JWTs for @SpringBootTest integration tests.
 * The service does not re-verify the JWT signature (gateway already did),
 * so a fake signature is accepted.
 */
public class TestTokenFactory {

    private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();
    public static final String DEFAULT_HOSPITAL_ID = "H001";

    /** Returns a JWT with HOSPITAL_MANAGER role and default hospitalId (H001). */
    public static String hospitalManagerToken() {
        return hospitalManagerToken(DEFAULT_HOSPITAL_ID);
    }

    /** Returns a JWT with HOSPITAL_MANAGER role and specified hospitalId. */
    public static String hospitalManagerToken(String hospitalId) {
        return buildToken("u-test-01", "Test Manager", hospitalId,
                Map.of("role_name", "hospital_manager", "enabled", true));
    }

    /** Returns a JWT with SYSTEM_ADMIN role and specified hospitalId. */
    public static String systemAdminToken(String hospitalId) {
        return buildToken("u-admin-01", "Test Admin", hospitalId,
                Map.of("role_name", "system_admin", "enabled", true));
    }

    /** Returns a JWT with SYSTEM_ADMIN role and default hospitalId (H001). */
    public static String systemAdminToken() {
        return systemAdminToken(DEFAULT_HOSPITAL_ID);
    }

    /** Returns a JWT with an unknown role (no DomainRole match). */
    public static String unknownRoleToken() {
        return buildToken("u-unknown", "Unknown Role User", null,
                Map.of("role_name", "unknown_role", "enabled", true));
    }

    /** Returns a JWT with REVIEWER role and specified userId + hospitalId. */
    public static String reviewerToken(String userId, String hospitalId) {
        return buildToken(userId, "Test Reviewer", hospitalId,
                Map.of("role_name", "reviewer", "enabled", true));
    }

    /** Returns a JWT with REVIEWER role, default userId and hospitalId. */
    public static String reviewerToken() {
        return reviewerToken("reviewer-1", DEFAULT_HOSPITAL_ID);
    }

    private static String buildToken(String userId, String userName,
                                     String hospitalId, Map<String, Object> role) {
        try {
            String header = base64url(MAPPER.writeValueAsString(
                    Map.of("alg", "RS512", "typ", "JWT")));

            // Build user object — use LinkedHashMap to allow null values
            Map<String, Object> userObj = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            userObj.put("user_id", userId);
            userObj.put("user_name", userName);
            userObj.put("user_role", new Object[]{role});
            if (hospitalId != null) {
                userObj.put("hospital_id", hospitalId);
            }
            String tzUserJson = MAPPER.writeValueAsString(Map.of("user", userObj));

            String payloadJson = MAPPER.writeValueAsString(Map.of(
                    "iss", "api-gateway",
                    "tz-user", tzUserJson
            ));
            String payload = base64url(payloadJson);

            return header + "." + payload + ".test-sig";
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Failed to build test token", e);
        }
    }

    private static String base64url(String json) {
        return Base64.getUrlEncoder().withoutPadding().encodeToString(json.getBytes());
    }
}

package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.infrastructure.persistence.reviewcase;

import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.MedicalRecordType;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCase;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCaseRepository;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewerAssignment;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

@Repository
public class ReviewCaseRepositoryImpl implements ReviewCaseRepository {

    private final ReviewCaseJpaRepository jpa;

    public ReviewCaseRepositoryImpl(ReviewCaseJpaRepository jpa) {
        this.jpa = jpa;
    }

    @Override
    public void save(ReviewCase reviewCase) {
        jpa.save(toEntity(reviewCase));
    }

    @Override
    public void saveAll(List<ReviewCase> cases) {
        jpa.saveAll(cases.stream().map(this::toEntity).collect(Collectors.toList()));
    }

    @Override
    public Optional<ReviewCase> findById(String caseId) {
        return jpa.findById(caseId).map(this::toDomain);
    }

    private ReviewCase toDomain(ReviewCaseEntity e) {
        ReviewerAssignment assignment = null;
        if (e.getReviewerId() != null && e.getReviewerAssignedAt() != null) {
            assignment = new ReviewerAssignment(e.getReviewerId(), e.getReviewerAssignedAt());
        }

        MedicalRecordType mrt = null;
        if (e.getMedicalRecordType() != null) {
            mrt = MedicalRecordType.valueOf(e.getMedicalRecordType());
        }

        return ReviewCase.reconstitute(
                e.getCaseId(), e.getBatchId(), e.getProjectId(), e.getHospitalId(),
                e.getSourceCaseKey(), mrt,
                e.getStatus(), assignment, e.getDueAt(),
                e.getCancelReason(), e.getReturnReason(), e.getCancelledAt(), e.getClosedAt(),
                e.isRereviewRequired(), e.getFinalScore(), e.getFinalConclusion(),
                e.getLatestInitialSubmissionId(), e.getRuleSnapshotRef(), e.getScoreSheetVersionRef());
    }

    private ReviewCaseEntity toEntity(ReviewCase rc) {
        ReviewCaseEntity e = new ReviewCaseEntity();
        e.setCaseId(rc.getCaseId());
        e.setBatchId(rc.getBatchId());
        e.setProjectId(rc.getProjectId());
        e.setHospitalId(rc.getHospitalId());
        e.setSourceCaseKey(rc.getSourceCaseKey());
        e.setMedicalRecordType(rc.getMedicalRecordType() != null ? rc.getMedicalRecordType().name() : null);
        e.setStatus(rc.getStatus());

        if (rc.getReviewerAssignment() != null) {
            e.setReviewerId(rc.getReviewerAssignment().getReviewerId());
            e.setReviewerAssignedAt(rc.getReviewerAssignment().getAssignedAt());
        }
        e.setDueAt(rc.getDueAt());
        e.setCancelReason(rc.getCancelReason());
        e.setReturnReason(rc.getReturnReason());
        e.setCancelledAt(rc.getCancelledAt());
        e.setClosedAt(rc.getClosedAt());
        e.setRereviewRequired(rc.isRereviewRequired());
        e.setFinalScore(rc.getFinalScore());
        e.setFinalConclusion(rc.getFinalConclusion());
        e.setLatestInitialSubmissionId(rc.getLatestInitialSubmissionId());
        e.setRuleSnapshotRef(rc.getRuleSnapshotRef());
        e.setScoreSheetVersionRef(rc.getScoreSheetVersionRef());
        return e;
    }
}

package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase;

import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.AccessDeniedException;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.ActorContext;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.DomainEventPublisher;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.DomainRole;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.DomainRuleViolationException;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.DomainStateConflictException;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.ResourceNotFoundException;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.CaseStatus;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCase;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCaseRepository;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.AnswerItem;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewStage;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewSubmission;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewSubmissionRepository;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.SubmissionStatus;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.event.ReviewSubmissionSubmittedEvent;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.scoresheet.RequiredRule;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.scoresheet.ScoreItem;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.scoresheet.ScoreSheetDefinition;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.scoresheet.ScoreSheetRepository;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

@Service
@Transactional
public class SubmitInitialReviewUseCase {

    private final ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository;
    private final ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository;
    private final ScoreSheetRepository scoreSheetRepository;
    private final DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher;
    private final ScoreCalculationService scoreCalculationService;

    public SubmitInitialReviewUseCase(ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository,
                                       ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository,
                                       ScoreSheetRepository scoreSheetRepository,
                                       DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher,
                                       ScoreCalculationService scoreCalculationService) {
        this.caseRepository = caseRepository;
        this.submissionRepository = submissionRepository;
        this.scoreSheetRepository = scoreSheetRepository;
        this.eventPublisher = eventPublisher;
        this.scoreCalculationService = scoreCalculationService;
    }

    public void execute(ActorContext actor, String caseId) {
        actor.requireRole(DomainRole.REVIEWER);

        ReviewSubmission submission = submissionRepository
                .findLatestByCaseIdAndStage(caseId, ReviewStage.INITIAL)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("SUBMISSION_NOT_FOUND",
                        "No INITIAL submission found for case: " + caseId));

        if (!actor.getUserId().equals(submission.getReviewerId())) {
            throw new AccessDeniedException("NOT_SUBMISSION_OWNER",
                    "Only the reviewer who owns this submission can submit");
        }

        // Load ReviewCase and verify status
        ReviewCase reviewCase = caseRepository.findById(caseId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("CASE_NOT_FOUND",
                        "ReviewCase not found: " + caseId));

        if (reviewCase.getStatus() != CaseStatus.INITIAL_REVIEW_IN_PROGRESS) {
            throw new DomainStateConflictException(
                    "CASE_NOT_IN_PROGRESS",
                    "Case must be in INITIAL_REVIEW_IN_PROGRESS. Current: " + reviewCase.getStatus());
        }

        // Check if already submitted early (will throw DomainStateConflictException)
        if (submission.getStatus() != SubmissionStatus.DRAFT) {
            throw new DomainStateConflictException(
                    "SUBMISSION_NOT_DRAFT",
                    "Submission must be in DRAFT status. Current: " + submission.getStatus());
        }

        ScoreSheetDefinition scoreSheet = scoreSheetRepository
                .findById(submission.getBasedOnScoreSheetVersionId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("SCORE_SHEET_NOT_FOUND",
                        "ScoreSheetDefinition not found: " + submission.getBasedOnScoreSheetVersionId()));

        List<AnswerItem> currentAnswers = submission.getAnswerSet();

        // Validate required items
        Set<String> answeredItemIds = currentAnswers.stream()
                .map(AnswerItem::getItemId)
                .collect(Collectors.toSet());

        List<String> missingRequired = scoreSheet.getSections().stream()
                .flatMap(s -> s.getItems().stream())
                .filter(item -> item.getRequiredRule() == RequiredRule.ALWAYS_REQUIRED)
                .map(ScoreItem::getItemId)
                .filter(id -> !answeredItemIds.contains(id))
                .collect(Collectors.toList());

        if (!missingRequired.isEmpty()) {
            throw new DomainRuleViolationException("REQUIRED_ITEMS_NOT_ANSWERED",
                    "Required items not answered: " + String.join(", ", missingRequired));
        }

        // Recalculate final scores
        List<AnswerItem> rawItems = currentAnswers.stream()
                .map(a -> AnswerItem.ofRaw(a.getItemId(), a.getAnswerValue()))
                .collect(Collectors.toList());

        ScoreResult result = scoreCalculationService.calculate(rawItems, scoreSheet);

        // Update with final scores, then submit
        submission.updateDraft(result.getScoredAnswers(), result.getTotalScore(), submission.getComment());
        submission.submit();
        submissionRepository.save(submission);

        // Complete review case
        reviewCase.completeInitialReview(result.getTotalScore());
        caseRepository.save(reviewCase);

        // Publish event
        eventPublisher.publish(new ReviewSubmissionSubmittedEvent(
                this, actor.getUserId(), actor.getUserName(),
                reviewCase.getHospitalId(), caseId,
                submission.getSubmissionId(), result.getTotalScore(), actor.getUserId()));
    }
}

package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.infrastructure.persistence.project;

import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.MedicalRecordType;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.project.ReviewProject;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.project.ReviewProjectRepository;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;

import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

@Repository
public class ReviewProjectRepositoryImpl implements ReviewProjectRepository {

    private final ReviewProjectJpaRepository jpa;

    public ReviewProjectRepositoryImpl(ReviewProjectJpaRepository jpa) {
        this.jpa = jpa;
    }

    @Override
    public void save(ReviewProject project) {
        ReviewProjectEntity entity = toEntity(project);
        jpa.save(entity);
    }

    @Override
    public Optional<ReviewProject> findById(String projectId) {
        return jpa.findById(projectId).map(this::toDomain);
    }

    private ReviewProjectEntity toEntity(ReviewProject project) {
        ReviewProjectEntity e = new ReviewProjectEntity();
        e.setProjectId(project.getProjectId());
        e.setHospitalId(project.getHospitalId());
        e.setName(project.getName());
        e.setDescription(project.getDescription());
        e.setBoundScoreSheetId(project.getBoundScoreSheetId());
        e.setMedicalRecordTypes(
                project.getMedicalRecordTypes().stream()
                        .map(Enum::name)
                        .collect(Collectors.toSet())
        );
        e.setStatus(project.getStatus());
        e.setVersionNumber(project.getCurrentVersion().getVersionNumber());
        e.setVersionPublished(project.getCurrentVersion().isPublished());
        return e;
    }

    private ReviewProject toDomain(ReviewProjectEntity e) {
        Set<MedicalRecordType> types = e.getMedicalRecordTypes().stream()
                .map(MedicalRecordType::valueOf)
                .collect(Collectors.toSet());
        return ReviewProject.reconstitute(
                e.getProjectId(),
                e.getHospitalId(),
                e.getName(),
                e.getDescription(),
                e.getBoundScoreSheetId(),
                types,
                e.getStatus(),
                e.getVersionNumber(),
                e.isVersionPublished()
        );
    }
}

1. # B4 — Re-review Operations & Closure Design Spec
2. 
3. ## 1. Overview
4. 
5. 本 spec 定義 B4 階段的設計，涵蓋：
6. 
7. - 初審提交後的自動閾值判斷
8. - 主管手動結案 / 手動送複審
9. - 複審員分派與重新分派
10. - 複審作業（開始、草稿、提交）
11. - 複審提交後自動結案與加權平均最終分數計算
12. - 複審修訂（append-only revision）
13. - 複審修訂後 finalScore 重算
14. 
15. **不包含：** 前端頁面（後端優先）
16. 
17. ---
18. 
19. ## 2. Decision Log Updates
20. 
21. B4 需更新以下 decision：
22. 
23. ### 修改 D-012
24. 
25. - **Before:** Final score set by re-reviewer.
26. - **After:** Final score = weighted average of initial review score and re-review score. Default weight 50/50, configurable per ProjectVersion.
27. 
28. ### 新增 D-017
29. 
30. Re-reviewer must not be the same person as the initial reviewer for the same case.
31. 
32. ### 新增 D-018
33. 
34. Re-reviewer cannot see initial review answers or scores during re-review (independent evaluation).
35. 
36. ### 新增 D-019
37. 
38. Threshold auto-evaluation: when initial score > quality threshold → auto PENDING_REREVIEW. When score <= threshold, case stays at INITIAL_REVIEW_COMPLETED; HOSPITAL_MANAGER may manually close or send to re-review.
39. 
40. ### 新增 D-020
41. 
42. Scoring weight (initialReviewWeight, rereviewWeight) is stored in ProjectVersion, default 0.5/0.5. Invariant: initialReviewWeight + rereviewWeight = 1.0, both > 0 and <= 1.
43. 
44. ### 修改 D-001
45. 
46. - **Before:** Results CLOSED cannot be revised.
47. - **After:** CLOSED cases cannot be reopened or have state transitions. However, **rereview revision** (append-only score correction) is allowed on CLOSED cases because: (1) revision does not change case state, (2) revision is not reopen, (3) case remains CLOSED, (4) only finalScore is recalculated. Initial review revision on CLOSED cases remains prohibited (initial review revision window ends when case reaches CLOSED).
48. 
49. ### 新增 D-021
50. 
51. Rereview revision is allowed on CLOSED cases (exception to terminal state no-revision rule). Rationale: rereview submission auto-closes the case, so the only window for rereview revision is after CLOSED. This is safe because revision is append-only and does not change case lifecycle state.
52. 
53. ---
54. 
55. ## 3. Domain Model Extensions
56. 
57. ### 3.1 ReviewCase Aggregate — New Fields
58. 
59. ```yaml
60. ReviewCase:
61.   existing_fields:
62.     - id: ReviewCaseId
63.     - projectId: ReviewProjectId
64.     - status: CaseStatus
65.     - reviewerAssignment: ReviewerAssignment  # initial reviewer
66.     # ... (existing fields omitted)
67. 
68.   new_fields:
69.     - rereviewerAssignment: ReviewerAssignment  # nullable, set on assignRereviewer
70.     - initialReviewScore: BigDecimal            # set on completeInitialReview
71.     - finalScore: BigDecimal                    # set on close (manual or rereview)
72. ```
73. 
74. ### 3.2 ReviewCase Aggregate — Modified Methods
75. 
76. #### `completeInitialReview(score, qualityThreshold)` — MODIFIED
77. 
78. Current signature: `completeInitialReview(score)`
79. 
80. New behavior:
81. - Records `initialReviewScore = score`
82. - If `score > qualityThreshold` → status = `PENDING_REREVIEW`, raises `ReviewCaseEscalatedToRereviewEvent(reason=THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED)`
83. - If `score <= qualityThreshold` → status = `INITIAL_REVIEW_COMPLETED`
84. - Guard: status must be `INITIAL_REVIEW_IN_PROGRESS`
85. 
86. ### 3.3 ReviewCase Aggregate — New Methods
87. 
88. #### `assignRereviewer(rereviewerId, dueAt)`
89. 
90. - Guard: status = `PENDING_REREVIEW`
91. - Guard: `rereviewerId ≠ reviewerAssignment.reviewerId` (D-017)
92. - Sets `rereviewerAssignment = new ReviewerAssignment(rereviewerId, dueAt)`
93. - Raises `RereviewerAssignedEvent`
94. 
95. #### `reassignRereviewer(rereviewerId, dueAt)`
96. 
97. - Guard: status = `PENDING_REREVIEW`
98. - Guard: `rereviewerId ≠ reviewerAssignment.reviewerId` (D-017)
99. - Replaces `rereviewerAssignment`
100. - Raises `RereviewerAssignedEvent`
````

300. 
301. ### 6.6 SaveRereviewDraftUseCase
302. 
303. ```yaml
304. actor: REREVIEWER (assigned re-reviewer)
305. input: caseId, answers[], comment
306. steps:
307.   1. Load ReviewCase
308.   2. Verify actor.userId == case.rereviewerAssignment.reviewerId
309.   3. Verify case.status == REREVIEW_IN_PROGRESS
310.   4. Load current REREVIEW draft submission
311.   5. Load ScoreSheetSnapshot
312.   6. Calculate scores via ScoreCalculationService
313.   7. submission.updateDraft(answers, calculatedScore, comment)
314.   8. Save submission
315. ```
316. 
317. ### 6.7 SubmitRereviewUseCase
318. 
319. ```yaml
320. actor: REREVIEWER (assigned re-reviewer)
321. input: caseId, submissionId
322. steps:
323.   1. Load ReviewCase
324.   2. Verify actor.userId == case.rereviewerAssignment.reviewerId
325.   3. Load ReviewSubmission (verify stage=REREVIEW, status=DRAFT)
326.   4. submission.submit()
327.   5. Load ProjectVersion → get initialReviewWeight, rereviewWeight
328.   6. case.completeRereview(submission.totalScore, initialWeight, rereviewWeight)
329.   7. Save case + submission
330.   8. Publish RereviewCompletedEvent, ReviewCaseClosedEvent
331. ```
332. 
333. ### 6.8 ReviseRereviewUseCase
334. 
335. ```yaml
336. actor: REREVIEWER (original re-reviewer)
337. input: caseId, submissionId, answers[], comment
338. steps:
339.   1. Load ReviewCase
340.   2. Verify case is not CANCELLED (CLOSED is allowed per D-021)
341.   3. Load current SUBMITTED REREVIEW submission
342.   4. Verify actor.userId == case.rereviewerAssignment.reviewerId
343.   5. Load ScoreSheetSnapshot
344.   6. Calculate scores via ScoreCalculationService
345.   7. previousSubmission.markSuperseded()
346.   8. Create new revision via createRereviewRevision()
347.   9. Load ProjectVersion → get weights
348.   10. case.updateFinalScoreOnRereviewRevision(newScore, initialWeight, rereviewWeight)
349.   11. Save case + old submission + new submission
350.   12. Publish RereviewSubmissionRevisedEvent
351. ```
352. 
353. **Note:** Unlike initial review revision, rereview revision IS allowed on CLOSED cases (D-021). This is because rereview submission auto-closes the case, making CLOSED the only state where rereview revision can occur. The revision does not change the case state — only finalScore is recalculated.
354. 
355. ### 6.9 GetRereviewRevisionHistoryUseCase
356. 
357. ```yaml
358. actor: multiple roles (per permission matrix)
359. input: caseId
360. steps:
361.   1. Load all REREVIEW stage submissions for caseId
362.   2. Return ordered by revisionNo
363.   3. Apply visibility rules per permission matrix
364. ```
365. 
366. ### 6.10 Modified: SubmitInitialReviewUseCase
367. 
368. ```yaml
369. changes:
370.   - After submission.submit(), load ProjectVersion to get qualityThreshold
371.   - Call case.completeInitialReview(submission.totalScore, qualityThreshold) instead of case.completeInitialReview(submission.totalScore)
372.   - Domain decides state transition based on threshold comparison
373. ```

535. ## 11. Testing Strategy
536. 
537. ### 11.1 Domain Tests
538. 
539. - Each new ReviewCase method: happy path + guard violation
540.   - `assignRereviewer`: valid + same-as-reviewer guard + wrong state
541.   - `startRereview`: valid + wrong actor + wrong state
542.   - `completeRereview`: valid + finalScore calculation + wrong state
543.   - `closeWithoutRereview`: valid + wrong state
544.   - `sendToRereview`: valid + wrong state
545.   - `completeInitialReview` (modified): threshold auto-evaluation (above, at, below threshold)
546. 
547. ### 11.2 Application Tests
548. 
549. - Each use case: ~5-10 tests using InMemory test doubles
550. - Focus: actor guard, domain invariant delegation, score calculation, revision append-only
551. 
552. ### 11.3 API Integration Tests
553. 
554. - Each endpoint: happy path + common errors
555. - Using TestTokenFactory pattern
556. - Focus: HTTP status codes, response body, error envelope
557. 
558. ### 11.4 Key Edge Cases
559. 
560. 1. Rereviewer == initial reviewer → 422 DomainRuleViolationException
561. 2. Case already CANCELLED → revision attempt → 409 DomainStateConflictException
562. 3. Case CLOSED → rereview revision allowed (D-021), initial review revision still blocked
563. 4. Weighted average calculation precision (BigDecimal HALF_UP rounding)
564. 5. Rereview revision → finalScore recalculation correctness
565. 6. Threshold boundary: score == threshold → stays INITIAL_REVIEW_COMPLETED (not escalated)
566. 7. Manual sendToRereview on case already at INITIAL_REVIEW_COMPLETED with score <= threshold → allowed
567.

125.         if (this.status == CaseStatus.CLOSED || this.status == CaseStatus.CANCELLED) {
126.             throw new DomainStateConflictException("CASE_TERMINAL",

128.         }
129.         Objects.requireNonNull(reason, "cancel reason must not be null");
130.         this.cancelReason = reason;
131.         this.cancelledAt = LocalDateTime.now();
132.         this.status = CaseStatus.CANCELLED;

136.         if (this.status != CaseStatus.INITIAL_REVIEW_IN_PROGRESS) {
137.             throw new DomainStateConflictException("CASE_NOT_IN_PROGRESS",
138.                     "Cannot return: case status is " + this.status);
139.         }
140.         Objects.requireNonNull(reason, "return reason must not be null");
141.         this.returnReason = reason;
142.         this.status = CaseStatus.RETURNED;

147.             throw new DomainStateConflictException("CASE_NOT_RETURNED",

149.         }
150.         this.returnReason = null;
151.         this.status = CaseStatus.PENDING_INITIAL_REVIEW;

158.             throw new DomainStateConflictException("CASE_NOT_PENDING_INITIAL_REVIEW",

101.         requireDraft();
102.         Objects.requireNonNull(scoredAnswers, "scoredAnswers must not be null");
103.         Objects.requireNonNull(totalScore, "totalScore must not be null");
104.         this.answerSet = new ArrayList<>(scoredAnswers);
105.         this.totalScore = totalScore;
106.         this.comment = comment;
107.         this.updatedAt = LocalDateTime.now();
108.     }
109. 
110.     /**
111.      * Submit this draft. Transitions DRAFT → SUBMITTED. Irreversible.
112.      */
113.     public void submit() {
114.         requireDraft();
115.         this.status = SubmissionStatus.SUBMITTED;
116.         this.submittedAt = LocalDateTime.now();
117.         this.updatedAt = LocalDateTime.now();
118.     }

122.      * The new submission is directly SUBMITTED (no DRAFT phase for revisions).
123.      */
124.     public static ReviewSubmission createRevision(
125.             String newSubmissionId,
126.             ReviewSubmission oldSubmission,
127.             List<AnswerItem> scoredAnswers,
128.             BigDecimal totalScore,
129.             String comment) {
130.         Objects.requireNonNull(newSubmissionId, "newSubmissionId must not be null");
131.         Objects.requireNonNull(oldSubmission, "oldSubmission must not be null");
132.         Objects.requireNonNull(scoredAnswers, "scoredAnswers must not be null");
133.         Objects.requireNonNull(totalScore, "totalScore must not be null");
134. 
135.         if (oldSubmission.status != SubmissionStatus.SUBMITTED) {
136.             throw new DomainStateConflictException("SUBMISSION_NOT_SUBMITTED",
137.                     "Can only revise a SUBMITTED submission. Current: " + oldSubmission.status);
138.         }
139. 
140.         ReviewSubmission rev = new ReviewSubmission();
141.         rev.submissionId = newSubmissionId;
142.         rev.caseId = oldSubmission.caseId;
143.         rev.stage = oldSubmission.stage;
144.         rev.reviewerId = oldSubmission.reviewerId;
145.         rev.status = SubmissionStatus.SUBMITTED;
146.         rev.revisionNo = oldSubmission.revisionNo + 1;
147.         rev.answerSet = new ArrayList<>(scoredAnswers);
148.         rev.totalScore = totalScore;
149.         rev.comment = comment;
150.         rev.submittedAt = LocalDateTime.now();
151.         rev.basedOnScoreSheetVersionId = oldSubmission.basedOnScoreSheetVersionId;
152.         rev.createdAt = LocalDateTime.now();
153.         rev.updatedAt = rev.createdAt;
154.         return rev;
155.     }
156.

159.      * Only SUBMITTED submissions can be superseded.

162.         if (this.status != SubmissionStatus.SUBMITTED) {

164.                     "Can only supersede a SUBMITTED submission. Current: " + this.status);
165.         }

167.         this.supersededBySubmissionId = newSubmissionId;
168.         this.status = SubmissionStatus.SUPERSEDED;

1. package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase;
2. 
3. import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.AccessDeniedException;
4. import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.ActorContext;
5. import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.DomainEventPublisher;
6. import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.DomainRole;
7. import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.DomainRuleViolationException;
8. import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.DomainStateConflictException;
9. import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.ResourceNotFoundException;
10. import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.CaseStatus;
11. import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCase;
12. import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCaseRepository;
13. import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.AnswerItem;
14. import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewStage;
15. import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewSubmission;
16. import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewSubmissionRepository;
17. import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.SubmissionStatus;
18. import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.event.ReviewSubmissionSubmittedEvent;
19. import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.scoresheet.RequiredRule;
20. import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.scoresheet.ScoreItem;
21. import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.scoresheet.ScoreSheetDefinition;
22. import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.scoresheet.ScoreSheetRepository;
23. import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
24. import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
25. 
26. import java.util.List;
27. import java.util.Set;
28. import java.util.stream.Collectors;
29. 
30. @Service
31. @Transactional
32. public class SubmitInitialReviewUseCase {
33. 
34.     private final ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository;
35.     private final ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository;
36.     private final ScoreSheetRepository scoreSheetRepository;
37.     private final DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher;
38.     private final ScoreCalculationService scoreCalculationService;
39. 
40.     public SubmitInitialReviewUseCase(ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository,
41.                                        ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository,
42.                                        ScoreSheetRepository scoreSheetRepository,
43.                                        DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher,
44.                                        ScoreCalculationService scoreCalculationService) {
45.         this.caseRepository = caseRepository;
46.         this.submissionRepository = submissionRepository;
47.         this.scoreSheetRepository = scoreSheetRepository;
48.         this.eventPublisher = eventPublisher;
49.         this.scoreCalculationService = scoreCalculationService;
50.     }
51. 
52.     public void execute(ActorContext actor, String caseId) {
53.         actor.requireRole(DomainRole.REVIEWER);
54. 
55.         ReviewSubmission submission = submissionRepository
56.                 .findLatestByCaseIdAndStage(caseId, ReviewStage.INITIAL)
57.                 .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("SUBMISSION_NOT_FOUND",
58.                         "No INITIAL submission found for case: " + caseId));
59. 
60.         if (!actor.getUserId().equals(submission.getReviewerId())) {
61.             throw new AccessDeniedException("NOT_SUBMISSION_OWNER",
62.                     "Only the reviewer who owns this submission can submit");
63.         }
64. 
65.         // Load ReviewCase and verify status
66.         ReviewCase reviewCase = caseRepository.findById(caseId)
67.                 .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("CASE_NOT_FOUND",
68.                         "ReviewCase not found: " + caseId));
69. 
70.         if (reviewCase.getStatus() != CaseStatus.INITIAL_REVIEW_IN_PROGRESS) {
71.             throw new DomainStateConflictException(
72.                     "CASE_NOT_IN_PROGRESS",
73.                     "Case must be in INITIAL_REVIEW_IN_PROGRESS. Current: " + reviewCase.getStatus());
74.         }
75. 
76.         // Check if already submitted early (will throw DomainStateConflictException)
77.         if (submission.getStatus() != SubmissionStatus.DRAFT) {
78.             throw new DomainStateConflictException(
79.                     "SUBMISSION_NOT_DRAFT",
80.                     "Submission must be in DRAFT status. Current: " + submission.getStatus());
81.         }
82. 
83.         ScoreSheetDefinition scoreSheet = scoreSheetRepository
84.                 .findById(submission.getBasedOnScoreSheetVersionId())
85.                 .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("SCORE_SHEET_NOT_FOUND",
86.                         "ScoreSheetDefinition not found: " + submission.getBasedOnScoreSheetVersionId()));
87. 
88.         List<AnswerItem> currentAnswers = submission.getAnswerSet();
89. 
90.         // Validate required items
91.         Set<String> answeredItemIds = currentAnswers.stream()
92.                 .map(AnswerItem::getItemId)
93.                 .collect(Collectors.toSet());
94. 
95.         List<String> missingRequired = scoreSheet.getSections().stream()
96.                 .flatMap(s -> s.getItems().stream())
97.                 .filter(item -> item.getRequiredRule() == RequiredRule.ALWAYS_REQUIRED)
98.                 .map(ScoreItem::getItemId)
99.                 .filter(id -> !answeredItemIds.contains(id))
100.                 .collect(Collectors.toList());
101. 
102.         if (!missingRequired.isEmpty()) {
103.             throw new DomainRuleViolationException("REQUIRED_ITEMS_NOT_ANSWERED",
104.                     "Required items not answered: " + String.join(", ", missingRequired));
105.         }
106. 
107.         // Recalculate final scores
108.         List<AnswerItem> rawItems = currentAnswers.stream()
109.                 .map(a -> AnswerItem.ofRaw(a.getItemId(), a.getAnswerValue()))
110.                 .collect(Collectors.toList());
111. 
112.         ScoreResult result = scoreCalculationService.calculate(rawItems, scoreSheet);
113. 
114.         // Update with final scores, then submit
115.         submission.updateDraft(result.getScoredAnswers(), result.getTotalScore(), submission.getComment());
116.         submission.submit();
117.         submissionRepository.save(submission);
118. 
119.         // Complete review case
120.         reviewCase.completeInitialReview(result.getTotalScore());
121.         caseRepository.save(reviewCase);
122. 
123.         // Publish event
124.         eventPublisher.publish(new ReviewSubmissionSubmittedEvent(
125.                 this, actor.getUserId(), actor.getUserName(),
126.                 reviewCase.getHospitalId(), caseId,
127.                 submission.getSubmissionId(), result.getTotalScore(), actor.getUserId()));
128.     }
129. }
130.
```

1. package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.project;
2. 
3. import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.DomainRuleViolationException;
4. import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.DomainStateConflictException;
5. import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.MedicalRecordType;
6. 
7. import java.util.*;
8. 
9. /**
10.  * Aggregate root for ReviewProject.
11.  * <p>
12.  * A ReviewProject defines a quality review activity including sampling policy,
13.  * score sheet binding, reviewer pool, quality threshold, and effective period.
14.  * <p>
15.  * Invariants:
16.  * - An unpublished project cannot execute sampling.
17.  * - A published version is immutable.
18.  * - Version publication creates a new immutable snapshot.
19.  * - Activation requires a published version AND a bound score sheet.
20.  * - DEACTIVATED is terminal — no re-activation.
21.  */
22. public class ReviewProject {
23. 
24.     private String projectId;
25.     private String hospitalId;
26.     private String name;
27.     private String description;
28.     private String boundScoreSheetId;
29.     private Set<MedicalRecordType> medicalRecordTypes;
30.     private ProjectStatus status;
31.     private ProjectVersion currentVersion;
32. 
33.     protected ReviewProject() {
34.         // for JPA
35.     }
36. 
37.     private ReviewProject(String projectId, String hospitalId, String name,
38.                           String description, Set<MedicalRecordType> medicalRecordTypes) {
39.         Objects.requireNonNull(projectId, "projectId must not be null");
40.         Objects.requireNonNull(hospitalId, "hospitalId must not be null");
41.         Objects.requireNonNull(name, "name must not be null");
42.         if (name.isBlank()) {
43.             throw new DomainRuleViolationException("INVALID_PROJECT_NAME",
44.                     "Project name must not be blank");
45.         }
46.         this.projectId = projectId;
47.         this.hospitalId = hospitalId;
48.         this.name = name;
49.         this.description = description;
50.         this.medicalRecordTypes = (medicalRecordTypes != null && !medicalRecordTypes.isEmpty())
51.                 ? EnumSet.copyOf(medicalRecordTypes)
52.                 : EnumSet.noneOf(MedicalRecordType.class);
53.         this.status = ProjectStatus.DRAFT;
54.         this.currentVersion = new ProjectVersion(1, false);
55.     }
56. 
57.     public static ReviewProject create(String projectId, String hospitalId, String name,
58.                                         String description,
59.                                         Set<MedicalRecordType> medicalRecordTypes) {
60.         return new ReviewProject(projectId, hospitalId, name, description, medicalRecordTypes);
61.     }
62. 
63.     /**
64.      * Reconstitute a ReviewProject from persisted state.
65.      * FOR INFRASTRUCTURE USE ONLY — do not call from domain or application code.
66.      */
67.     public static ReviewProject reconstitute(String projectId, String hospitalId, String name,
68.                                               String description, String boundScoreSheetId,
69.                                               Set<MedicalRecordType> medicalRecordTypes,
70.                                               ProjectStatus status, int versionNumber,
71.                                               boolean versionPublished) {
72.         ReviewProject project = new ReviewProject();
73.         project.projectId = projectId;
74.         project.hospitalId = hospitalId;
75.         project.name = name;
76.         project.description = description;
77.         project.boundScoreSheetId = boundScoreSheetId;
78.         project.medicalRecordTypes = (medicalRecordTypes != null && !medicalRecordTypes.isEmpty())
79.                 ? EnumSet.copyOf(medicalRecordTypes)
80.                 : EnumSet.noneOf(MedicalRecordType.class);
81.         project.status = status;
82.         project.currentVersion = new ProjectVersion(versionNumber, versionPublished);
83.         return project;
84.     }
85. 
86.     public void activate() {
87.         if (this.status == ProjectStatus.ACTIVE) {
88.             return; // idempotent
89.         }
90.         if (this.status != ProjectStatus.DRAFT) {
91.             throw new DomainStateConflictException("INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION",
92.                     "Can only activate from DRAFT status, current: " + this.status);
93.         }
94.         if (!this.currentVersion.isPublished()) {
95.             throw new DomainStateConflictException("INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION",
96.                     "Cannot activate project without a published version");
97.         }
98.         if (this.boundScoreSheetId == null) {
99.             throw new DomainRuleViolationException("SCORE_SHEET_NOT_BOUND",
100.                     "Cannot activate project without a bound score sheet");
101.         }
102.         this.status = ProjectStatus.ACTIVE;
103.     }
104. 
105.     public void deactivate() {
106.         if (this.status == ProjectStatus.DEACTIVATED) {
107.             return; // idempotent
108.         }
109.         if (this.status != ProjectStatus.ACTIVE) {
110.             throw new DomainStateConflictException("INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION",
111.                     "Can only deactivate from ACTIVE status, current: " + this.status);
112.         }
113.         this.status = ProjectStatus.DEACTIVATED;
114.     }
115. 
116.     /**
117.      * Update draft project fields. Only allowed in DRAFT status.
118.      */
119.     public void updateDraft(String name, String description, Set<MedicalRecordType> types) {
120.         requireStatusDraft();
121.         Objects.requireNonNull(name, "name must not be null");
122.         if (name.isBlank()) {
123.             throw new DomainRuleViolationException("INVALID_PROJECT_NAME",
124.                     "Project name must not be blank");
125.         }
126.         this.name = name;
127.         this.description = description;
128.         this.medicalRecordTypes = (types != null && !types.isEmpty())
129.                 ? EnumSet.copyOf(types)
130.                 : EnumSet.noneOf(MedicalRecordType.class);
131.     }
132. 
133.     /**
134.      * Bind a score sheet definition to this project. Only allowed in DRAFT status.
135.      * Does NOT cross-validate that the scoreSheetId exists or is published.
136.      */
137.     public void bindScoreSheet(String scoreSheetId) {
138.         requireStatusDraft();
139.         Objects.requireNonNull(scoreSheetId, "scoreSheetId must not be null");
140.         this.boundScoreSheetId = scoreSheetId;
141.     }
142. 
143.     /**
144.      * Publish the current draft version, making it immutable.
145.      */
146.     public void publishNewVersion() {
147.         if (this.currentVersion.isPublished()) {
148.             throw new DomainStateConflictException("INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION",
149.                     "Current version is already published. Cannot re-publish without creating a new draft.");
150.         }
151.         this.currentVersion = this.currentVersion.publish();
152.     }
153. 
154.     /**
155.      * Prepare a new draft version for future edits.
156.      * Can only be called when the current version is published.
157.      */
158.     public void prepareDraftVersion() {
159.         if (!this.currentVersion.isPublished()) {
160.             throw new DomainStateConflictException("INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION",
161.                     "A draft version already exists");
162.         }
163.         this.currentVersion = this.currentVersion.nextDraft();
164.     }
165. 
166.     public void updateName(String name) {
167.         requireDraft();
168.         Objects.requireNonNull(name, "name must not be null");
169.         if (name.isBlank()) {
170.             throw new DomainRuleViolationException("INVALID_PROJECT_NAME",
171.                     "Project name must not be blank");
172.         }
173.         this.name = name;
174.     }
175. 
176.     private void requireDraft() {
177.         if (this.currentVersion.isPublished()) {
178.             throw new DomainStateConflictException("INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION",
179.                     "Cannot modify a published version");
180.         }
181.     }
182. 
183.     private void requireStatusDraft() {
184.         if (this.status != ProjectStatus.DRAFT) {
185.             throw new DomainStateConflictException("INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION",
186.                     "Operation only allowed in DRAFT status, current: " + this.status);
187.         }
188.     }

14. import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewSubmission;
15. import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewSubmissionRepository;
16. import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.event.ReviewSubmissionRevisedEvent;
17. import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.scoresheet.ScoreSheetDefinition;
18. import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.scoresheet.ScoreSheetRepository;
19. import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.interfaces.rest.BadRequestException;
20. import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
21. import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
22. 
23. import java.util.List;
24. import java.util.UUID;
25. import java.util.stream.Collectors;
26. 
27. @Service
28. @Transactional
29. public class ReviseInitialReviewUseCase {
30. 
31.     private final ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository;
32.     private final ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository;
33.     private final ScoreSheetRepository scoreSheetRepository;
34.     private final DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher;
35.     private final ScoreCalculationService scoreCalculationService;
36. 
37.     public ReviseInitialReviewUseCase(ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository,
38.                                        ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository,
39.                                        ScoreSheetRepository scoreSheetRepository,
40.                                        DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher,
41.                                        ScoreCalculationService scoreCalculationService) {
42.         this.caseRepository = caseRepository;
43.         this.submissionRepository = submissionRepository;
44.         this.scoreSheetRepository = scoreSheetRepository;
45.         this.eventPublisher = eventPublisher;
46.         this.scoreCalculationService = scoreCalculationService;
47.     }
48. 
49.     public RevisionResult execute(ActorContext actor, String caseId, String submissionId,
50.                                    List<AnswerInput> answers, String comment) {
51.         actor.requireRole(DomainRole.REVIEWER);
52. 
53.         // Load and validate ReviewCase
54.         ReviewCase reviewCase = caseRepository.findById(caseId)
55.                 .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("CASE_NOT_FOUND",
56.                         "ReviewCase not found: " + caseId));
57.         reviewCase.requireNotTerminal();
58. 
59.         // Load and validate old submission
60.         ReviewSubmission oldSubmission = submissionRepository.findById(submissionId)
61.                 .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("SUBMISSION_NOT_FOUND",
62.                         "Submission not found: " + submissionId));
63. 
64.         if (!oldSubmission.getCaseId().equals(caseId)) {
65.             throw new BadRequestException(
66.                     "Submission " + submissionId + " does not belong to case " + caseId);
67.         }
68. 
69.         if (oldSubmission.getStage() != ReviewStage.INITIAL) {
70.             throw new DomainRuleViolationException("SUBMISSION_NOT_INITIAL",
71.                     "Can only revise INITIAL stage submissions. Current: " + oldSubmission.getStage());
72.         }
73. 
74.         if (!actor.getUserId().equals(oldSubmission.getReviewerId())) {
75.             throw new AccessDeniedException("NOT_SUBMISSION_OWNER",
76.                     "Only the original reviewer can revise this submission");
77.         }
78. 
79.         // Load score sheet for scoring
80.         ScoreSheetDefinition scoreSheet = scoreSheetRepository
81.                 .findById(oldSubmission.getBasedOnScoreSheetVersionId())
82.                 .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("SCORE_SHEET_NOT_FOUND",
83.                         "ScoreSheetDefinition not found: " + oldSubmission.getBasedOnScoreSheetVersionId()));
84. 
85.         // Calculate scores
86.         List<AnswerItem> rawItems = answers.stream()
87.                 .map(a -> AnswerItem.ofRaw(a.getItemId(), a.getAnswerValue()))
88.                 .collect(Collectors.toList());
89.         ScoreResult result = scoreCalculationService.calculate(rawItems, scoreSheet);
90. 
91.         // Create new revision
92.         String newSubmissionId = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
93.         ReviewSubmission newSubmission = ReviewSubmission.createRevision(
94.                 newSubmissionId, oldSubmission, result.getScoredAnswers(),
95.                 result.getTotalScore(), comment);
96. 
97.         // Mark old as superseded
98.         oldSubmission.markSuperseded(newSubmissionId);
99. 
100.         // Update case's final score (no status change)
101.         reviewCase.updateFinalScore(result.getTotalScore());
102. 
103.         // Persist
104.         submissionRepository.save(oldSubmission);
105.         submissionRepository.save(newSubmission);
106.         caseRepository.save(reviewCase);
107. 
108.         // Publish event
109.         eventPublisher.publish(new ReviewSubmissionRevisedEvent(
110.                 this, actor.getUserId(), actor.getUserName(),
111.                 reviewCase.getHospitalId(), caseId,
112.                 submissionId, newSubmissionId,
113.                 oldSubmission.getStage().name(), newSubmission.getRevisionNo()));
114. 
115.         return new RevisionResult(
116.                 newSubmissionId, newSubmission.getRevisionNo(),
117.                 result.getTotalScore(), newSubmission.getStatus().name());
118.     }
119. }

1. package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection;
2. 
3. import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
4. import java.util.Base64;
5. import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
6. import java.util.Map;
7. 
8. /**
9.  * Generates unsigned test JWTs for @SpringBootTest integration tests.
10.  * The service does not re-verify the JWT signature (gateway already did),
11.  * so a fake signature is accepted.
12.  */
13. public class TestTokenFactory {
14. 
15.     private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();
16.     public static final String DEFAULT_HOSPITAL_ID = "H001";
17. 
18.     /** Returns a JWT with HOSPITAL_MANAGER role and default hospitalId (H001). */
19.     public static String hospitalManagerToken() {
20.         return hospitalManagerToken(DEFAULT_HOSPITAL_ID);
21.     }
22. 
23.     /** Returns a JWT with HOSPITAL_MANAGER role and specified hospitalId. */
24.     public static String hospitalManagerToken(String hospitalId) {
25.         return buildToken("u-test-01", "Test Manager", hospitalId,
26.                 Map.of("role_name", "hospital_manager", "enabled", true));
27.     }
28. 
29.     /** Returns a JWT with SYSTEM_ADMIN role and specified hospitalId. */
30.     public static String systemAdminToken(String hospitalId) {
31.         return buildToken("u-admin-01", "Test Admin", hospitalId,
32.                 Map.of("role_name", "system_admin", "enabled", true));
33.     }
34. 
35.     /** Returns a JWT with SYSTEM_ADMIN role and default hospitalId (H001). */
36.     public static String systemAdminToken() {
37.         return systemAdminToken(DEFAULT_HOSPITAL_ID);
38.     }
39. 
40.     /** Returns a JWT with an unknown role (no DomainRole match). */
41.     public static String unknownRoleToken() {
42.         return buildToken("u-unknown", "Unknown Role User", null,
43.                 Map.of("role_name", "unknown_role", "enabled", true));
44.     }
45. 
46.     /** Returns a JWT with REVIEWER role and specified userId + hospitalId. */
47.     public static String reviewerToken(String userId, String hospitalId) {
48.         return buildToken(userId, "Test Reviewer", hospitalId,
49.                 Map.of("role_name", "reviewer", "enabled", true));
50.     }
51. 
52.     /** Returns a JWT with REVIEWER role, default userId and hospitalId. */
53.     public static String reviewerToken() {
54.         return reviewerToken("reviewer-1", DEFAULT_HOSPITAL_ID);
55.     }
56. 
57.     private static String buildToken(String userId, String userName,
58.                                      String hospitalId, Map<String, Object> role) {
59.         try {
60.             String header = base64url(MAPPER.writeValueAsString(
61.                     Map.of("alg", "RS512", "typ", "JWT")));
62. 
63.             // Build user object — use LinkedHashMap to allow null values
64.             Map<String, Object> userObj = new LinkedHashMap<>();
65.             userObj.put("user_id", userId);
66.             userObj.put("user_name", userName);
67.             userObj.put("user_role", new Object[]{role});
68.             if (hospitalId != null) {
69.                 userObj.put("hospital_id", hospitalId);
70.             }
71.             String tzUserJson = MAPPER.writeValueAsString(Map.of("user", userObj));
72. 
73.             String payloadJson = MAPPER.writeValueAsString(Map.of(
74.                     "iss", "api-gateway",
75.                     "tz-user", tzUserJson
76.             ));
77.             String payload = base64url(payloadJson);
78. 
79.             return header + "." + payload + ".test-sig";
80.         } catch (Exception e) {
81.             throw new RuntimeException("Failed to build test token", e);
82.         }
83.     }
84. 
85.     private static String base64url(String json) {
86.         return Base64.getUrlEncoder().withoutPadding().encodeToString(json.getBytes());
87.     }
88. }
89.

### Task 1: Update decision-log.md

This is a docs-only task. Update the decision log with B4 decisions before touching code.

- [ ] **Step 1: Add/modify decisions in decision-log.md**

Append the following entries (use the existing format in the file):

**Modify D-001:**
> - **Before:** Results in CLOSED status cannot be revised.
> - **After:** CLOSED cases cannot be reopened or have state transitions. However, **rereview revision** (append-only score correction) is allowed on CLOSED cases because: (1) revision does not change case state, (2) revision is not reopen, (3) case remains CLOSED, (4) only finalScore is recalculated. Initial review revision on CLOSED cases remains prohibited.

**Modify D-012:**
> - **Before:** Final score set by re-reviewer.
> - **After:** Final score = weighted average of initial review score and re-review score. Default weight 50/50, configurable per ProjectVersion.

**Add D-017:** Re-reviewer must not be the same person as the initial reviewer for the same case.

**Add D-018:** Re-reviewer cannot see initial review answers or scores during re-review (independent evaluation).

**Add D-019:** Threshold auto-evaluation: when initial score > quality threshold → auto PENDING_REREVIEW. When score ≤ threshold or threshold is null, case stays at INITIAL_REVIEW_COMPLETED; HOSPITAL_MANAGER may manually close or send to re-review.

**Add D-020:** Scoring weight (initialReviewWeight, rereviewWeight) is stored in ProjectVersion, default 0.5/0.5. Invariant: initialReviewWeight + rereviewWeight = 1.0, both > 0 and ≤ 1.

**Add D-021:** Rereview revision is allowed on CLOSED cases (exception to terminal state no-revision rule). Rationale: rereview submission auto-closes the case, so the only window for rereview revision is after CLOSED. This is safe because revision is append-only and does not change case lifecycle state.

```java
package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.project;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Immutable version snapshot for a ReviewProject.
 * Carries scoring configuration: qualityThreshold and review weights.
 */
public class ProjectVersion {

    private static final BigDecimal DEFAULT_WEIGHT = new BigDecimal("0.5");

    private final int versionNumber;
    private final boolean published;
    private final BigDecimal qualityThreshold;
    private final BigDecimal initialReviewWeight;
    private final BigDecimal rereviewWeight;

    public ProjectVersion(int versionNumber, boolean published) {
        this(versionNumber, published, null, DEFAULT_WEIGHT, DEFAULT_WEIGHT);
    }

    public ProjectVersion(int versionNumber, boolean published,
                          BigDecimal qualityThreshold,
                          BigDecimal initialReviewWeight,
                          BigDecimal rereviewWeight) {
        if (versionNumber < 1) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Version number must be >= 1");
        }
        this.versionNumber = versionNumber;
        this.published = published;
        this.qualityThreshold = qualityThreshold;
        this.initialReviewWeight = initialReviewWeight != null ? initialReviewWeight : DEFAULT_WEIGHT;
        this.rereviewWeight = rereviewWeight != null ? rereviewWeight : DEFAULT_WEIGHT;
    }

    /**
     * Validate that weights sum to 1.0 and each is > 0 and <= 1.
     * Called before publishing a version.
     */
    public void validateWeightsForPublish() {
        if (initialReviewWeight.compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) <= 0
                || initialReviewWeight.compareTo(BigDecimal.ONE) > 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "initialReviewWeight must be > 0 and <= 1, got: " + initialReviewWeight);
        }
        if (rereviewWeight.compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) <= 0
                || rereviewWeight.compareTo(BigDecimal.ONE) > 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "rereviewWeight must be > 0 and <= 1, got: " + rereviewWeight);
        }
        if (initialReviewWeight.add(rereviewWeight).compareTo(BigDecimal.ONE) != 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Weights must sum to 1.0, got: " + initialReviewWeight + " + " + rereviewWeight);
        }
    }

    public int getVersionNumber() { return versionNumber; }
    public boolean isPublished() { return published; }
    public BigDecimal getQualityThreshold() { return qualityThreshold; }
    public BigDecimal getInitialReviewWeight() { return initialReviewWeight; }
    public BigDecimal getRereviewWeight() { return rereviewWeight; }

    public ProjectVersion publish() {
        return new ProjectVersion(this.versionNumber, true,
                this.qualityThreshold, this.initialReviewWeight, this.rereviewWeight);
    }

    public ProjectVersion nextDraft() {
        return new ProjectVersion(this.versionNumber + 1, false,
                this.qualityThreshold, this.initialReviewWeight, this.rereviewWeight);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object o) {
        if (this == o) return true;
        if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
        ProjectVersion that = (ProjectVersion) o;
        return versionNumber == that.versionNumber && published == that.published;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hash(versionNumber, published);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "v" + versionNumber + (published ? " (published)" : " (draft)");
    }
}
```

    public void completeInitialReview(BigDecimal totalScore, BigDecimal qualityThreshold) {
        if (this.status != CaseStatus.INITIAL_REVIEW_IN_PROGRESS) {
            throw new DomainStateConflictException("CASE_NOT_IN_INITIAL_REVIEW",
                    "Case must be in INITIAL_REVIEW_IN_PROGRESS to complete. Current: " + this.status);
        }
        Objects.requireNonNull(totalScore, "totalScore must not be null");
        this.initialReviewScore = totalScore;
        if (qualityThreshold != null && totalScore.compareTo(qualityThreshold) > 0) {
            this.status = CaseStatus.PENDING_REREVIEW;
        } else {
            this.finalScore = totalScore;
            this.status = CaseStatus.INITIAL_REVIEW_COMPLETED;
        }
    }

    // --- B4 Domain Methods ---

    public void closeWithoutRereview() {
        if (this.status != CaseStatus.INITIAL_REVIEW_COMPLETED) {
            throw new DomainStateConflictException("CASE_NOT_INITIAL_REVIEW_COMPLETED",
                    "Can only close-without-rereview from INITIAL_REVIEW_COMPLETED. Current: " + this.status);
        }
        this.finalScore = this.initialReviewScore;
        this.closedAt = LocalDateTime.now();
        this.status = CaseStatus.CLOSED;
    }

    public void sendToRereview() {
        if (this.status != CaseStatus.INITIAL_REVIEW_COMPLETED) {
            throw new DomainStateConflictException("CASE_NOT_INITIAL_REVIEW_COMPLETED",
                    "Can only send-to-rereview from INITIAL_REVIEW_COMPLETED. Current: " + this.status);
        }
        this.status = CaseStatus.PENDING_REREVIEW;
    }

```java
    public void assignRereviewer(String rereviewerId, LocalDateTime dueAt) {
        if (this.status != CaseStatus.PENDING_REREVIEW) {
            throw new DomainStateConflictException("CASE_NOT_PENDING_REREVIEW",
                    "Can only assign rereviewer in PENDING_REREVIEW. Current: " + this.status);
        }
        Objects.requireNonNull(rereviewerId, "rereviewerId must not be null");
        if (this.reviewerAssignment != null
                && rereviewerId.equals(this.reviewerAssignment.getReviewerId())) {
            throw new DomainRuleViolationException("REREVIEWER_SAME_AS_REVIEWER",
                    "Re-reviewer must not be the same person as the initial reviewer (D-017)");
        }
        this.rereviewerAssignment = new ReviewerAssignment(rereviewerId, LocalDateTime.now());
        this.rereviewerDueAt = dueAt;
    }

    public void reassignRereviewer(String rereviewerId, LocalDateTime dueAt) {
        if (this.status != CaseStatus.PENDING_REREVIEW) {
            throw new DomainStateConflictException("CASE_NOT_PENDING_REREVIEW",
                    "Can only reassign rereviewer in PENDING_REREVIEW. Current: " + this.status);
        }
        Objects.requireNonNull(rereviewerId, "rereviewerId must not be null");
        if (this.reviewerAssignment != null
                && rereviewerId.equals(this.reviewerAssignment.getReviewerId())) {
            throw new DomainRuleViolationException("REREVIEWER_SAME_AS_REVIEWER",
                    "Re-reviewer must not be the same person as the initial reviewer (D-017)");
        }
        this.rereviewerAssignment = new ReviewerAssignment(rereviewerId, LocalDateTime.now());
        this.rereviewerDueAt = dueAt;
    }

    public void startRereview(String actorId) {
        if (this.status != CaseStatus.PENDING_REREVIEW) {
            throw new DomainStateConflictException("CASE_NOT_PENDING_REREVIEW",
                    "Can only start rereview in PENDING_REREVIEW. Current: " + this.status);
        }
        if (this.rereviewerAssignment == null) {
            throw new DomainRuleViolationException("NO_REREVIEWER_ASSIGNED",
                    "Cannot start rereview: no rereviewer has been assigned");
        }
        Objects.requireNonNull(actorId, "actorId must not be null");
        if (!actorId.equals(this.rereviewerAssignment.getReviewerId())) {
            throw new DomainRuleViolationException("NOT_ASSIGNED_REREVIEWER",
                    "Only the assigned rereviewer can start the rereview");
        }
        this.status = CaseStatus.REREVIEW_IN_PROGRESS;
    }
```
