```java
    public void completeRereview(BigDecimal rereviewScore,
                                  BigDecimal initialWeight,
                                  BigDecimal rereviewWeight) {
        if (this.status != CaseStatus.REREVIEW_IN_PROGRESS) {
            throw new DomainStateConflictException("CASE_NOT_REREVIEW_IN_PROGRESS",
                    "Can only complete rereview in REREVIEW_IN_PROGRESS. Current: " + this.status);
        }
        Objects.requireNonNull(rereviewScore, "rereviewScore must not be null");
        Objects.requireNonNull(initialWeight, "initialWeight must not be null");
        Objects.requireNonNull(rereviewWeight, "rereviewWeight must not be null");
        this.finalScore = this.initialReviewScore.multiply(initialWeight)
                .add(rereviewScore.multiply(rereviewWeight))
                .setScale(2, java.math.RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
        this.closedAt = LocalDateTime.now();
        this.status = CaseStatus.CLOSED;
    }

    public void updateFinalScoreForRereview(BigDecimal newRereviewScore,
                                             BigDecimal initialWeight,
                                             BigDecimal rereviewWeight) {
        requireNotCancelled();
        Objects.requireNonNull(newRereviewScore, "newRereviewScore must not be null");
        this.finalScore = this.initialReviewScore.multiply(initialWeight)
                .add(newRereviewScore.multiply(rereviewWeight))
                .setScale(2, java.math.RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
    }

    private void requireNotCancelled() {
        if (this.status == CaseStatus.CANCELLED) {
            throw new DomainStateConflictException("CASE_CANCELLED",
                    "Operation not allowed on CANCELLED case");
        }
    }
```

package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase;

import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.ActorContext;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.DomainEventPublisher;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase.command.CloseWithoutRereviewCommand;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.DomainRole;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.ResourceNotFoundException;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCase;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCaseRepository;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.event.CaseClosedWithoutRereviewEvent;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class CloseWithoutRereviewUseCase {

    private final ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository;
    private final DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher;

    public CloseWithoutRereviewUseCase(ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository,
                                        DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher) {
        this.caseRepository = caseRepository;
        this.eventPublisher = eventPublisher;
    }

    @Transactional
    public void execute(ActorContext actor, CloseWithoutRereviewCommand cmd) {
        actor.requireRole(DomainRole.HOSPITAL_MANAGER);
        ReviewCase reviewCase = caseRepository.findById(cmd.getCaseId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewCase", cmd.getCaseId()));
        reviewCase.closeWithoutRereview();
        caseRepository.save(reviewCase);
        eventPublisher.publish(new CaseClosedWithoutRereviewEvent(
                this, actor.getUserId(), actor.getUserName(), reviewCase.getHospitalId(),
                reviewCase.getCaseId(),
                String.format("{\"finalScore\":%.2f}", reviewCase.getFinalScore())));
    }
}
```

package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase;

import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.ActorContext;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.DomainEventPublisher;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase.command.SendToRereviewCommand;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.DomainRole;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.ResourceNotFoundException;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCase;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCaseRepository;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.event.CaseEscalatedToRereviewEvent;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class SendToRereviewUseCase {

    private final ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository;
    private final DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher;

    public SendToRereviewUseCase(ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository,
                                  DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher) {
        this.caseRepository = caseRepository;
        this.eventPublisher = eventPublisher;
    }

    @Transactional
    public void execute(ActorContext actor, SendToRereviewCommand cmd) {
        actor.requireRole(DomainRole.HOSPITAL_MANAGER);
        ReviewCase reviewCase = caseRepository.findById(cmd.getCaseId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewCase", cmd.getCaseId()));
        reviewCase.sendToRereview();
        caseRepository.save(reviewCase);
        eventPublisher.publish(new CaseEscalatedToRereviewEvent(
                this, actor.getUserId(), actor.getUserName(), reviewCase.getHospitalId(),
                reviewCase.getCaseId(),
                "{\"trigger\":\"manual\"}"));
    }
}
```

package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase;

import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.ActorContext;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.DomainEventPublisher;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase.command.AssignRereviewerCommand;

import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.ResourceNotFoundException;

import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.event.RereviewerAssignedEvent;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class AssignRereviewerUseCase {

    private final ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository;
    private final DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher;

    public AssignRereviewerUseCase(ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository,
                                    DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher) {
        this.caseRepository = caseRepository;
        this.eventPublisher = eventPublisher;
    }

    @Transactional
    public void execute(ActorContext actor, AssignRereviewerCommand cmd) {
        actor.requireRole(DomainRole.HOSPITAL_MANAGER);
        ReviewCase reviewCase = caseRepository.findById(cmd.getCaseId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewCase", cmd.getCaseId()));
        reviewCase.assignRereviewer(cmd.getRereviewerId(), cmd.getDueAt());
        caseRepository.save(reviewCase);
        eventPublisher.publish(new RereviewerAssignedEvent(
                this, actor.getUserId(), actor.getUserName(), reviewCase.getHospitalId(),
                reviewCase.getCaseId(),
                String.format("{\"rereviewerId\":\"%s\"}", cmd.getRereviewerId())));
    }
}

package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase;

import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.ActorContext;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.DomainEventPublisher;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase.command.StartRereviewCommand;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.DomainRole;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.ResourceNotFoundException;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCase;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCaseRepository;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.event.RereviewStartedEvent;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewSubmission;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewSubmissionRepository;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.util.UUID;

@Service
public class StartRereviewUseCase {

    private final ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository;
    private final ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository;
    private final DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher;

    public StartRereviewUseCase(ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository,
                                 ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository,
                                 DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher) {
        this.caseRepository = caseRepository;
        this.submissionRepository = submissionRepository;
        this.eventPublisher = eventPublisher;
    }

    @Transactional
    public void execute(ActorContext actor, StartRereviewCommand cmd) {
        actor.requireRole(DomainRole.REREVIEWER);
        ReviewCase reviewCase = caseRepository.findById(cmd.getCaseId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewCase", cmd.getCaseId()));
        reviewCase.startRereview(actor.getUserId());
        ReviewSubmission rereviewDraft = ReviewSubmission.createRereviewDraft(
                UUID.randomUUID().toString(), cmd.getCaseId(), actor.getUserId());
        submissionRepository.save(rereviewDraft);
        caseRepository.save(reviewCase);
        eventPublisher.publish(new RereviewStartedEvent(
                this, actor.getUserId(), actor.getUserName(), reviewCase.getHospitalId(),
                reviewCase.getCaseId(),
                String.format("{\"submissionId\":\"%s\"}", rereviewDraft.getSubmissionId())));
    }
}

package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase;

import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.ActorContext;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase.command.SaveDraftCommand;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.DomainRole;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.DomainRuleViolationException;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.ResourceNotFoundException;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCase;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCaseRepository;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewSubmission;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewSubmissionRepository;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class SaveRereviewDraftUseCase {

    private final ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository;
    private final ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository;

    public SaveRereviewDraftUseCase(ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository,
                                     ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository) {
        this.caseRepository = caseRepository;
        this.submissionRepository = submissionRepository;
    }

    @Transactional
    public void execute(ActorContext actor, SaveDraftCommand cmd) {
        actor.requireRole(DomainRole.REREVIEWER);
        ReviewCase reviewCase = caseRepository.findById(cmd.getCaseId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewCase", cmd.getCaseId()));
        if (reviewCase.getRereviewerAssignment() == null
                || !actor.getUserId().equals(reviewCase.getRereviewerAssignment().getReviewerId())) {
            throw new DomainRuleViolationException("NOT_ASSIGNED_REREVIEWER",
                    "Only the assigned rereviewer can save this draft");
        }
        ReviewSubmission submission = submissionRepository.findById(cmd.getSubmissionId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewSubmission", cmd.getSubmissionId()));
        submission.updateDraft(cmd.getAnswers());
        submissionRepository.save(submission);
    }
}

package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase;

import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.ActorContext;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.DomainEventPublisher;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase.command.SubmitRereviewCommand;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.DomainRole;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.DomainRuleViolationException;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.ResourceNotFoundException;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.project.ProjectVersion;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.project.ReviewProject;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.project.ReviewProjectRepository;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCase;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCaseRepository;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.event.RereviewSubmittedEvent;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewSubmission;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewSubmissionRepository;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.scoresheet.ScoreSheetDefinition;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.scoresheet.ScoreSheetRepository;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.math.BigDecimal;

@Service
public class SubmitRereviewUseCase {

    private final ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository;
    private final ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository;
    private final ReviewProjectRepository projectRepository;
    private final ScoreSheetRepository scoreSheetRepository;
    private final DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher;

    public SubmitRereviewUseCase(ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository,
                                  ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository,
                                  ReviewProjectRepository projectRepository,
                                  ScoreSheetRepository scoreSheetRepository,
                                  DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher) {
        this.caseRepository = caseRepository;
        this.submissionRepository = submissionRepository;
        this.projectRepository = projectRepository;
        this.scoreSheetRepository = scoreSheetRepository;
        this.eventPublisher = eventPublisher;
    }

    @Transactional
    public void execute(ActorContext actor, SubmitRereviewCommand cmd) {
        actor.requireRole(DomainRole.REREVIEWER);
        ReviewCase reviewCase = caseRepository.findById(cmd.getCaseId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewCase", cmd.getCaseId()));

        if (reviewCase.getRereviewerAssignment() == null
                || !actor.getUserId().equals(reviewCase.getRereviewerAssignment().getReviewerId())) {
            throw new DomainRuleViolationException("NOT_ASSIGNED_REREVIEWER",
                    "Only the assigned rereviewer can submit this rereview");
        }

        ReviewSubmission submission = submissionRepository.findById(cmd.getSubmissionId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewSubmission", cmd.getSubmissionId()));

        if (cmd.getAnswers() != null) {
            submission.updateDraft(cmd.getAnswers());
        }

        // Load score sheet for scoring
        ScoreSheetDefinition scoreSheet = scoreSheetRepository.findById(reviewCase.getScoreSheetVersionRef())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ScoreSheetDefinition", reviewCase.getScoreSheetVersionRef()));
        var result = scoreSheet.calculateScore(submission.getAnswers());
        submission.submit(result.getTotalScore());
        submissionRepository.save(submission);

        // Load project for weights
        ReviewProject project = projectRepository.findById(reviewCase.getProjectId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewProject", reviewCase.getProjectId()));
        ProjectVersion version = project.getActiveVersion()
                .orElseThrow(() -> new DomainRuleViolationException("NO_ACTIVE_VERSION",
                        "ReviewProject has no active version"));

        reviewCase.completeRereview(
                result.getTotalScore(),
                version.getInitialReviewWeight(),
                version.getRereviewWeight());
        caseRepository.save(reviewCase);

        eventPublisher.publish(new RereviewSubmittedEvent(
                this, actor.getUserId(), actor.getUserName(), reviewCase.getHospitalId(),
                reviewCase.getCaseId(),
                String.format("{\"rereviewScore\":%.2f,\"finalScore\":%.2f}",
                        result.getTotalScore(), reviewCase.getFinalScore())));
    }
}

package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase;

import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.ActorContext;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.DomainEventPublisher;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase.command.ReviseRereviewCommand;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.DomainRole;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.DomainRuleViolationException;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.ResourceNotFoundException;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.project.ProjectVersion;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.project.ReviewProject;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.project.ReviewProjectRepository;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCase;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCaseRepository;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.event.RereviewRevisedEvent;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewSubmission;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewSubmissionRepository;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.scoresheet.ScoreSheetDefinition;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.scoresheet.ScoreSheetRepository;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.util.UUID;

@Service
public class ReviseRereviewUseCase {

    private final ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository;
    private final ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository;
    private final ReviewProjectRepository projectRepository;
    private final ScoreSheetRepository scoreSheetRepository;
    private final DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher;

    public ReviseRereviewUseCase(ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository,
                                  ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository,
                                  ReviewProjectRepository projectRepository,
                                  ScoreSheetRepository scoreSheetRepository,
                                  DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher) {
        this.caseRepository = caseRepository;
        this.submissionRepository = submissionRepository;
        this.projectRepository = projectRepository;
        this.scoreSheetRepository = scoreSheetRepository;
        this.eventPublisher = eventPublisher;
    }

    @Transactional
    public void execute(ActorContext actor, ReviseRereviewCommand cmd) {
        actor.requireRole(DomainRole.REREVIEWER);
        ReviewCase reviewCase = caseRepository.findById(cmd.getCaseId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewCase", cmd.getCaseId()));

        if (reviewCase.getRereviewerAssignment() == null
                || !actor.getUserId().equals(reviewCase.getRereviewerAssignment().getReviewerId())) {
            throw new DomainRuleViolationException("NOT_ASSIGNED_REREVIEWER",
                    "Only the assigned rereviewer can revise this rereview");
        }

        ReviewSubmission oldSubmission = submissionRepository.findById(cmd.getSubmissionId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewSubmission", cmd.getSubmissionId()));

        // Create revision (append-only)
        ReviewSubmission revision = oldSubmission.createRevision(UUID.randomUUID().toString());
        if (cmd.getAnswers() != null) {
            revision.updateDraft(cmd.getAnswers());
        }

        // Score the revision
        ScoreSheetDefinition scoreSheet = scoreSheetRepository.findById(reviewCase.getScoreSheetVersionRef())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ScoreSheetDefinition", reviewCase.getScoreSheetVersionRef()));
        var result = scoreSheet.calculateScore(revision.getAnswers());
        revision.submit(result.getTotalScore());
        submissionRepository.save(revision);

        // Recalculate weighted final score
        ReviewProject project = projectRepository.findById(reviewCase.getProjectId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewProject", reviewCase.getProjectId()));
        ProjectVersion version = project.getActiveVersion()
                .orElseThrow(() -> new DomainRuleViolationException("NO_ACTIVE_VERSION",
                        "ReviewProject has no active version"));

        reviewCase.updateFinalScoreForRereview(
                result.getTotalScore(),
                version.getInitialReviewWeight(),
                version.getRereviewWeight());
        caseRepository.save(reviewCase);

        eventPublisher.publish(new RereviewRevisedEvent(
                this, actor.getUserId(), actor.getUserName(), reviewCase.getHospitalId(),
                reviewCase.getCaseId(),
                String.format("{\"revisionNumber\":%d,\"rereviewScore\":%.2f,\"finalScore\":%.2f}",
                        revision.getRevisionNumber(), result.getTotalScore(), reviewCase.getFinalScore())));
    }
}

package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase;

import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.ActorContext;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase.query.GetRereviewRevisionHistoryQuery;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewStage;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewSubmission;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewSubmissionRepository;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

@Service
@Transactional(readOnly = true)
public class GetRereviewRevisionHistoryUseCase {

    private final ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository;

    public GetRereviewRevisionHistoryUseCase(ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository) {
        this.submissionRepository = submissionRepository;
    }

    public List<ReviewSubmission> execute(ActorContext actor, GetRereviewRevisionHistoryQuery query) {
        // Any authenticated role can query — visibility is enforced at API/UI layer
        return submissionRepository.findByCaseId(query.getCaseId()).stream()
                .filter(s -> s.getStage() == ReviewStage.REREVIEW)
                .sorted((a, b) -> Integer.compare(a.getRevisionNumber(), b.getRevisionNumber()))
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }
}

```java
    // --- B4 Rereview Endpoints ---

    @PostMapping("/{caseId}/close-without-rereview")
    public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<Void>> closeWithoutRereview(
            @PathVariable String caseId,
            @CurrentActor ActorContext actor) {
        CloseWithoutRereviewCommand cmd = new CloseWithoutRereviewCommand();
        cmd.setCaseId(caseId);
        closeWithoutRereviewUseCase.execute(actor, cmd);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.ok(null));
    }

    @PostMapping("/{caseId}/send-to-rereview")
    public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<Void>> sendToRereview(
            @PathVariable String caseId,
            @CurrentActor ActorContext actor) {
        SendToRereviewCommand cmd = new SendToRereviewCommand();
        cmd.setCaseId(caseId);
        sendToRereviewUseCase.execute(actor, cmd);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.ok(null));
    }

    @PostMapping("/{caseId}/assign-rereviewer")
    public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<Void>> assignRereviewer(
            @PathVariable String caseId,
            @RequestBody @Valid AssignRereviewerRequest request,
            @CurrentActor ActorContext actor) {
        AssignRereviewerCommand cmd = new AssignRereviewerCommand();
        cmd.setCaseId(caseId);
        cmd.setRereviewerId(request.getRereviewerId());
        cmd.setDueAt(request.getDueAt());
        assignRereviewerUseCase.execute(actor, cmd);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.ok(null));
    }

    @PostMapping("/{caseId}/reassign-rereviewer")
    public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<Void>> reassignRereviewer(
            @PathVariable String caseId,
            @RequestBody @Valid ReassignRereviewerRequest request,
            @CurrentActor ActorContext actor) {
        ReassignRereviewerCommand cmd = new ReassignRereviewerCommand();
        cmd.setCaseId(caseId);
        cmd.setRereviewerId(request.getRereviewerId());
        cmd.setDueAt(request.getDueAt());
        reassignRereviewerUseCase.execute(actor, cmd);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.ok(null));
    }

    @PostMapping("/{caseId}/start-rereview")
    public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<Void>> startRereview(
            @PathVariable String caseId,
            @CurrentActor ActorContext actor) {
        StartRereviewCommand cmd = new StartRereviewCommand();
        cmd.setCaseId(caseId);
        startRereviewUseCase.execute(actor, cmd);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.ok(null));
    }

    @PutMapping("/{caseId}/rereview-draft")
    public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<Void>> saveRereviewDraft(
            @PathVariable String caseId,
            @RequestBody @Valid SaveDraftCommand cmd,
            @CurrentActor ActorContext actor) {
        cmd.setCaseId(caseId);
        saveRereviewDraftUseCase.execute(actor, cmd);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.ok(null));
    }

    @PostMapping("/{caseId}/submit-rereview")
    public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<Void>> submitRereview(
            @PathVariable String caseId,
            @RequestBody @Valid SubmitRereviewRequest request,
            @CurrentActor ActorContext actor) {
        SubmitRereviewCommand cmd = new SubmitRereviewCommand();
        cmd.setCaseId(caseId);
        cmd.setSubmissionId(request.getSubmissionId());
        cmd.setAnswers(request.getAnswers());
        submitRereviewUseCase.execute(actor, cmd);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.ok(null));
    }

    @PostMapping("/{caseId}/revise-rereview")
    public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<Void>> reviseRereview(
            @PathVariable String caseId,
            @RequestBody @Valid ReviseRereviewRequest request,
            @CurrentActor ActorContext actor) {
        ReviseRereviewCommand cmd = new ReviseRereviewCommand();
        cmd.setCaseId(caseId);
        cmd.setSubmissionId(request.getSubmissionId());
        cmd.setAnswers(request.getAnswers());
        reviseRereviewUseCase.execute(actor, cmd);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.ok(null));
    }

    @GetMapping("/{caseId}/rereview-revisions")
    public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<Object>> getRereviewRevisionHistory(
            @PathVariable String caseId,
            @CurrentActor ActorContext actor) {
        GetRereviewRevisionHistoryQuery query = new GetRereviewRevisionHistoryQuery();
        query.setCaseId(caseId);
        var result = getRereviewRevisionHistoryUseCase.execute(actor, query);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.ok(result));
    }
```

```java
package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.interfaces.rest;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.testfixture.TestTokenFactory;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.autoconfigure.web.servlet.AutoConfigureMockMvc;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.test.annotation.DirtiesContext;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.MockMvc;

import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.*;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockMvcRequestBuilders.*;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.result.MockMvcResultMatchers.*;

@SpringBootTest
@AutoConfigureMockMvc
@DirtiesContext(classMode = DirtiesContext.ClassMode.AFTER_EACH_TEST_METHOD)
class RereviewApiTest {

    @Autowired private MockMvc mockMvc;
    @Autowired private ObjectMapper objectMapper;

    private static final String BASE = "/review-cases";

    // --- Helper: Create project, batch, case, and complete initial review ---
    // (This follows the same pattern as existing InitialReviewApiTest)

    @Test
    void fullRereviewFlow() throws Exception {
        // 1. Setup: create project with threshold, sampling, case
        //    (Use existing setup patterns from InitialReviewApiTest or ReviewCaseApiTest)

        // 2. Complete initial review with score above threshold
        //    → expect status PENDING_REREVIEW

        // 3. Assign rereviewer
        String assignBody = "{\"rereviewerId\":\"rereviewer-1\",\"dueAt\":\"2026-06-30T23:59:00\"}";
        mockMvc.perform(post(BASE + "/{caseId}/assign-rereviewer", "CASE_ID")
                        .header("api-key", TestTokenFactory.hospitalManagerToken())
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .content(assignBody))
                .andExpect(status().isOk());

        // 4. Start rereview (as rereviewer)
        mockMvc.perform(post(BASE + "/{caseId}/start-rereview", "CASE_ID")
                        .header("api-key", TestTokenFactory.rereviewerToken()))
                .andExpect(status().isOk());

        // 5. Submit rereview
        // → expect CLOSED with weighted final score

        // 6. Revise rereview (on CLOSED case — D-021)
        // → expect CLOSED with recalculated final score

        // 7. Get rereview revision history
        mockMvc.perform(get(BASE + "/{caseId}/rereview-revisions", "CASE_ID")
                        .header("api-key", TestTokenFactory.hospitalManagerToken()))
                .andExpect(status().isOk())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.data", hasSize(greaterThanOrEqualTo(2))));
    }

    @Test
    void closeWithoutRereview_happyPath() throws Exception {
        // 1. Setup: case at INITIAL_REVIEW_COMPLETED (score <= threshold or manual)
        // 2. Close without rereview
        mockMvc.perform(post(BASE + "/{caseId}/close-without-rereview", "CASE_ID")
                        .header("api-key", TestTokenFactory.hospitalManagerToken()))
                .andExpect(status().isOk());
    }

    @Test
    void sendToRereview_manualEscalation() throws Exception {
        // 1. Setup: case at INITIAL_REVIEW_COMPLETED
        // 2. Send to rereview
        mockMvc.perform(post(BASE + "/{caseId}/send-to-rereview", "CASE_ID")
                        .header("api-key", TestTokenFactory.hospitalManagerToken()))
                .andExpect(status().isOk());
    }

    @Test
    void assignRereviewer_sameAsInitialReviewer_shouldReturn422() throws Exception {
        // 1. Setup: case at PENDING_REREVIEW, initial reviewer = "reviewer-1"
        // 2. Try to assign "reviewer-1" as rereviewer → 422
        String body = "{\"rereviewerId\":\"reviewer-1\"}";
        mockMvc.perform(post(BASE + "/{caseId}/assign-rereviewer", "CASE_ID")
                        .header("api-key", TestTokenFactory.hospitalManagerToken())
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .content(body))
                .andExpect(status().isUnprocessableEntity());
    }

    @Test
    void startRereview_wrongActor_shouldReturn422() throws Exception {
        // 1. Setup: case at PENDING_REREVIEW with rereviewer-1 assigned
        // 2. Try to start as wrong user → 422
        mockMvc.perform(post(BASE + "/{caseId}/start-rereview", "CASE_ID")
                        .header("api-key", TestTokenFactory.rereviewerToken("wrong-user", "H001")))
                .andExpect(status().isUnprocessableEntity());
    }
}
```

16.

18.

20. 
21.     If you have questions about:

23.     - The approach or implementation strategy
24.     - Dependencies or assumptions
25.     - Anything unclear in the task description
26. 
27.     **Ask them now.** Raise any concerns before starting work.
28. 
29.     ## Your Job
30. 
31.     Once you're clear on requirements:
32.     1. Implement exactly what the task specifies
33.     2. Write tests (following TDD if task says to)
34.     3. Verify implementation works
35.     4. Commit your work
36.     5. Self-review (see below)
37.     6. Report back
38. 
39.     Work from: [directory]
40. 
41.     **While you work:** If you encounter something unexpected or unclear, **ask questions**.
42.     It's always OK to pause and clarify. Don't guess or make assumptions.
43. 
44.     ## Code Organization
45. 
46.     You reason best about code you can hold in context at once, and your edits are more
47.     reliable when files are focused. Keep this in mind:
48.     - Follow the file structure defined in the plan
49.     - Each file should have one clear responsibility with a well-defined interface
50.     - If a file you're creating is growing beyond the plan's intent, stop and report
51.       it as DONE_WITH_CONCERNS — don't split files on your own without plan guidance
52.     - If an existing file you're modifying is already large or tangled, work carefully
53.       and note it as a concern in your report
54.     - In existing codebases, follow established patterns. Improve code you're touching
55.       the way a good developer would, but don't restructure things outside your task.
56. 
57.     ## When You're in Over Your Head
58. 
59.     It is always OK to stop and say "this is too hard for me." Bad work is worse than
60.     no work. You will not be penalized for escalating.
61. 
62.     **STOP and escalate when:**
63.     - The task requires architectural decisions with multiple valid approaches
64.     - You need to understand code beyond what was provided and can't find clarity
65.     - You feel uncertain about whether your approach is correct
66.     - The task involves restructuring existing code in ways the plan didn't anticipate
67.     - You've been reading file after file trying to understand the system without progress
68. 
69.     **How to escalate:** Report back with status BLOCKED or NEEDS_CONTEXT. Describe
70.     specifically what you're stuck on, what you've tried, and what kind of help you need.
71.     The controller can provide more context, re-dispatch with a more capable model,
72.     or break the task into smaller pieces.
73. 
74.     ## Before Reporting Back: Self-Review

80.     - Did I miss any requirements?
81.     - Are there edge cases I didn't handle?
82. 
83.     **Quality:**

85.     - Are names clear and accurate (match what things do, not how they work)?
86.     - Is the code clean and maintainable?
87. 
88.     **Discipline:**
89.     - Did I avoid overbuilding (YAGNI)?
90.     - Did I only build what was requested?
91.     - Did I follow existing patterns in the codebase?
92. 
93.     **Testing:**
94.     - Do tests actually verify behavior (not just mock behavior)?
95.     - Did I follow TDD if required?
96.     - Are tests comprehensive?
97. 
98.     If you find issues during self-review, fix them now before reporting.
99. 
100.     ## Report Format
101.

13.     ## What Was Requested
14. 
15.     [FULL TEXT of task requirements]
16. 
17.     ## What Implementer Claims They Built
18. 
19.     [From implementer's report]
20. 
21.     ## CRITICAL: Do Not Trust the Report
22. 
23.     The implementer finished suspiciously quickly. Their report may be incomplete,
24.     inaccurate, or optimistic. You MUST verify everything independently.
25. 
26.     **DO NOT:**
27.     - Take their word for what they implemented
28.     - Trust their claims about completeness
29.     - Accept their interpretation of requirements
30. 
31.     **DO:**
32.     - Read the actual code they wrote
33.     - Compare actual implementation to requirements line by line
34.     - Check for missing pieces they claimed to implement
35.     - Look for extra features they didn't mention
36. 
37.     ## Your Job
38. 
39.     Read the implementation code and verify:
40. 
41.     **Missing requirements:**
42.     - Did they implement everything that was requested?
43.     - Are there requirements they skipped or missed?
44.     - Did they claim something works but didn't actually implement it?
45. 
46.     **Extra/unneeded work:**
47.     - Did they build things that weren't requested?
48.     - Did they over-engineer or add unnecessary features?
49.     - Did they add "nice to haves" that weren't in spec?
50. 
51.     **Misunderstandings:**
52.     - Did they interpret requirements differently than intended?
53.     - Did they solve the wrong problem?
54.     - Did they implement the right feature but wrong way?
55. 
56.     **Verify by reading code, not by trusting report.**
57. 
58.     Report:
59.     - ✅ Spec compliant (if everything matches after code inspection)
60.     - ❌ Issues found: [list specifically what's missing or extra, with file:line references]
61. ```

115. 
116. **Modify D-001:**
117. > - **Before:** Results in CLOSED status cannot be revised.
118. > - **After:** CLOSED cases cannot be reopened or have state transitions. However, **rereview revision** (append-only score correction) is allowed on CLOSED cases because: (1) revision does not change case state, (2) revision is not reopen, (3) case remains CLOSED, (4) only finalScore is recalculated. Initial review revision on CLOSED cases remains prohibited.
119. 
120. **Modify D-012:**
121. > - **Before:** Final score set by re-reviewer.
122. > - **After:** Final score = weighted average of initial review score and re-review score. Default weight 50/50, configurable per ProjectVersion.
123. 
124. **Add D-017:** Re-reviewer must not be the same person as the initial reviewer for the same case.
125. 
126. **Add D-018:** Re-reviewer cannot see initial review answers or scores during re-review (independent evaluation).
127. 
128. **Add D-019:** Threshold auto-evaluation: when initial score > quality threshold → auto PENDING_REREVIEW. When score ≤ threshold or threshold is null, case stays at INITIAL_REVIEW_COMPLETED; HOSPITAL_MANAGER may manually close or send to re-review.
129. 
130. **Add D-020:** Scoring weight (initialReviewWeight, rereviewWeight) is stored in ProjectVersion, default 0.5/0.5. Invariant: initialReviewWeight + rereviewWeight = 1.0, both > 0 and ≤ 1.
131. 
132. **Add D-021:** Rereview revision is allowed on CLOSED cases (exception to terminal state no-revision rule). Rationale: rereview submission auto-closes the case, so the only window for rereview revision is after CLOSED. This is safe because revision is append-only and does not change case lifecycle state.

255. package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.project;
256. 
257. import java.math.BigDecimal;
258. import java.util.Objects;
259. 
260. /**
261.  * Immutable version snapshot for a ReviewProject.
262.  * Carries scoring configuration: qualityThreshold and review weights.
263.  */
264. public class ProjectVersion {
265. 
266.     private static final BigDecimal DEFAULT_WEIGHT = new BigDecimal("0.5");
267. 
268.     private final int versionNumber;
269.     private final boolean published;
270.     private final BigDecimal qualityThreshold;
271.     private final BigDecimal initialReviewWeight;
272.     private final BigDecimal rereviewWeight;
273. 
274.     public ProjectVersion(int versionNumber, boolean published) {
275.         this(versionNumber, published, null, DEFAULT_WEIGHT, DEFAULT_WEIGHT);
276.     }
277. 
278.     public ProjectVersion(int versionNumber, boolean published,
279.                           BigDecimal qualityThreshold,
280.                           BigDecimal initialReviewWeight,
281.                           BigDecimal rereviewWeight) {
282.         if (versionNumber < 1) {
283.             throw new IllegalArgumentException("Version number must be >= 1");
284.         }
285.         this.versionNumber = versionNumber;
286.         this.published = published;
287.         this.qualityThreshold = qualityThreshold;
288.         this.initialReviewWeight = initialReviewWeight != null ? initialReviewWeight : DEFAULT_WEIGHT;
289.         this.rereviewWeight = rereviewWeight != null ? rereviewWeight : DEFAULT_WEIGHT;
290.     }
291. 
292.     /**
293.      * Validate that weights sum to 1.0 and each is > 0 and <= 1.
294.      * Called before publishing a version.
295.      */
296.     public void validateWeightsForPublish() {
297.         if (initialReviewWeight.compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) <= 0
298.                 || initialReviewWeight.compareTo(BigDecimal.ONE) > 0) {
299.             throw new IllegalArgumentException(
300.                     "initialReviewWeight must be > 0 and <= 1, got: " + initialReviewWeight);
301.         }
302.         if (rereviewWeight.compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) <= 0
303.                 || rereviewWeight.compareTo(BigDecimal.ONE) > 0) {
304.             throw new IllegalArgumentException(
305.                     "rereviewWeight must be > 0 and <= 1, got: " + rereviewWeight);
306.         }
307.         if (initialReviewWeight.add(rereviewWeight).compareTo(BigDecimal.ONE) != 0) {
308.             throw new IllegalArgumentException(
309.                     "Weights must sum to 1.0, got: " + initialReviewWeight + " + " + rereviewWeight);
310.         }
311.     }
312. 
313.     public int getVersionNumber() { return versionNumber; }
314.     public boolean isPublished() { return published; }
315.     public BigDecimal getQualityThreshold() { return qualityThreshold; }
316.     public BigDecimal getInitialReviewWeight() { return initialReviewWeight; }
317.     public BigDecimal getRereviewWeight() { return rereviewWeight; }
318. 
319.     public ProjectVersion publish() {
320.         return new ProjectVersion(this.versionNumber, true,
321.                 this.qualityThreshold, this.initialReviewWeight, this.rereviewWeight);
322.     }
323. 
324.     public ProjectVersion nextDraft() {
325.         return new ProjectVersion(this.versionNumber + 1, false,
326.                 this.qualityThreshold, this.initialReviewWeight, this.rereviewWeight);
327.     }
328. 
329.     @Override
330.     public boolean equals(Object o) {
331.         if (this == o) return true;
332.         if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
333.         ProjectVersion that = (ProjectVersion) o;
334.         return versionNumber == that.versionNumber && published == that.published;
335.     }
336. 
337.     @Override
338.     public int hashCode() {
339.         return Objects.hash(versionNumber, published);
340.     }
341. 
342.     @Override
343.     public String toString() {
344.         return "v" + versionNumber + (published ? " (published)" : " (draft)");
345.     }
346. }
347. ```

### What was implemented:

I successfully updated the decision-log.md with B4 (Re-review Operations) decisions. All required modifications were completed:

#### 1. **Modified D-001: 結案後不允許 revision（修訂 - B4）**
   - Clarified that CLOSED cases cannot have state transitions or reopens
   - Added exception: **rereview revision (score correction) IS allowed on CLOSED cases**
   - Rationale: revision doesn't change state, is append-only, and constitutes the final opportunity to correct scores after auto-close
   - Initial review revision on CLOSED cases remains prohibited

#### 2. **Modified D-012: 複審最終分數（修訂 - B4）**
   - Changed from "final score determined solely by re-reviewer"
   - To: **Final score = weighted average of initial + rereview scores**
   - Default weights: 50/50 (configurable per ProjectVersion)
   - Formula: `finalScore = initialReviewScore × initialReviewWeight + rereviewScore × rereviewWeight`
   - Weights locked at version publish time

#### 3. **Added D-017: 複審醫師不可為同案的初審醫師**
   - Re-reviewer must be different from initial reviewer
   - Ensures independent evaluation and prevents self-review

#### 4. **Added D-018: 複審期間複審醫師看不到初審答案與分數**
   - Re-reviewer sees blind evaluation (no initial review answers/scores during rereview)
   - Can view initial content after rereview submission completes
   - Ensures unbiased independent assessment

#### 5. **Added D-019: 自動閾值評估與自動進入複審**
   - Auto-escalation: if initialReviewScore > quality_threshold → auto-transition to `PENDING_REREVIEW`
   - Otherwise: transition to `INITIAL_REVIEW_COMPLETED` with manual options (close or send to rereview)

#### 6. **Added D-020: 計分權重與不變性**
   - Scoring weights stored in ProjectVersion: `initialReviewWeight`, `rereviewWeight`
   - Default: 0.5 / 0.5
   - Constraint: weights must sum to 1.0, both > 0 and ≤ 1.0
   - Immutable after version publish (prevents retroactive score changes)

#### 7. **Added D-021: 複審 Revision 允許在 CLOSED 案件上（D-001 例外）**
   - Rereview revision explicitly allowed on CLOSED cases (exception to D-001)
   - Rationale: rereview auto-closes, so post-close revision is the only correction window
   - Still append-only, doesn't change lifecycle state
   - Automatically recalculates finalScore per D-020 formula

57.     ## When You're in Over Your Head

```java
package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.project;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Immutable version snapshot for a ReviewProject.
 * Carries scoring configuration: qualityThreshold and review weights.
 */
public class ProjectVersion {

    private static final BigDecimal DEFAULT_WEIGHT = new BigDecimal("0.5");

    private final int versionNumber;
    private final boolean published;
    private final BigDecimal qualityThreshold;
    private final BigDecimal initialReviewWeight;
    private final BigDecimal rereviewWeight;

    public ProjectVersion(int versionNumber, boolean published) {
        this(versionNumber, published, null, DEFAULT_WEIGHT, DEFAULT_WEIGHT);
    }

    public ProjectVersion(int versionNumber, boolean published,
                          BigDecimal qualityThreshold,
                          BigDecimal initialReviewWeight,
                          BigDecimal rereviewWeight) {
        if (versionNumber < 1) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Version number must be >= 1");
        }
        this.versionNumber = versionNumber;
        this.published = published;
        this.qualityThreshold = qualityThreshold;
        this.initialReviewWeight = initialReviewWeight != null ? initialReviewWeight : DEFAULT_WEIGHT;
        this.rereviewWeight = rereviewWeight != null ? rereviewWeight : DEFAULT_WEIGHT;
    }

    /**
     * Validate that weights sum to 1.0 and each is > 0 and <= 1.
     * Called before publishing a version.
     */
    public void validateWeightsForPublish() {
        if (initialReviewWeight.compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) <= 0
                || initialReviewWeight.compareTo(BigDecimal.ONE) > 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "initialReviewWeight must be > 0 and <= 1, got: " + initialReviewWeight);
        }
        if (rereviewWeight.compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) <= 0
                || rereviewWeight.compareTo(BigDecimal.ONE) > 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "rereviewWeight must be > 0 and <= 1, got: " + rereviewWeight);
        }
        if (initialReviewWeight.add(rereviewWeight).compareTo(BigDecimal.ONE) != 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Weights must sum to 1.0, got: " + initialReviewWeight + " + " + rereviewWeight);
        }
    }

    public int getVersionNumber() { return versionNumber; }
    public boolean isPublished() { return published; }
    public BigDecimal getQualityThreshold() { return qualityThreshold; }
    public BigDecimal getInitialReviewWeight() { return initialReviewWeight; }
    public BigDecimal getRereviewWeight() { return rereviewWeight; }

    public ProjectVersion publish() {
        return new ProjectVersion(this.versionNumber, true,
                this.qualityThreshold, this.initialReviewWeight, this.rereviewWeight);
    }

    public ProjectVersion nextDraft() {
        return new ProjectVersion(this.versionNumber + 1, false,
                this.qualityThreshold, this.initialReviewWeight, this.rereviewWeight);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object o) {
        if (this == o) return true;
        if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
        ProjectVersion that = (ProjectVersion) o;
        return versionNumber == that.versionNumber && published == that.published;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hash(versionNumber, published);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "v" + versionNumber + (published ? " (published)" : " (draft)");
    }
}
```

    @ElementCollection(fetch = FetchType.EAGER)

            joinColumns = @JoinColumn(name = "project_id"))
    @Column(name = "record_type")
    private Set<String> medicalRecordTypes;

    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)

### ReviewProjectRepositoryImpl.java (full file):
```java
package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.infrastructure.persistence.project;

import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.MedicalRecordType;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.project.ReviewProject;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.project.ReviewProjectRepository;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;

import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

@Repository
public class ReviewProjectRepositoryImpl implements ReviewProjectRepository {

    private final ReviewProjectJpaRepository jpa;

    public ReviewProjectRepositoryImpl(ReviewProjectJpaRepository jpa) {
        this.jpa = jpa;
    }

    @Override
    public void save(ReviewProject project) {
        ReviewProjectEntity entity = toEntity(project);
        jpa.save(entity);
    }

    @Override
    public Optional<ReviewProject> findById(String projectId) {
        return jpa.findById(projectId).map(this::toDomain);
    }

    private ReviewProjectEntity toEntity(ReviewProject project) {
        ReviewProjectEntity e = new ReviewProjectEntity();
        e.setProjectId(project.getProjectId());
        e.setHospitalId(project.getHospitalId());
        e.setName(project.getName());
        e.setDescription(project.getDescription());
        e.setBoundScoreSheetId(project.getBoundScoreSheetId());
        e.setMedicalRecordTypes(
                project.getMedicalRecordTypes().stream()
                        .map(Enum::name)
                        .collect(Collectors.toSet())
        );
        e.setStatus(project.getStatus());
        e.setVersionNumber(project.getCurrentVersion().getVersionNumber());
        e.setVersionPublished(project.getCurrentVersion().isPublished());
        return e;
    }

    private ReviewProject toDomain(ReviewProjectEntity e) {
        Set<MedicalRecordType> types = e.getMedicalRecordTypes().stream()
                .map(MedicalRecordType::valueOf)
                .collect(Collectors.toSet());
        return ReviewProject.reconstitute(
                e.getProjectId(),
                e.getHospitalId(),
                e.getName(),
                e.getDescription(),
                e.getBoundScoreSheetId(),
                types,
                e.getStatus(),
                e.getVersionNumber(),
                e.isVersionPublished()
        );
    }
}
```

126.             throw new DomainStateConflictException("CASE_TERMINAL",
127.                     "Cannot cancel: case is in terminal status " + this.status);
128.         }
129.         Objects.requireNonNull(reason, "cancel reason must not be null");
130.         this.cancelReason = reason;
131.         this.cancelledAt = LocalDateTime.now();
132.         this.status = CaseStatus.CANCELLED;
133.     }
134. 
135.     public void returnToInitialReview(String reason) {
136.         if (this.status != CaseStatus.INITIAL_REVIEW_IN_PROGRESS) {
137.             throw new DomainStateConflictException("CASE_NOT_IN_PROGRESS",
138.                     "Cannot return: case status is " + this.status);
139.         }
140.         Objects.requireNonNull(reason, "return reason must not be null");
141.         this.returnReason = reason;
142.         this.status = CaseStatus.RETURNED;
143.     }
144. 
145.     public void reopenInitialReview() {
146.         if (this.status != CaseStatus.RETURNED) {
147.             throw new DomainStateConflictException("CASE_NOT_RETURNED",
148.                     "Cannot reopen: case status is " + this.status);
149.         }
150.         this.returnReason = null;
151.         this.status = CaseStatus.PENDING_INITIAL_REVIEW;
152.     }
153. 
154.     // --- B3b Domain Methods ---
155. 
156.     public void startInitialReview(String submissionId, String scoreSheetVersionRef) {
157.         if (this.status != CaseStatus.PENDING_INITIAL_REVIEW) {
158.             throw new DomainStateConflictException("CASE_NOT_PENDING_INITIAL_REVIEW",
159.                     "Case must be in PENDING_INITIAL_REVIEW to start. Current: " + this.status);
160.         }
161.         Objects.requireNonNull(submissionId, "submissionId must not be null");
162.         Objects.requireNonNull(scoreSheetVersionRef, "scoreSheetVersionRef must not be null");
163.         this.latestInitialSubmissionId = submissionId;
164.         this.scoreSheetVersionRef = scoreSheetVersionRef;
165.         this.status = CaseStatus.INITIAL_REVIEW_IN_PROGRESS;
166.     }
167. 
168.     public void completeInitialReview(BigDecimal totalScore) {
169.         if (this.status != CaseStatus.INITIAL_REVIEW_IN_PROGRESS) {
170.             throw new DomainStateConflictException("CASE_NOT_IN_INITIAL_REVIEW",
171.                     "Case must be in INITIAL_REVIEW_IN_PROGRESS to complete. Current: " + this.status);
172.         }
173.         Objects.requireNonNull(totalScore, "totalScore must not be null");
174.         this.finalScore = totalScore;
175.         this.status = CaseStatus.INITIAL_REVIEW_COMPLETED;
176.     }
177. 
178.     /**
179.      * Guard: reject operations on terminal cases (CLOSED or CANCELLED).
180.      */
181.     public void requireNotTerminal() {
182.         if (this.status == CaseStatus.CLOSED || this.status == CaseStatus.CANCELLED) {
183.             throw new DomainStateConflictException("CASE_TERMINAL",
184.                     "Case is in terminal status: " + this.status + ". Revision not allowed.");
185.         }
186.     }

192.         requireNotTerminal();
193.         Objects.requireNonNull(newScore, "newScore must not be null");
194.         this.finalScore = newScore;
195.     }

CaseStatus.PENDING_REREVIEW already exists in the enum (added in B3).

    // --- B4 Domain Methods ---

    public void closeWithoutRereview() {
        if (this.status != CaseStatus.INITIAL_REVIEW_COMPLETED) {
            throw new DomainStateConflictException("CASE_NOT_INITIAL_REVIEW_COMPLETED",
                    "Can only close-without-rereview from INITIAL_REVIEW_COMPLETED. Current: " + this.status);
        }
        this.finalScore = this.initialReviewScore;
        this.closedAt = LocalDateTime.now();
        this.status = CaseStatus.CLOSED;
    }

    public void sendToRereview() {
        if (this.status != CaseStatus.INITIAL_REVIEW_COMPLETED) {
            throw new DomainStateConflictException("CASE_NOT_INITIAL_REVIEW_COMPLETED",
                    "Can only send-to-rereview from INITIAL_REVIEW_COMPLETED. Current: " + this.status);
        }
        this.status = CaseStatus.PENDING_REREVIEW;
    }

                    "Can only assign rereviewer in PENDING_REREVIEW. Current: " + this.status);
        }
        Objects.requireNonNull(rereviewerId, "rereviewerId must not be null");
        if (this.reviewerAssignment != null
                && rereviewerId.equals(this.reviewerAssignment.getReviewerId())) {
            throw new DomainRuleViolationException("REREVIEWER_SAME_AS_REVIEWER",
                    "Re-reviewer must not be the same person as the initial reviewer (D-017)");
        }
        this.rereviewerAssignment = new ReviewerAssignment(rereviewerId, LocalDateTime.now());
        this.rereviewerDueAt = dueAt;
    }

    public void reassignRereviewer(String rereviewerId, LocalDateTime dueAt) {
        if (this.status != CaseStatus.PENDING_REREVIEW) {
            throw new DomainStateConflictException("CASE_NOT_PENDING_REREVIEW",
                    "Can only reassign rereviewer in PENDING_REREVIEW. Current: " + this.status);
        }
        Objects.requireNonNull(rereviewerId, "rereviewerId must not be null");
        if (this.reviewerAssignment != null
                && rereviewerId.equals(this.reviewerAssignment.getReviewerId())) {
            throw new DomainRuleViolationException("REREVIEWER_SAME_AS_REVIEWER",
                    "Re-reviewer must not be the same person as the initial reviewer (D-017)");
        }
        this.rereviewerAssignment = new ReviewerAssignment(rereviewerId, LocalDateTime.now());
        this.rereviewerDueAt = dueAt;
    }

    public void startRereview(String actorId) {
        if (this.status != CaseStatus.PENDING_REREVIEW) {
            throw new DomainStateConflictException("CASE_NOT_PENDING_REREVIEW",
                    "Can only start rereview in PENDING_REREVIEW. Current: " + this.status);
        }
        if (this.rereviewerAssignment == null) {
            throw new DomainRuleViolationException("NO_REREVIEWER_ASSIGNED",
                    "Cannot start rereview: no rereviewer has been assigned");
        }
        Objects.requireNonNull(actorId, "actorId must not be null");
        if (!actorId.equals(this.rereviewerAssignment.getReviewerId())) {
            throw new DomainRuleViolationException("NOT_ASSIGNED_REREVIEWER",
                    "Only the assigned rereviewer can start the rereview");
        }
        this.status = CaseStatus.REREVIEW_IN_PROGRESS;
    }
```

203.         this.status = CaseStatus.CLOSED;
204.     }
205. 
206.     public void sendToRereview() {
207.         if (this.status != CaseStatus.INITIAL_REVIEW_COMPLETED) {
208.             throw new DomainStateConflictException("CASE_NOT_INITIAL_REVIEW_COMPLETED",
209.                     "Can only send-to-rereview from INITIAL_REVIEW_COMPLETED. Current: " + this.status);
210.         }
211.         this.status = CaseStatus.PENDING_REREVIEW;
212.     }
213. 
214.     public void assignRereviewer(String rereviewerId, LocalDateTime dueAt) {
215.         if (this.status != CaseStatus.PENDING_REREVIEW) {
216.             throw new DomainStateConflictException("CASE_NOT_PENDING_REREVIEW",
217.                     "Can only assign rereviewer in PENDING_REREVIEW. Current: " + this.status);
218.         }
219.         Objects.requireNonNull(rereviewerId, "rereviewerId must not be null");
220.         if (this.reviewerAssignment != null
221.                 && rereviewerId.equals(this.reviewerAssignment.getReviewerId())) {
222.             throw new DomainRuleViolationException("REREVIEWER_SAME_AS_REVIEWER",
223.                     "Re-reviewer must not be the same person as the initial reviewer (D-017)");
224.         }
225.         this.rereviewerAssignment = new ReviewerAssignment(rereviewerId, LocalDateTime.now());
226.         this.rereviewerDueAt = dueAt;
227.     }
228. 
229.     public void reassignRereviewer(String rereviewerId, LocalDateTime dueAt) {
230.         if (this.status != CaseStatus.PENDING_REREVIEW) {
231.             throw new DomainStateConflictException("CASE_NOT_PENDING_REREVIEW",
232.                     "Can only reassign rereviewer in PENDING_REREVIEW. Current: " + this.status);
233.         }
234.         Objects.requireNonNull(rereviewerId, "rereviewerId must not be null");
235.         if (this.reviewerAssignment != null
236.                 && rereviewerId.equals(this.reviewerAssignment.getReviewerId())) {
237.             throw new DomainRuleViolationException("REREVIEWER_SAME_AS_REVIEWER",
238.                     "Re-reviewer must not be the same person as the initial reviewer (D-017)");
239.         }
240.         this.rereviewerAssignment = new ReviewerAssignment(rereviewerId, LocalDateTime.now());
241.         this.rereviewerDueAt = dueAt;
242.     }
243. 
244.     public void startRereview(String actorId) {
245.         if (this.status != CaseStatus.PENDING_REREVIEW) {
246.             throw new DomainStateConflictException("CASE_NOT_PENDING_REREVIEW",
247.                     "Can only start rereview in PENDING_REREVIEW. Current: " + this.status);
248.         }
249.         if (this.rereviewerAssignment == null) {
250.             throw new DomainRuleViolationException("NO_REREVIEWER_ASSIGNED",
251.                     "Cannot start rereview: no rereviewer has been assigned");
252.         }
253.         Objects.requireNonNull(actorId, "actorId must not be null");
254.         if (!actorId.equals(this.rereviewerAssignment.getReviewerId())) {
255.             throw new DomainRuleViolationException("NOT_ASSIGNED_REREVIEWER",
256.                     "Only the assigned rereviewer can start the rereview");
257.         }
258.         this.status = CaseStatus.REREVIEW_IN_PROGRESS;
259.     }
260. 
261.     /**
262.      * Guard: reject operations on terminal cases (CLOSED or CANCELLED).
263.      */
264.     public void requireNotTerminal() {
265.         if (this.status == CaseStatus.CLOSED || this.status == CaseStatus.CANCELLED) {
266.             throw new DomainStateConflictException("CASE_TERMINAL",
267.                     "Case is in terminal status: " + this.status + ". Revision not allowed.");
268.         }
269.     }
270. 
271.     /**
272.      * Update finalScore after a revision. Does not change case status.
273.      */
274.     public void updateFinalScore(BigDecimal newScore) {
275.         requireNotTerminal();
276.         Objects.requireNonNull(newScore, "newScore must not be null");
277.         this.initialReviewScore = newScore;
278.         this.finalScore = newScore;
279.     }

287.     }

1. package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission;
2. 
3. import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.DomainStateConflictException;
4. 
5. import java.math.BigDecimal;
6. import java.time.LocalDateTime;
7. import java.util.ArrayList;
8. import java.util.Collections;
9. import java.util.List;
10. import java.util.Objects;
11. 
12. /**
13.  * Aggregate root for a review submission.
14.  * B3a: shell with getters only.
15.  * B3b: full business methods — createDraft, updateDraft, submit.
16.  */
17. public class ReviewSubmission {
18. 
19.     private String submissionId;
20.     private String caseId;
21.     private ReviewStage stage;
22.     private String reviewerId;
23.     private SubmissionStatus status;
24.     private int revisionNo;
25.     private List<AnswerItem> answerSet;
26.     private BigDecimal totalScore;
27.     private String comment;
28.     private LocalDateTime submittedAt;
29.     private String basedOnScoreSheetVersionId;
30.     private String supersededBySubmissionId;
31.     private String attachmentRefsJson;
32.     private LocalDateTime createdAt;
33.     private LocalDateTime updatedAt;
34. 
35.     protected ReviewSubmission() {
36.         // for persistence / reconstitution
37.     }
38. 
39.     /**
40.      * Create an initial review draft submission.
41.      * Called by StartInitialReviewUseCase.
42.      */
43.     public static ReviewSubmission createInitialDraft(
44.             String submissionId, String caseId, String reviewerId,
45.             String scoreSheetVersionId) {
46.         Objects.requireNonNull(submissionId, "submissionId must not be null");
47.         Objects.requireNonNull(caseId, "caseId must not be null");
48.         Objects.requireNonNull(reviewerId, "reviewerId must not be null");
49.         Objects.requireNonNull(scoreSheetVersionId, "scoreSheetVersionId must not be null");
50. 
51.         ReviewSubmission sub = new ReviewSubmission();
52.         sub.submissionId = submissionId;
53.         sub.caseId = caseId;
54.         sub.stage = ReviewStage.INITIAL;
55.         sub.reviewerId = reviewerId;
56.         sub.status = SubmissionStatus.DRAFT;
57.         sub.revisionNo = 1;
58.         sub.answerSet = new ArrayList<>();
59.         sub.totalScore = BigDecimal.ZERO;
60.         sub.basedOnScoreSheetVersionId = scoreSheetVersionId;
61.         sub.createdAt = LocalDateTime.now();
62.         sub.updatedAt = sub.createdAt;
63.         return sub;
64.     }
65. 
66.     /**
67.      * Reconstitute from persistence. No business validation.
68.      */
69.     public static ReviewSubmission reconstitute(
70.             String submissionId, String caseId, ReviewStage stage,
71.             String reviewerId, SubmissionStatus status, int revisionNo,
72.             List<AnswerItem> answerSet, BigDecimal totalScore,
73.             String comment, LocalDateTime submittedAt,
74.             String basedOnScoreSheetVersionId,
75.             String supersededBySubmissionId,
76.             String attachmentRefsJson,
77.             LocalDateTime createdAt, LocalDateTime updatedAt) {
78.         ReviewSubmission sub = new ReviewSubmission();
79.         sub.submissionId = submissionId;
80.         sub.caseId = caseId;
81.         sub.stage = stage;
82.         sub.reviewerId = reviewerId;
83.         sub.status = status;
84.         sub.revisionNo = revisionNo;
85.         sub.answerSet = answerSet != null ? new ArrayList<>(answerSet) : new ArrayList<>();
86.         sub.totalScore = totalScore;
87.         sub.comment = comment;
88.         sub.submittedAt = submittedAt;
89.         sub.basedOnScoreSheetVersionId = basedOnScoreSheetVersionId;
90.         sub.supersededBySubmissionId = supersededBySubmissionId;
91.         sub.attachmentRefsJson = attachmentRefsJson;
92.         sub.createdAt = createdAt;
93.         sub.updatedAt = updatedAt;
94.         return sub;
95.     }
96. 
97.     /**
98.      * Update draft answers and score. Can be called multiple times while in DRAFT.
99.      */
100.     public void updateDraft(List<AnswerItem> scoredAnswers, BigDecimal totalScore, String comment) {
101.         requireDraft();
102.         Objects.requireNonNull(scoredAnswers, "scoredAnswers must not be null");
103.         Objects.requireNonNull(totalScore, "totalScore must not be null");
104.         this.answerSet = new ArrayList<>(scoredAnswers);
105.         this.totalScore = totalScore;
106.         this.comment = comment;
107.         this.updatedAt = LocalDateTime.now();
108.     }
109. 
110.     /**
111.      * Submit this draft. Transitions DRAFT → SUBMITTED. Irreversible.
112.      */
113.     public void submit() {
114.         requireDraft();
115.         this.status = SubmissionStatus.SUBMITTED;
116.         this.submittedAt = LocalDateTime.now();
117.         this.updatedAt = LocalDateTime.now();
118.     }
119. 
120.     /**
121.      * Create a revision from an existing SUBMITTED submission.
122.      * The new submission is directly SUBMITTED (no DRAFT phase for revisions).
123.      */
124.     public static ReviewSubmission createRevision(
125.             String newSubmissionId,
126.             ReviewSubmission oldSubmission,
127.             List<AnswerItem> scoredAnswers,
128.             BigDecimal totalScore,
129.             String comment) {
130.         Objects.requireNonNull(newSubmissionId, "newSubmissionId must not be null");
131.         Objects.requireNonNull(oldSubmission, "oldSubmission must not be null");
132.         Objects.requireNonNull(scoredAnswers, "scoredAnswers must not be null");
133.         Objects.requireNonNull(totalScore, "totalScore must not be null");
134. 
135.         if (oldSubmission.status != SubmissionStatus.SUBMITTED) {
136.             throw new DomainStateConflictException("SUBMISSION_NOT_SUBMITTED",
137.                     "Can only revise a SUBMITTED submission. Current: " + oldSubmission.status);
138.         }
139. 
140.         ReviewSubmission rev = new ReviewSubmission();
141.         rev.submissionId = newSubmissionId;
142.         rev.caseId = oldSubmission.caseId;
143.         rev.stage = oldSubmission.stage;
144.         rev.reviewerId = oldSubmission.reviewerId;
145.         rev.status = SubmissionStatus.SUBMITTED;
146.         rev.revisionNo = oldSubmission.revisionNo + 1;
147.         rev.answerSet = new ArrayList<>(scoredAnswers);
148.         rev.totalScore = totalScore;
149.         rev.comment = comment;
150.         rev.submittedAt = LocalDateTime.now();
151.         rev.basedOnScoreSheetVersionId = oldSubmission.basedOnScoreSheetVersionId;
152.         rev.createdAt = LocalDateTime.now();
153.         rev.updatedAt = rev.createdAt;
154.         return rev;
155.     }
156. 
157.     /**
158.      * Mark this submission as SUPERSEDED by a newer revision.
159.      * Only SUBMITTED submissions can be superseded.
160.      */
161.     public void markSuperseded(String newSubmissionId) {
162.         if (this.status != SubmissionStatus.SUBMITTED) {
163.             throw new DomainStateConflictException("SUBMISSION_NOT_SUBMITTED",
164.                     "Can only supersede a SUBMITTED submission. Current: " + this.status);
165.         }
166.         Objects.requireNonNull(newSubmissionId, "newSubmissionId must not be null");
167.         this.supersededBySubmissionId = newSubmissionId;
168.         this.status = SubmissionStatus.SUPERSEDED;
169.         this.updatedAt = LocalDateTime.now();
170.     }
171. 
172.     private void requireDraft() {
173.         if (this.status != SubmissionStatus.DRAFT) {
174.             throw new DomainStateConflictException("SUBMISSION_NOT_DRAFT",
175.                     "Submission must be in DRAFT status. Current: " + this.status);
176.         }
177.     }
178.

182.     public String getCaseId() { return caseId; }
183.     public ReviewStage getStage() { return stage; }
184.     public String getReviewerId() { return reviewerId; }
185.     public SubmissionStatus getStatus() { return status; }
186.     public int getRevisionNo() { return revisionNo; }
187.     public List<AnswerItem> getAnswerSet() { return Collections.unmodifiableList(answerSet != null ? answerSet : Collections.emptyList()); }
188.     public BigDecimal getTotalScore() { return totalScore; }
189.     public String getComment() { return comment; }
190.     public LocalDateTime getSubmittedAt() { return submittedAt; }
191.     public String getBasedOnScoreSheetVersionId() { return basedOnScoreSheetVersionId; }
192.     public String getSupersededBySubmissionId() { return supersededBySubmissionId; }
193.     public String getAttachmentRefsJson() { return attachmentRefsJson; }
194.     public LocalDateTime getCreatedAt() { return createdAt; }
195.     public LocalDateTime getUpdatedAt() { return updatedAt; }
196. }

    public void completeRereview(BigDecimal rereviewScore,
                                  BigDecimal initialWeight,
                                  BigDecimal rereviewWeight) {
        if (this.status != CaseStatus.REREVIEW_IN_PROGRESS) {
            throw new DomainStateConflictException("CASE_NOT_REREVIEW_IN_PROGRESS",
                    "Can only complete rereview in REREVIEW_IN_PROGRESS. Current: " + this.status);
        }
        Objects.requireNonNull(rereviewScore, "rereviewScore must not be null");
        Objects.requireNonNull(initialWeight, "initialWeight must not be null");
        Objects.requireNonNull(rereviewWeight, "rereviewWeight must not be null");
        this.finalScore = this.initialReviewScore.multiply(initialWeight)
                .add(rereviewScore.multiply(rereviewWeight))
                .setScale(2, java.math.RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
        this.closedAt = LocalDateTime.now();
        this.status = CaseStatus.CLOSED;
    }

    public void updateFinalScoreForRereview(BigDecimal newRereviewScore,
                                             BigDecimal initialWeight,
                                             BigDecimal rereviewWeight) {
        requireNotCancelled();
        Objects.requireNonNull(newRereviewScore, "newRereviewScore must not be null");
        this.finalScore = this.initialReviewScore.multiply(initialWeight)
                .add(newRereviewScore.multiply(rereviewWeight))
                .setScale(2, java.math.RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
    }

    private void requireNotCancelled() {
        if (this.status == CaseStatus.CANCELLED) {
            throw new DomainStateConflictException("CASE_CANCELLED",
                    "Operation not allowed on CANCELLED case");
        }
    }

1761.     }
1762. }

25. 
26. import java.util.List;
27. import java.util.Set;
28. import java.util.stream.Collectors;
29. 
30. @Service
31. @Transactional
32. public class SubmitInitialReviewUseCase {
33. 
34.     private final ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository;
35.     private final ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository;
36.     private final ScoreSheetRepository scoreSheetRepository;
37.     private final DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher;
38.     private final ScoreCalculationService scoreCalculationService;
39. 
40.     public SubmitInitialReviewUseCase(ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository,
41.                                        ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository,
42.                                        ScoreSheetRepository scoreSheetRepository,
43.                                        DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher,
44.                                        ScoreCalculationService scoreCalculationService) {
45.         this.caseRepository = caseRepository;
46.         this.submissionRepository = submissionRepository;
47.         this.scoreSheetRepository = scoreSheetRepository;
48.         this.eventPublisher = eventPublisher;
49.         this.scoreCalculationService = scoreCalculationService;
50.     }
51. 
52.     public void execute(ActorContext actor, String caseId) {
53.         actor.requireRole(DomainRole.REVIEWER);
54. 
55.         ReviewSubmission submission = submissionRepository
56.                 .findLatestByCaseIdAndStage(caseId, ReviewStage.INITIAL)
57.                 .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("SUBMISSION_NOT_FOUND",
58.                         "No INITIAL submission found for case: " + caseId));
59. 
60.         if (!actor.getUserId().equals(submission.getReviewerId())) {
61.             throw new AccessDeniedException("NOT_SUBMISSION_OWNER",
62.                     "Only the reviewer who owns this submission can submit");
63.         }
64. 
65.         // Load ReviewCase and verify status
66.         ReviewCase reviewCase = caseRepository.findById(caseId)
67.                 .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("CASE_NOT_FOUND",
68.                         "ReviewCase not found: " + caseId));
69. 
70.         if (reviewCase.getStatus() != CaseStatus.INITIAL_REVIEW_IN_PROGRESS) {
71.             throw new DomainStateConflictException(
72.                     "CASE_NOT_IN_PROGRESS",
73.                     "Case must be in INITIAL_REVIEW_IN_PROGRESS. Current: " + reviewCase.getStatus());
74.         }
75. 
76.         // Check if already submitted early (will throw DomainStateConflictException)
77.         if (submission.getStatus() != SubmissionStatus.DRAFT) {
78.             throw new DomainStateConflictException(
79.                     "SUBMISSION_NOT_DRAFT",
80.                     "Submission must be in DRAFT status. Current: " + submission.getStatus());
81.         }
82. 
83.         ScoreSheetDefinition scoreSheet = scoreSheetRepository
84.                 .findById(submission.getBasedOnScoreSheetVersionId())
85.                 .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("SCORE_SHEET_NOT_FOUND",
86.                         "ScoreSheetDefinition not found: " + submission.getBasedOnScoreSheetVersionId()));
87. 
88.         List<AnswerItem> currentAnswers = submission.getAnswerSet();
89. 
90.         // Validate required items
91.         Set<String> answeredItemIds = currentAnswers.stream()
92.                 .map(AnswerItem::getItemId)
93.                 .collect(Collectors.toSet());
94. 
95.         List<String> missingRequired = scoreSheet.getSections().stream()
96.                 .flatMap(s -> s.getItems().stream())
97.                 .filter(item -> item.getRequiredRule() == RequiredRule.ALWAYS_REQUIRED)
98.                 .map(ScoreItem::getItemId)
99.                 .filter(id -> !answeredItemIds.contains(id))
100.                 .collect(Collectors.toList());
101. 
102.         if (!missingRequired.isEmpty()) {
103.             throw new DomainRuleViolationException("REQUIRED_ITEMS_NOT_ANSWERED",
104.                     "Required items not answered: " + String.join(", ", missingRequired));
105.         }
106. 
107.         // Recalculate final scores
108.         List<AnswerItem> rawItems = currentAnswers.stream()
109.                 .map(a -> AnswerItem.ofRaw(a.getItemId(), a.getAnswerValue()))
110.                 .collect(Collectors.toList());
111. 
112.         ScoreResult result = scoreCalculationService.calculate(rawItems, scoreSheet);
113. 
114.         // Update with final scores, then submit
115.         submission.updateDraft(result.getScoredAnswers(), result.getTotalScore(), submission.getComment());
116.         submission.submit();
117.         submissionRepository.save(submission);
118. 
119.         // Complete review case
120.         reviewCase.completeInitialReview(result.getTotalScore(), null);
121.         caseRepository.save(reviewCase);
122. 
123.         // Publish event
124.         eventPublisher.publish(new ReviewSubmissionSubmittedEvent(
125.                 this, actor.getUserId(), actor.getUserName(),
126.                 reviewCase.getHospitalId(), caseId,
127.                 submission.getSubmissionId(), result.getTotalScore(), actor.getUserId()));
128.     }
129. }
130.
```

```java
@Test
void execute_scoreAboveThreshold_shouldEscalateToPendingRereview() {
    // Seed project with very low threshold so 17.5 > 0 triggers escalation
    projectRepo.store.clear();
    seedProject(BigDecimal.ZERO); // threshold 0 → any positive score escalates
    
    seedScoreSheet();
    seedCaseInProgress();
    seedDraftWithAnswers();

    useCase.execute(reviewer(), CASE_ID);

    ReviewCase savedCase = caseRepo.store.get(CASE_ID);
    assertEquals(CaseStatus.PENDING_REREVIEW, savedCase.getStatus());
    assertNull(savedCase.getFinalScore()); // no finalScore when escalated
    // Should have 2 events: escalation + submission
    assertTrue(eventPublisher.events.size() >= 2);
}
```
