```java
package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase;

import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.ActorContext;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.DomainRole;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.UnauthorizedException;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase.command.SendToRereviewCommand;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.MedicalRecordType;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.CaseStatus;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCase;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.testfixture.CapturingDomainEventPublisher;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.testfixture.InMemoryReviewCaseRepository;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.EnumSet;
import java.util.Optional;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class SendToRereviewUseCaseTest {

    private InMemoryReviewCaseRepository caseRepository;
    private CapturingDomainEventPublisher eventPublisher;
    private SendToRereviewUseCase useCase;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        caseRepository = new InMemoryReviewCaseRepository();
        eventPublisher = new CapturingDomainEventPublisher();
        useCase = new SendToRereviewUseCase(caseRepository, eventPublisher);
    }

    private ActorContext managerActor() {
        return new ActorContext("mgr-1", "Manager",
                EnumSet.of(DomainRole.HOSPITAL_MANAGER), Optional.of("H001"));
    }

    private ReviewCase seedCompletedCase() {
        ReviewCase rc = ReviewCase.createFromSampling(
                "c1", "b1", "p1", "H001", "SK-001", MedicalRecordType.OUTPATIENT);
        rc.assignReviewer("reviewer-1", LocalDateTime.now());
        rc.startInitialReview("sub-1", "ss-1");
        rc.completeInitialReview(new BigDecimal("70"), new BigDecimal("80"));
        // score 70 <= threshold 80 → INITIAL_REVIEW_COMPLETED
        caseRepository.save(rc);
        return rc;
    }

    @Test
    void execute_happyPath_shouldEscalate() {
        seedCompletedCase();
        SendToRereviewCommand cmd = new SendToRereviewCommand();
        cmd.setCaseId("c1");

        useCase.execute(managerActor(), cmd);

        ReviewCase saved = caseRepository.findById("c1").orElseThrow();
        assertEquals(CaseStatus.PENDING_REREVIEW, saved.getStatus());
        assertEquals(1, eventPublisher.events.size());
    }

    @Test
    void execute_wrongRole_shouldThrow() {
        seedCompletedCase();
        SendToRereviewCommand cmd = new SendToRereviewCommand();
        cmd.setCaseId("c1");

        ActorContext wrongActor = new ActorContext("reviewer-1", "Reviewer",
                EnumSet.of(DomainRole.REVIEWER), Optional.of("H001"));
        assertThrows(UnauthorizedException.class, () -> useCase.execute(wrongActor, cmd));
    }
}
```

```java
package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase;

import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.ActorContext;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.DomainEventPublisher;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.DomainRole;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase.command.SendToRereviewCommand;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.ResourceNotFoundException;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCase;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCaseRepository;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.event.CaseEscalatedToRereviewEvent;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class SendToRereviewUseCase {

    private final ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository;
    private final DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher;

    public SendToRereviewUseCase(ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository,
                                  DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher) {
        this.caseRepository = caseRepository;
        this.eventPublisher = eventPublisher;
    }

    @Transactional
    public void execute(ActorContext actor, SendToRereviewCommand cmd) {
        actor.requireRole(DomainRole.HOSPITAL_MANAGER);
        ReviewCase reviewCase = caseRepository.findById(cmd.getCaseId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewCase", cmd.getCaseId()));
        reviewCase.sendToRereview();
        caseRepository.save(reviewCase);
        eventPublisher.publish(new CaseEscalatedToRereviewEvent(
                this, actor.getUserId(), actor.getUserName(), reviewCase.getHospitalId(),
                reviewCase.getCaseId(),
                "{\"trigger\":\"manual\"}"));
    }
}
```

```
179.     public void completeInitialReview(BigDecimal totalScore, BigDecimal qualityThreshold) {
180.         if (this.status != CaseStatus.INITIAL_REVIEW_IN_PROGRESS) {

275.         this.status = CaseStatus.CLOSED;
276.     }
```

```java
package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase;

import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.ActorContext;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.DomainRole;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.UnauthorizedException;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase.command.CloseWithoutRereviewCommand;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.MedicalRecordType;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.CaseStatus;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCase;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.testfixture.CapturingDomainEventPublisher;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.testfixture.InMemoryReviewCaseRepository;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.EnumSet;
import java.util.Optional;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class CloseWithoutRereviewUseCaseTest {

    private InMemoryReviewCaseRepository caseRepository;
    private CapturingDomainEventPublisher eventPublisher;
    private CloseWithoutRereviewUseCase useCase;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        caseRepository = new InMemoryReviewCaseRepository();
        eventPublisher = new CapturingDomainEventPublisher();
        useCase = new CloseWithoutRereviewUseCase(caseRepository, eventPublisher);
    }

    private ActorContext managerActor() {
        return new ActorContext("mgr-1", "Manager",
                EnumSet.of(DomainRole.HOSPITAL_MANAGER), Optional.of("H001"));
    }

    private ReviewCase seedCompletedCase() {
        ReviewCase rc = ReviewCase.createFromSampling(
                "c1", "b1", "p1", "H001", "SK-001", MedicalRecordType.OUTPATIENT);
        rc.assignReviewer("reviewer-1", LocalDateTime.now());
        rc.startInitialReview("sub-1", "ss-1");
        rc.completeInitialReview(new BigDecimal("70"), new BigDecimal("80"));
        // score 70 <= threshold 80 → INITIAL_REVIEW_COMPLETED
        caseRepository.save(rc);
        return rc;
    }

    @Test
    void execute_happyPath_shouldCloseCase() {
        seedCompletedCase();
        CloseWithoutRereviewCommand cmd = new CloseWithoutRereviewCommand();
        cmd.setCaseId("c1");

        useCase.execute(managerActor(), cmd);

        ReviewCase saved = caseRepository.findById("c1").orElseThrow();
        assertEquals(CaseStatus.CLOSED, saved.getStatus());
        assertNotNull(saved.getClosedAt());
        assertEquals(1, eventPublisher.events.size());
    }

    @Test
    void execute_wrongRole_shouldThrow() {
        seedCompletedCase();
        CloseWithoutRereviewCommand cmd = new CloseWithoutRereviewCommand();
        cmd.setCaseId("c1");

        ActorContext wrongActor = new ActorContext("reviewer-1", "Reviewer",
                EnumSet.of(DomainRole.REVIEWER), Optional.of("H001"));
        assertThrows(UnauthorizedException.class, () -> useCase.execute(wrongActor, cmd));
    }
}
```

### File 3: CloseWithoutRereviewUseCase.java

```java
package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase;

import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.ActorContext;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.DomainEventPublisher;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.DomainRole;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase.command.CloseWithoutRereviewCommand;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.ResourceNotFoundException;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCase;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCaseRepository;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.event.CaseClosedWithoutRereviewEvent;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class CloseWithoutRereviewUseCase {

    private final ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository;
    private final DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher;

    public CloseWithoutRereviewUseCase(ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository,
                                        DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher) {
        this.caseRepository = caseRepository;
        this.eventPublisher = eventPublisher;
    }

    @Transactional
    public void execute(ActorContext actor, CloseWithoutRereviewCommand cmd) {
        actor.requireRole(DomainRole.HOSPITAL_MANAGER);
        ReviewCase reviewCase = caseRepository.findById(cmd.getCaseId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewCase", cmd.getCaseId()));
        reviewCase.closeWithoutRereview();
        caseRepository.save(reviewCase);
        eventPublisher.publish(new CaseClosedWithoutRereviewEvent(
                this, actor.getUserId(), actor.getUserName(), reviewCase.getHospitalId(),
                reviewCase.getCaseId(),
                String.format("{\"finalScore\":%s}", reviewCase.getFinalScore())));
    }
}
```

2614.         actor.requireRole(DomainRole.REREVIEWER);
2615.         ReviewCase reviewCase = caseRepository.findById(cmd.getCaseId())
2616.                 .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewCase", cmd.getCaseId()));
2617.         if (reviewCase.getRereviewerAssignment() == null
2618.                 || !actor.getUserId().equals(reviewCase.getRereviewerAssignment().getReviewerId())) {
2619.             throw new DomainRuleViolationException("NOT_ASSIGNED_REREVIEWER",
2620.                     "Only the assigned rereviewer can save this draft");
2621.         }
2622.         ReviewSubmission submission = submissionRepository.findById(cmd.getSubmissionId())
2623.                 .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewSubmission", cmd.getSubmissionId()));
2624.         submission.updateDraft(cmd.getAnswers());
2625.         submissionRepository.save(submission);
2626.     }
2627. }

```java
package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase;

import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.ActorContext;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.DomainEventPublisher;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.DomainRole;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase.command.StartRereviewCommand;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.ResourceNotFoundException;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCase;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCaseRepository;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.event.RereviewStartedEvent;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewSubmission;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewSubmissionRepository;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.util.UUID;

@Service
public class StartRereviewUseCase {

    private final ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository;
    private final ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository;
    private final DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher;

    public StartRereviewUseCase(ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository,
                                 ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository,
                                 DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher) {
        this.caseRepository = caseRepository;
        this.submissionRepository = submissionRepository;
        this.eventPublisher = eventPublisher;
    }

    @Transactional
    public void execute(ActorContext actor, StartRereviewCommand cmd) {
        actor.requireRole(DomainRole.REREVIEWER);
        ReviewCase reviewCase = caseRepository.findById(cmd.getCaseId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewCase", cmd.getCaseId()));
        // Domain method validates actor is the assigned rereviewer
        reviewCase.startRereview(actor.getUserId());
        ReviewSubmission rereviewDraft = ReviewSubmission.createRereviewDraft(
                UUID.randomUUID().toString(), cmd.getCaseId(), actor.getUserId());
        submissionRepository.save(rereviewDraft);
        caseRepository.save(reviewCase);
        eventPublisher.publish(new RereviewStartedEvent(
                this, actor.getUserId(), actor.getUserName(), reviewCase.getHospitalId(),
                reviewCase.getCaseId(),
                String.format("{\"submissionId\":\"%s\"}", rereviewDraft.getSubmissionId())));
    }
}
```

```java
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.testfixture.InMemoryReviewCaseRepository;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.testfixture.InMemoryReviewSubmissionRepository;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.EnumSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class StartRereviewUseCaseTest {

    private InMemoryReviewCaseRepository caseRepository;
    private InMemoryReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository;
    private CapturingDomainEventPublisher eventPublisher;
    private StartRereviewUseCase useCase;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        caseRepository = new InMemoryReviewCaseRepository();
        submissionRepository = new InMemoryReviewSubmissionRepository();
        eventPublisher = new CapturingDomainEventPublisher();
        useCase = new StartRereviewUseCase(caseRepository, submissionRepository, eventPublisher);
    }

    private ActorContext rereviewerActor() {
        return new ActorContext("rereviewer-1", "ReReviewer",
                EnumSet.of(DomainRole.REREVIEWER), Optional.of("H001"));
    }

    private ReviewCase seedAssignedCase() {
        ReviewCase rc = ReviewCase.createFromSampling(
                "c1", "b1", "p1", "H001", "SK-001", MedicalRecordType.OUTPATIENT);
        rc.assignReviewer("reviewer-1", LocalDateTime.now());
        rc.startInitialReview("sub-1", "ss-1");
        rc.completeInitialReview(new BigDecimal("90"), new BigDecimal("80"));
        // score 90 > threshold 80 → PENDING_REREVIEW
        rc.assignRereviewer("rereviewer-1", LocalDateTime.of(2026, 6, 30, 23, 59));
        caseRepository.save(rc);
        return rc;
    }

    @Test
    void execute_happyPath_shouldTransitionAndCreateDraft() {
        seedAssignedCase();
        StartRereviewCommand cmd = new StartRereviewCommand();
        cmd.setCaseId("c1");

        useCase.execute(rereviewerActor(), cmd);

        ReviewCase saved = caseRepository.findById("c1").orElseThrow();
        assertEquals(CaseStatus.REREVIEW_IN_PROGRESS, saved.getStatus());

        // A rereview draft submission should be created
        List<ReviewSubmission> subs = submissionRepository.findAllByCaseId("c1");
        ReviewSubmission rereviewDraft = subs.stream()
                .filter(s -> s.getStage() == ReviewStage.REREVIEW)
                .findFirst().orElseThrow();
        assertEquals(SubmissionStatus.DRAFT, rereviewDraft.getStatus());
        assertEquals("rereviewer-1", rereviewDraft.getReviewerId());
        assertEquals(1, eventPublisher.events.size());
    }

    @Test
    void execute_wrongActor_shouldThrow() {
        seedAssignedCase();
        StartRereviewCommand cmd = new StartRereviewCommand();
        cmd.setCaseId("c1");

        // Not the assigned rereviewer
        ActorContext wrongActor = new ActorContext("someone-else", "Other",
                EnumSet.of(DomainRole.REREVIEWER), Optional.of("H001"));
        assertThrows(Exception.class, () -> useCase.execute(wrongActor, cmd));
    }

    @Test
    void execute_nonRereviewer_shouldThrow() {
        seedAssignedCase();
        StartRereviewCommand cmd = new StartRereviewCommand();
        cmd.setCaseId("c1");

        ActorContext reviewer = new ActorContext("rereviewer-1", "Reviewer",
                EnumSet.of(DomainRole.REVIEWER), Optional.of("H001"));
        assertThrows(UnauthorizedException.class, () -> useCase.execute(reviewer, cmd));
    }
}
```

```
20. @Service
21. public class ScoreCalculationService {
22. 
23.     /**
24.      * Calculate scores for raw answers against the score sheet definition.
25.      *
26.      * @param rawAnswers  frontend-submitted answers (itemId + answerValue only)
27.      * @param scoreSheet  the published ScoreSheetDefinition
28.      * @return ScoreResult with scored answers and total score
29.      */
30.     public ScoreResult calculate(List<AnswerItem> rawAnswers, ScoreSheetDefinition scoreSheet) {
31.         Objects.requireNonNull(rawAnswers, "rawAnswers must not be null");
32.         Objects.requireNonNull(scoreSheet, "scoreSheet must not be null");
33.         // Build itemId → ScoreItem lookup map from all sections
34.         Map<String, ScoreItem> itemMap = new HashMap<>();
35.         for (ScoreSheetSection section : scoreSheet.getSections()) {
36.             for (ScoreItem item : section.getItems()) {
37.                 itemMap.put(item.getItemId(), item);
38.             }
39.         }
40. 
41.         List<AnswerItem> scoredAnswers = new ArrayList<>();
42.         BigDecimal totalScore = BigDecimal.ZERO;
43. 
44.         for (AnswerItem raw : rawAnswers) {
45.             ScoreItem definition = itemMap.get(raw.getItemId());
46.             if (definition == null) {
47.                 // Unknown itemId — ignore per spec
48.                 continue;
49.             }
50. 
51.             BigDecimal derivedScore = computeScore(raw, definition);
52.             scoredAnswers.add(AnswerItem.ofScored(raw.getItemId(), raw.getAnswerValue(), derivedScore));
53.             totalScore = totalScore.add(derivedScore);
54.         }
55. 
56.         return new ScoreResult(scoredAnswers, totalScore);
57.     }
58. 
59.     private BigDecimal computeScore(AnswerItem raw, ScoreItem definition) {
60.         BigDecimal weight = definition.getWeight();
61. 
62.         switch (definition.getScoreType()) {
63.             case BOOLEAN:
64.                 return "true".equals(raw.getAnswerValue())
65.                         ? definition.getMaxScore().multiply(weight)
66.                         : BigDecimal.ZERO;
67. 
68.             case FIXED:
69.                 return definition.getMaxScore().multiply(weight);
70. 
71.             case RANGE:
72.                 BigDecimal value;
73.                 try {
74.                     value = new BigDecimal(raw.getAnswerValue());
75.                 } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
76.                     throw new IllegalArgumentException(
77.                             "RANGE answer for item " + raw.getItemId()
78.                                     + " must be numeric, got: " + raw.getAnswerValue());
79.                 }
80.                 if (value.compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) < 0) {
81.                     throw new IllegalArgumentException(
82.                             "RANGE answer for item " + raw.getItemId()
83.                                     + " must not be negative, got: " + raw.getAnswerValue());
84.                 }
85.                 BigDecimal capped = value.min(definition.getMaxScore());
86.                 return capped.multiply(weight);
87. 
88.             default:
89.                 throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown ScoreType: " + definition.getScoreType());
90.         }
91.     }
92. }
93.
```

```
36. public class SubmitInitialReviewUseCase {
37. 
38.     private final ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository;
39.     private final ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository;
40.     private final ReviewProjectRepository projectRepository;
41.     private final ScoreSheetRepository scoreSheetRepository;
42.     private final DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher;

44. 
45.     public SubmitInitialReviewUseCase(ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository,
46.                                        ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository,
47.                                        ReviewProjectRepository projectRepository,
48.                                        ScoreSheetRepository scoreSheetRepository,
49.                                        DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher,
50.                                        ScoreCalculationService scoreCalculationService) {
51.         this.caseRepository = caseRepository;
52.         this.submissionRepository = submissionRepository;
53.         this.projectRepository = projectRepository;
54.         this.scoreSheetRepository = scoreSheetRepository;
55.         this.eventPublisher = eventPublisher;
56.         this.scoreCalculationService = scoreCalculationService;
57.     }
58. 
59.     public void execute(ActorContext actor, String caseId) {
60.         actor.requireRole(DomainRole.REVIEWER);
61. 
62.         ReviewSubmission submission = submissionRepository
63.                 .findLatestByCaseIdAndStage(caseId, ReviewStage.INITIAL)
64.                 .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("SUBMISSION_NOT_FOUND",
65.                         "No INITIAL submission found for case: " + caseId));
66. 
67.         if (!actor.getUserId().equals(submission.getReviewerId())) {
68.             throw new AccessDeniedException("NOT_SUBMISSION_OWNER",
69.                     "Only the reviewer who owns this submission can submit");
70.         }
71. 
72.         // Load ReviewCase and verify status
73.         ReviewCase reviewCase = caseRepository.findById(caseId)
74.                 .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("CASE_NOT_FOUND",
75.                         "ReviewCase not found: " + caseId));
76. 
77.         if (reviewCase.getStatus() != CaseStatus.INITIAL_REVIEW_IN_PROGRESS) {
78.             throw new DomainStateConflictException(
79.                     "CASE_NOT_IN_PROGRESS",
80.                     "Case must be in INITIAL_REVIEW_IN_PROGRESS. Current: " + reviewCase.getStatus());
81.         }
82. 
83.         // Check if already submitted early (will throw DomainStateConflictException)
84.         if (submission.getStatus() != SubmissionStatus.DRAFT) {
85.             throw new DomainStateConflictException(
86.                     "SUBMISSION_NOT_DRAFT",
87.                     "Submission must be in DRAFT status. Current: " + submission.getStatus());
88.         }
89. 
90.         ScoreSheetDefinition scoreSheet = scoreSheetRepository
91.                 .findById(submission.getBasedOnScoreSheetVersionId())
92.                 .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("SCORE_SHEET_NOT_FOUND",
93.                         "ScoreSheetDefinition not found: " + submission.getBasedOnScoreSheetVersionId()));
94. 
95.         List<AnswerItem> currentAnswers = submission.getAnswerSet();
96. 
97.         // Validate required items
98.         Set<String> answeredItemIds = currentAnswers.stream()
99.                 .map(AnswerItem::getItemId)
100.                 .collect(Collectors.toSet());
101. 
102.         List<String> missingRequired = scoreSheet.getSections().stream()
103.                 .flatMap(s -> s.getItems().stream())
104.                 .filter(item -> item.getRequiredRule() == RequiredRule.ALWAYS_REQUIRED)
105.                 .map(ScoreItem::getItemId)
106.                 .filter(id -> !answeredItemIds.contains(id))
107.                 .collect(Collectors.toList());
108. 
109.         if (!missingRequired.isEmpty()) {
110.             throw new DomainRuleViolationException("REQUIRED_ITEMS_NOT_ANSWERED",
111.                     "Required items not answered: " + String.join(", ", missingRequired));
112.         }
113. 
114.         // Recalculate final scores
115.         List<AnswerItem> rawItems = currentAnswers.stream()
116.                 .map(a -> AnswerItem.ofRaw(a.getItemId(), a.getAnswerValue()))
117.                 .collect(Collectors.toList());
118. 
119.         ScoreResult result = scoreCalculationService.calculate(rawItems, scoreSheet);
120. 
121.         // Update with final scores, then submit
122.         submission.updateDraft(result.getScoredAnswers(), result.getTotalScore(), submission.getComment());
123.         submission.submit();
124.         submissionRepository.save(submission);
125. 
126.         // Load quality threshold from the project's current version
127.         ReviewProject project = projectRepository.findById(reviewCase.getProjectId())
128.                 .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewProject", reviewCase.getProjectId()));
129.         BigDecimal qualityThreshold = project.getCurrentVersion().getQualityThreshold();
130. 
131.         // Complete review case
132.         reviewCase.completeInitialReview(result.getTotalScore(), qualityThreshold);
133.         caseRepository.save(reviewCase);
134. 
135.         // If escalated to re-review, publish escalation event
136.         if (reviewCase.getStatus() == CaseStatus.PENDING_REREVIEW) {
137.             eventPublisher.publish(new CaseEscalatedToRereviewEvent(
138.                     this, actor.getUserId(), actor.getUserName(), reviewCase.getHospitalId(),
139.                     reviewCase.getCaseId(),
140.                     String.format("{\"score\":%s,\"threshold\":%s}",
141.                             result.getTotalScore(), qualityThreshold)));
142.         }
143. 
144.         // Publish event
145.         eventPublisher.publish(new ReviewSubmissionSubmittedEvent(
146.                 this, actor.getUserId(), actor.getUserName(),
147.                 reviewCase.getHospitalId(), caseId,
148.                 submission.getSubmissionId(), result.getTotalScore(), actor.getUserId()));
149.     }
150. }
```

```java
package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase;
```

```java
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.event.RereviewerAssignedEvent;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class AssignRereviewerUseCase {

    private final ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository;
    private final DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher;

    public AssignRereviewerUseCase(ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository,
                                    DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher) {
        this.caseRepository = caseRepository;
        this.eventPublisher = eventPublisher;
    }

    @Transactional
    public void execute(ActorContext actor, AssignRereviewerCommand cmd) {
        actor.requireRole(DomainRole.HOSPITAL_MANAGER);
        ReviewCase reviewCase = caseRepository.findById(cmd.getCaseId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewCase", cmd.getCaseId()));
        reviewCase.assignRereviewer(cmd.getRereviewerId(), cmd.getDueAt());
        caseRepository.save(reviewCase);
        eventPublisher.publish(new RereviewerAssignedEvent(
                this, actor.getUserId(), actor.getUserName(), reviewCase.getHospitalId(),
                reviewCase.getCaseId(),
                String.format("{\"rereviewerId\":\"%s\"}", cmd.getRereviewerId())));
    }
}
```

3135.     public ReviseRereviewUseCase(ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository,
3136.                                   ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository,
3137.                                   ReviewProjectRepository projectRepository,
3138.                                   ScoreSheetRepository scoreSheetRepository,
3139.                                   DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher) {
3140.         this.caseRepository = caseRepository;
3141.         this.submissionRepository = submissionRepository;
3142.         this.projectRepository = projectRepository;
3143.         this.scoreSheetRepository = scoreSheetRepository;
3144.         this.eventPublisher = eventPublisher;
3145.     }

3147.     @Transactional
3148.     public void execute(ActorContext actor, ReviseRereviewCommand cmd) {
3149.         actor.requireRole(DomainRole.REREVIEWER);
3150.         ReviewCase reviewCase = caseRepository.findById(cmd.getCaseId())
3151.                 .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewCase", cmd.getCaseId()));
3152. 
3153.         if (reviewCase.getRereviewerAssignment() == null
3154.                 || !actor.getUserId().equals(reviewCase.getRereviewerAssignment().getReviewerId())) {
3155.             throw new DomainRuleViolationException("NOT_ASSIGNED_REREVIEWER",
3156.                     "Only the assigned rereviewer can revise this rereview");
3157.         }
3158. 
3159.         ReviewSubmission oldSubmission = submissionRepository.findById(cmd.getSubmissionId())
3160.                 .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewSubmission", cmd.getSubmissionId()));
3161. 
3162.         // Create revision (append-only)
3163.         ReviewSubmission revision = oldSubmission.createRevision(UUID.randomUUID().toString());
3164.         if (cmd.getAnswers() != null) {
3165.             revision.updateDraft(cmd.getAnswers());
3166.         }
3167. 
3168.         // Score the revision
3169.         ScoreSheetDefinition scoreSheet = scoreSheetRepository.findById(reviewCase.getScoreSheetVersionRef())
3170.                 .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ScoreSheetDefinition", reviewCase.getScoreSheetVersionRef()));
3171.         var result = scoreSheet.calculateScore(revision.getAnswers());
3172.         revision.submit(result.getTotalScore());
3173.         submissionRepository.save(revision);
3174. 
3175.         // Recalculate weighted final score
3176.         ReviewProject project = projectRepository.findById(reviewCase.getProjectId())
3177.                 .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewProject", reviewCase.getProjectId()));
3178.         ProjectVersion version = project.getActiveVersion()
3179.                 .orElseThrow(() -> new DomainRuleViolationException("NO_ACTIVE_VERSION",
3180.                         "ReviewProject has no active version"));
3181. 
3182.         reviewCase.updateFinalScoreForRereview(
3183.                 result.getTotalScore(),
3184.                 version.getInitialReviewWeight(),
3185.                 version.getRereviewWeight());
3186.         caseRepository.save(reviewCase);
3187. 
3188.         eventPublisher.publish(new RereviewRevisedEvent(
3189.                 this, actor.getUserId(), actor.getUserName(), reviewCase.getHospitalId(),
3190.                 reviewCase.getCaseId(),
3191.                 String.format("{\"revisionNumber\":%d,\"rereviewScore\":%.2f,\"finalScore\":%.2f}",
3192.                         revision.getRevisionNumber(), result.getTotalScore(), reviewCase.getFinalScore())));
3193.     }
3194. }

```java
package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase;

import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.ActorContext;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.DomainRole;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase.command.SaveRereviewDraftCommand;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.DomainRuleViolationException;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.ResourceNotFoundException;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCase;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCaseRepository;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewSubmission;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewSubmissionRepository;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.Collections;

@Service
public class SaveRereviewDraftUseCase {

    private final ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository;
    private final ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository;

    public SaveRereviewDraftUseCase(ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository,
                                     ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository) {
        this.caseRepository = caseRepository;
        this.submissionRepository = submissionRepository;
    }

    @Transactional
    public void execute(ActorContext actor, SaveRereviewDraftCommand cmd) {
        actor.requireRole(DomainRole.REREVIEWER);
        ReviewCase reviewCase = caseRepository.findById(cmd.getCaseId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewCase", cmd.getCaseId()));
        if (reviewCase.getRereviewerAssignment() == null
                || !actor.getUserId().equals(reviewCase.getRereviewerAssignment().getReviewerId())) {
            throw new DomainRuleViolationException("NOT_ASSIGNED_REREVIEWER",
                    "Only the assigned rereviewer can save this draft");
        }
        ReviewSubmission submission = submissionRepository.findById(cmd.getSubmissionId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewSubmission", cmd.getSubmissionId()));
        submission.updateDraft(
                cmd.getAnswers() != null ? cmd.getAnswers() : Collections.emptyList(),
                cmd.getTotalScore() != null ? cmd.getTotalScore() : BigDecimal.ZERO,
                cmd.getComment());
        submissionRepository.save(submission);
    }
}
```

### 3. `src/test/java/com/tzuchi/his/quality/inspection/application/reviewcase/SaveRereviewDraftUseCaseTest.java`

```java
package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase;

import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.ActorContext;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.DomainRole;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.UnauthorizedException;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase.command.SaveRereviewDraftCommand;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.MedicalRecordType;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCase;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewSubmission;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.SubmissionStatus;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.testfixture.InMemoryReviewCaseRepository;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.testfixture.InMemoryReviewSubmissionRepository;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.EnumSet;
import java.util.Optional;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class SaveRereviewDraftUseCaseTest {

    private InMemoryReviewCaseRepository caseRepository;
    private InMemoryReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository;
    private SaveRereviewDraftUseCase useCase;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        caseRepository = new InMemoryReviewCaseRepository();
        submissionRepository = new InMemoryReviewSubmissionRepository();
        useCase = new SaveRereviewDraftUseCase(caseRepository, submissionRepository);
    }

    private ActorContext rereviewerActor() {
        return new ActorContext("rereviewer-1", "ReReviewer",
                EnumSet.of(DomainRole.REREVIEWER), Optional.of("H001"));
    }

    private void seedCaseAndDraft() {
        ReviewCase rc = ReviewCase.createFromSampling(
                "c1", "b1", "p1", "H001", "SK-001", MedicalRecordType.OUTPATIENT);
        rc.assignReviewer("reviewer-1", LocalDateTime.now());
        rc.startInitialReview("sub-init", "ss-1");
        rc.completeInitialReview(new BigDecimal("90"), new BigDecimal("80"));
        rc.assignRereviewer("rereviewer-1", LocalDateTime.of(2026, 6, 30, 23, 59));
        rc.startRereview("rereviewer-1");
        caseRepository.save(rc);

        ReviewSubmission draft = ReviewSubmission.createRereviewDraft("sub-r1", "c1", "rereviewer-1");
        submissionRepository.save(draft);
    }

    @Test
    void execute_happyPath_shouldSaveDraft() {
        seedCaseAndDraft();
        SaveRereviewDraftCommand cmd = new SaveRereviewDraftCommand();
        cmd.setCaseId("c1");
        cmd.setSubmissionId("sub-r1");
        cmd.setAnswers(Collections.emptyList());
        cmd.setTotalScore(BigDecimal.ZERO);
        cmd.setComment("draft comment");

        useCase.execute(rereviewerActor(), cmd);

        ReviewSubmission saved = submissionRepository.findById("sub-r1").orElseThrow();
        assertEquals(SubmissionStatus.DRAFT, saved.getStatus());
        assertEquals("draft comment", saved.getComment());
    }

    @Test
    void execute_wrongActor_shouldThrow() {
        seedCaseAndDraft();
        SaveRereviewDraftCommand cmd = new SaveRereviewDraftCommand();
        cmd.setCaseId("c1");
        cmd.setSubmissionId("sub-r1");
        cmd.setAnswers(Collections.emptyList());

        ActorContext wrongActor = new ActorContext("someone-else", "Other",
                EnumSet.of(DomainRole.REREVIEWER), Optional.of("H001"));
        assertThrows(Exception.class, () -> useCase.execute(wrongActor, cmd));
    }

    @Test
    void execute_nonRereviewer_shouldThrow() {
        seedCaseAndDraft();
        SaveRereviewDraftCommand cmd = new SaveRereviewDraftCommand();
        cmd.setCaseId("c1");
        cmd.setSubmissionId("sub-r1");
        cmd.setAnswers(Collections.emptyList());

        ActorContext reviewer = new ActorContext("rereviewer-1", "Reviewer",
                EnumSet.of(DomainRole.REVIEWER), Optional.of("H001"));
        assertThrows(UnauthorizedException.class, () -> useCase.execute(reviewer, cmd));
    }
}
```

```java
package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase;

import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.ActorContext;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.DomainEventPublisher;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.DomainRole;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase.command.SubmitRereviewCommand;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.DomainRuleViolationException;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.ResourceNotFoundException;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.project.ProjectVersion;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.project.ReviewProject;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.project.ReviewProjectRepository;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCase;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCaseRepository;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.event.RereviewSubmittedEvent;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.AnswerItem;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewSubmission;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewSubmissionRepository;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.scoresheet.ScoreSheetDefinition;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.scoresheet.ScoreSheetRepository;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

@Service
public class SubmitRereviewUseCase {

    private final ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository;
    private final ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository;
    private final ReviewProjectRepository projectRepository;
    private final ScoreSheetRepository scoreSheetRepository;
    private final DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher;
    private final ScoreCalculationService scoreCalculationService;

    public SubmitRereviewUseCase(ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository,
                                  ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository,
                                  ReviewProjectRepository projectRepository,
                                  ScoreSheetRepository scoreSheetRepository,
                                  DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher,
                                  ScoreCalculationService scoreCalculationService) {
        this.caseRepository = caseRepository;
        this.submissionRepository = submissionRepository;
        this.projectRepository = projectRepository;
        this.scoreSheetRepository = scoreSheetRepository;
        this.eventPublisher = eventPublisher;
        this.scoreCalculationService = scoreCalculationService;
    }

    @Transactional
    public void execute(ActorContext actor, SubmitRereviewCommand cmd) {
        actor.requireRole(DomainRole.REREVIEWER);

        ReviewCase reviewCase = caseRepository.findById(cmd.getCaseId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewCase", cmd.getCaseId()));

        // Validate actor is the assigned rereviewer
        if (reviewCase.getRereviewerAssignment() == null
                || !actor.getUserId().equals(reviewCase.getRereviewerAssignment().getReviewerId())) {
            throw new DomainRuleViolationException("NOT_ASSIGNED_REREVIEWER",
                    "Only the assigned rereviewer can submit this rereview");
        }

        ReviewSubmission submission = submissionRepository.findById(cmd.getSubmissionId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewSubmission", cmd.getSubmissionId()));

        // Load score sheet for scoring
        ScoreSheetDefinition scoreSheet = scoreSheetRepository
                .findById(reviewCase.getScoreSheetVersionRef())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ScoreSheetDefinition",
                        reviewCase.getScoreSheetVersionRef()));

        // Get current answers (from command if provided, else from draft)
        List<AnswerItem> currentAnswers = cmd.getAnswers() != null
                ? cmd.getAnswers()
                : submission.getAnswerSet();

        // Calculate scores server-side
        List<AnswerItem> rawItems = currentAnswers.stream()
                .map(a -> AnswerItem.ofRaw(a.getItemId(), a.getAnswerValue()))
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
        ScoreResult result = scoreCalculationService.calculate(rawItems, scoreSheet);

        // Update draft with scored answers, then submit
        submission.updateDraft(result.getScoredAnswers(), result.getTotalScore(), cmd.getComment());
        submission.submit();
        submissionRepository.save(submission);

        // Load project for weights
        ReviewProject project = projectRepository.findById(reviewCase.getProjectId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewProject", reviewCase.getProjectId()));
        ProjectVersion version = project.getCurrentVersion();

        // Complete rereview with weighted final score
        reviewCase.completeRereview(
                result.getTotalScore(),
                version.getInitialReviewWeight(),
                version.getRereviewWeight());
        caseRepository.save(reviewCase);

        eventPublisher.publish(new RereviewSubmittedEvent(
                this, actor.getUserId(), actor.getUserName(), reviewCase.getHospitalId(),
                reviewCase.getCaseId(),
                String.format("{\"rereviewScore\":%s,\"finalScore\":%s}",
                        result.getTotalScore(), reviewCase.getFinalScore())));
    }
}
```

```java
package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase;

import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.ActorContext;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.DomainRole;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.UnauthorizedException;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase.command.SubmitRereviewCommand;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.MedicalRecordType;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.project.ProjectStatus;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.project.ReviewProject;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.CaseStatus;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCase;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.AnswerItem;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewSubmission;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.SubmissionStatus;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.scoresheet.RequiredRule;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.scoresheet.ScoreItem;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.scoresheet.ScoreSheetDefinition;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.scoresheet.ScoreSheetSection;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.scoresheet.ScoreType;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.testfixture.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.*;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class SubmitRereviewUseCaseTest {

    private InMemoryReviewCaseRepository caseRepo;
    private InMemoryReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepo;
    private InMemoryReviewProjectRepository projectRepo;
    private InMemoryScoreSheetRepository scoreSheetRepo;
    private CapturingDomainEventPublisher eventPublisher;
    private SubmitRereviewUseCase useCase;

    private static final String CASE_ID = "c1";
    private static final String SUBMISSION_ID = "sub-r1";
    private static final String PROJECT_ID = "p1";
    private static final String HOSPITAL_ID = "H001";
    private static final String SCORE_SHEET_ID = "ss-1";
    private static final String REREVIEWER_ID = "rereviewer-1";

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        caseRepo = new InMemoryReviewCaseRepository();
        submissionRepo = new InMemoryReviewSubmissionRepository();
        projectRepo = new InMemoryReviewProjectRepository();
        scoreSheetRepo = new InMemoryScoreSheetRepository();
        eventPublisher = new CapturingDomainEventPublisher();
        ScoreCalculationService scoreCalcService = new ScoreCalculationService();
        useCase = new SubmitRereviewUseCase(
                caseRepo, submissionRepo, projectRepo, scoreSheetRepo, eventPublisher, scoreCalcService);
    }

    private ActorContext rereviewerActor() {
        return new ActorContext(REREVIEWER_ID, "ReReviewer",
                EnumSet.of(DomainRole.REREVIEWER), Optional.of(HOSPITAL_ID));
    }

    private void seedProject() {
        // Use reconstitute to seed project with scoring config (threshold=80, 50/50 weights)
        ReviewProject project = ReviewProject.reconstitute(
                PROJECT_ID, HOSPITAL_ID, "Test Project", null, SCORE_SHEET_ID,
                null, ProjectStatus.ACTIVE, 1, true,
                new BigDecimal("80"), new BigDecimal("0.5"), new BigDecimal("0.5"));
        projectRepo.save(project);
    }

    private void seedScoreSheet() {
        ScoreSheetDefinition ss = ScoreSheetDefinition.createDraft(SCORE_SHEET_ID, PROJECT_ID);
        ScoreSheetSection section = new ScoreSheetSection("sec-1", "Section 1");
        section.addItem(new ScoreItem("Q001", "Q001", "Bool Question", ScoreType.BOOLEAN,
                new BigDecimal("10"), new BigDecimal("1.0"),
                RequiredRule.ALWAYS_REQUIRED, null));
        section.addItem(new ScoreItem("Q002", "Q002", "Range Question", ScoreType.RANGE,
                new BigDecimal("20"), new BigDecimal("0.5"),
                RequiredRule.OPTIONAL, null));
        ss.addSection(section);
        ss.publishVersion();
        scoreSheetRepo.save(ss);
    }

    private void seedRereviewInProgressCase() {
        ReviewCase rc = ReviewCase.createFromSampling(
                CASE_ID, "b1", PROJECT_ID, HOSPITAL_ID, "SK-001", MedicalRecordType.OUTPATIENT);
        rc.assignReviewer("reviewer-1", LocalDateTime.now());
        rc.startInitialReview("sub-init", SCORE_SHEET_ID);
        rc.completeInitialReview(new BigDecimal("90"), new BigDecimal("80"));
        // score 90 > threshold 80 → PENDING_REREVIEW
        rc.assignRereviewer(REREVIEWER_ID, LocalDateTime.of(2026, 6, 30, 23, 59));
        rc.startRereview(REREVIEWER_ID);
        caseRepo.save(rc);
    }

    private void seedRereviewDraftWithAnswers() {
        ReviewSubmission draft = ReviewSubmission.createRereviewDraft(
                SUBMISSION_ID, CASE_ID, REREVIEWER_ID);
        List<AnswerItem> answers = Arrays.asList(
                AnswerItem.ofScored("Q001", "true", new BigDecimal("10.0")),
                AnswerItem.ofScored("Q002", "15", new BigDecimal("7.5"))
        );
        draft.updateDraft(answers, new BigDecimal("17.5"), "rereview comment");
        submissionRepo.save(draft);
    }

    @Test
    void execute_happyPath_shouldCloseWithWeightedScore() {
        seedProject();
        seedScoreSheet();
        seedRereviewInProgressCase();
        seedRereviewDraftWithAnswers();

        SubmitRereviewCommand cmd = new SubmitRereviewCommand();
        cmd.setCaseId(CASE_ID);
        cmd.setSubmissionId(SUBMISSION_ID);
        // Don't pass answers — use existing draft answers

        useCase.execute(rereviewerActor(), cmd);

        ReviewCase saved = caseRepo.findById(CASE_ID).orElseThrow();
        assertEquals(CaseStatus.CLOSED, saved.getStatus());
        assertNotNull(saved.getFinalScore());
        assertNotNull(saved.getClosedAt());

        // finalScore = initialScore(90) * 0.5 + rereviewScore * 0.5
        // rereviewScore = Q001(10*1.0=10) + Q002(15*0.5=7.5) = 17.5
        // finalScore = 90*0.5 + 17.5*0.5 = 45 + 8.75 = 53.75
        assertEquals(0, saved.getFinalScore().compareTo(new BigDecimal("53.75")));

        ReviewSubmission sub = submissionRepo.findById(SUBMISSION_ID).orElseThrow();
        assertEquals(SubmissionStatus.SUBMITTED, sub.getStatus());
        assertTrue(eventPublisher.events.size() >= 1);
    }

    @Test
    void execute_wrongActor_shouldThrow() {
        seedProject();
        seedScoreSheet();
        seedRereviewInProgressCase();
        seedRereviewDraftWithAnswers();

        SubmitRereviewCommand cmd = new SubmitRereviewCommand();
        cmd.setCaseId(CASE_ID);
        cmd.setSubmissionId(SUBMISSION_ID);

        ActorContext wrongActor = new ActorContext("someone-else", "Other",
                EnumSet.of(DomainRole.REREVIEWER), Optional.of(HOSPITAL_ID));
        assertThrows(Exception.class, () -> useCase.execute(wrongActor, cmd));
    }

    @Test
    void execute_nonRereviewer_shouldThrow() {
        seedProject();
        seedScoreSheet();
        seedRereviewInProgressCase();
        seedRereviewDraftWithAnswers();

        SubmitRereviewCommand cmd = new SubmitRereviewCommand();
        cmd.setCaseId(CASE_ID);
        cmd.setSubmissionId(SUBMISSION_ID);

        ActorContext reviewer = new ActorContext(REREVIEWER_ID, "Reviewer",
                EnumSet.of(DomainRole.REVIEWER), Optional.of(HOSPITAL_ID));
        assertThrows(UnauthorizedException.class, () -> useCase.execute(reviewer, cmd));
    }
}
```

```
package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission;

import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.DomainStateConflictException;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Aggregate root for a review submission.
 * B3a: shell with getters only.
 * B3b: full business methods — createDraft, updateDraft, submit.
 */
public class ReviewSubmission {

    private String submissionId;
    private String caseId;
    private ReviewStage stage;
    private String reviewerId;
    private SubmissionStatus status;
    private int revisionNo;
    private List<AnswerItem> answerSet;
    private BigDecimal totalScore;
    private String comment;
    private LocalDateTime submittedAt;
    private String basedOnScoreSheetVersionId;
    private String supersededBySubmissionId;
    private String attachmentRefsJson;
    private LocalDateTime createdAt;
    private LocalDateTime updatedAt;

    protected ReviewSubmission() {
        // for persistence / reconstitution
    }

    /**
     * Create an initial review draft submission.
     * Called by StartInitialReviewUseCase.
     */
    public static ReviewSubmission createInitialDraft(
            String submissionId, String caseId, String reviewerId,
            String scoreSheetVersionId) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(submissionId, "submissionId must not be null");
        Objects.requireNonNull(caseId, "caseId must not be null");
        Objects.requireNonNull(reviewerId, "reviewerId must not be null");
        Objects.requireNonNull(scoreSheetVersionId, "scoreSheetVersionId must not be null");

        ReviewSubmission sub = new ReviewSubmission();
        sub.submissionId = submissionId;
        sub.caseId = caseId;
        sub.stage = ReviewStage.INITIAL;
        sub.reviewerId = reviewerId;
        sub.status = SubmissionStatus.DRAFT;
        sub.revisionNo = 1;
        sub.answerSet = new ArrayList<>();
        sub.totalScore = BigDecimal.ZERO;
        sub.basedOnScoreSheetVersionId = scoreSheetVersionId;
        sub.createdAt = LocalDateTime.now();
        sub.updatedAt = sub.createdAt;
        return sub;
    }

    /**
     * Create a rereview draft submission.
     * Called by StartRereviewUseCase.
     */
    public static ReviewSubmission createRereviewDraft(String submissionId, String caseId, String reviewerId) {
        ReviewSubmission s = new ReviewSubmission();
        s.submissionId = submissionId;
        s.caseId = caseId;
        s.reviewerId = reviewerId;
        s.stage = ReviewStage.REREVIEW;
        s.status = SubmissionStatus.DRAFT;
        s.revisionNo = 1;
        s.answerSet = new ArrayList<>();
        s.createdAt = LocalDateTime.now();
        s.updatedAt = LocalDateTime.now();
        return s;
    }

    /**
     * Reconstitute from persistence. No business validation.
     */
    public static ReviewSubmission reconstitute(
            String submissionId, String caseId, ReviewStage stage,
            String reviewerId, SubmissionStatus status, int revisionNo,
            List<AnswerItem> answerSet, BigDecimal totalScore,
            String comment, LocalDateTime submittedAt,
            String basedOnScoreSheetVersionId,
            String supersededBySubmissionId,
            String attachmentRefsJson,
            LocalDateTime createdAt, LocalDateTime updatedAt) {
        ReviewSubmission sub = new ReviewSubmission();
        sub.submissionId = submissionId;
        sub.caseId = caseId;
        sub.stage = stage;
        sub.reviewerId = reviewerId;
        sub.status = status;
        sub.revisionNo = revisionNo;
        sub.answerSet = answerSet != null ? new ArrayList<>(answerSet) : new ArrayList<>();
        sub.totalScore = totalScore;
        sub.comment = comment;
        sub.submittedAt = submittedAt;
        sub.basedOnScoreSheetVersionId = basedOnScoreSheetVersionId;
        sub.supersededBySubmissionId = supersededBySubmissionId;
        sub.attachmentRefsJson = attachmentRefsJson;
        sub.createdAt = createdAt;
        sub.updatedAt = updatedAt;
        return sub;
    }

    /**
     * Update draft answers and score. Can be called multiple times while in DRAFT.
     */
    public void updateDraft(List<AnswerItem> scoredAnswers, BigDecimal totalScore, String comment) {
        requireDraft();
        Objects.requireNonNull(scoredAnswers, "scoredAnswers must not be null");
        Objects.requireNonNull(totalScore, "totalScore must not be null");
        this.answerSet = new ArrayList<>(scoredAnswers);
        this.totalScore = totalScore;
        this.comment = comment;
        this.updatedAt = LocalDateTime.now();
    }

    /**
     * Submit this draft. Transitions DRAFT → SUBMITTED. Irreversible.
     */
    public void submit() {
        requireDraft();
        this.status = SubmissionStatus.SUBMITTED;
        this.submittedAt = LocalDateTime.now();
        this.updatedAt = LocalDateTime.now();
    }

    /**
     * Create a revision from an existing SUBMITTED submission.
     * The new submission is directly SUBMITTED (no DRAFT phase for revisions).
     */
    public static ReviewSubmission createRevision(
            String newSubmissionId,
            ReviewSubmission oldSubmission,
            List<AnswerItem> scoredAnswers,
            BigDecimal totalScore,
            String comment) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(newSubmissionId, "newSubmissionId must not be null");
        Objects.requireNonNull(oldSubmission, "oldSubmission must not be null");
        Objects.requireNonNull(scoredAnswers, "scoredAnswers must not be null");
        Objects.requireNonNull(totalScore, "totalScore must not be null");

        if (oldSubmission.status != SubmissionStatus.SUBMITTED) {
            throw new DomainStateConflictException("SUBMISSION_NOT_SUBMITTED",
                    "Can only revise a SUBMITTED submission. Current: " + oldSubmission.status);
        }

        ReviewSubmission rev = new ReviewSubmission();
        rev.submissionId = newSubmissionId;
        rev.caseId = oldSubmission.caseId;
        rev.stage = oldSubmission.stage;
        rev.reviewerId = oldSubmission.reviewerId;
        rev.status = SubmissionStatus.SUBMITTED;
        rev.revisionNo = oldSubmission.revisionNo + 1;
        rev.answerSet = new ArrayList<>(scoredAnswers);
        rev.totalScore = totalScore;
        rev.comment = comment;
        rev.submittedAt = LocalDateTime.now();
        rev.basedOnScoreSheetVersionId = oldSubmission.basedOnScoreSheetVersionId;
        rev.createdAt = LocalDateTime.now();
        rev.updatedAt = rev.createdAt;
        return rev;
    }

    /**
     * Mark this submission as SUPERSEDED by a newer revision.
     * Only SUBMITTED submissions can be superseded.
     */
    public void markSuperseded(String newSubmissionId) {
        if (this.status != SubmissionStatus.SUBMITTED) {
            throw new DomainStateConflictException("SUBMISSION_NOT_SUBMITTED",
                    "Can only supersede a SUBMITTED submission. Current: " + this.status);
        }
        Objects.requireNonNull(newSubmissionId, "newSubmissionId must not be null");
        this.supersededBySubmissionId = newSubmissionId;
        this.status = SubmissionStatus.SUPERSEDED;
        this.updatedAt = LocalDateTime.now();
    }

    private void requireDraft() {
        if (this.status != SubmissionStatus.DRAFT) {
            throw new DomainStateConflictException("SUBMISSION_NOT_DRAFT",
                    "Submission must be in DRAFT status. Current: " + this.status);
        }
    }

    // --- Getters ---

    public String getSubmissionId() { return submissionId; }
    public String getCaseId() { return caseId; }
    public ReviewStage getStage() { return stage; }
    public String getReviewerId() { return reviewerId; }
    public SubmissionStatus getStatus() { return status; }
    public int getRevisionNo() { return revisionNo; }
    public List<AnswerItem> getAnswerSet() { return Collections.unmodifiableList(answerSet != null ? answerSet : Collections.emptyList()); }
    public BigDecimal getTotalScore() { return totalScore; }
    public String getComment() { return comment; }
    public LocalDateTime getSubmittedAt() { return submittedAt; }
    public String getBasedOnScoreSheetVersionId() { return basedOnScoreSheetVersionId; }
    public String getSupersededBySubmissionId() { return supersededBySubmissionId; }
    public String getAttachmentRefsJson() { return attachmentRefsJson; }
    public LocalDateTime getCreatedAt() { return createdAt; }
    public LocalDateTime getUpdatedAt() { return updatedAt; }
}
```

```
package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase;

import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.ActorContext;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.DomainEventPublisher;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.DomainRole;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase.command.SubmitRereviewCommand;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.DomainRuleViolationException;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.ResourceNotFoundException;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.project.ProjectVersion;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.project.ReviewProject;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.project.ReviewProjectRepository;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCase;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCaseRepository;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.event.RereviewSubmittedEvent;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.AnswerItem;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewSubmission;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewSubmissionRepository;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.scoresheet.ScoreSheetDefinition;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.scoresheet.ScoreSheetRepository;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

@Service
public class SubmitRereviewUseCase {

    private final ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository;
    private final ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository;
    private final ReviewProjectRepository projectRepository;
    private final ScoreSheetRepository scoreSheetRepository;
    private final DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher;
    private final ScoreCalculationService scoreCalculationService;

    public SubmitRereviewUseCase(ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository,
                                  ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository,
                                  ReviewProjectRepository projectRepository,
                                  ScoreSheetRepository scoreSheetRepository,
                                  DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher,
                                  ScoreCalculationService scoreCalculationService) {
        this.caseRepository = caseRepository;
        this.submissionRepository = submissionRepository;
        this.projectRepository = projectRepository;
        this.scoreSheetRepository = scoreSheetRepository;
        this.eventPublisher = eventPublisher;
        this.scoreCalculationService = scoreCalculationService;
    }

    @Transactional
    public void execute(ActorContext actor, SubmitRereviewCommand cmd) {
        actor.requireRole(DomainRole.REREVIEWER);

        ReviewCase reviewCase = caseRepository.findById(cmd.getCaseId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewCase", cmd.getCaseId()));

        // Validate actor is the assigned rereviewer
        if (reviewCase.getRereviewerAssignment() == null
                || !actor.getUserId().equals(reviewCase.getRereviewerAssignment().getReviewerId())) {
            throw new DomainRuleViolationException("NOT_ASSIGNED_REREVIEWER",
                    "Only the assigned rereviewer can submit this rereview");
        }

        ReviewSubmission submission = submissionRepository.findById(cmd.getSubmissionId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewSubmission", cmd.getSubmissionId()));

        // Load score sheet for scoring
        ScoreSheetDefinition scoreSheet = scoreSheetRepository
                .findById(reviewCase.getScoreSheetVersionRef())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ScoreSheetDefinition",
                        reviewCase.getScoreSheetVersionRef()));

        // Get current answers (from command if provided, else from draft)
        List<AnswerItem> currentAnswers = cmd.getAnswers() != null
                ? cmd.getAnswers()
                : submission.getAnswerSet();

        // Calculate scores server-side
        List<AnswerItem> rawItems = currentAnswers.stream()
                .map(a -> AnswerItem.ofRaw(a.getItemId(), a.getAnswerValue()))
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
        ScoreResult result = scoreCalculationService.calculate(rawItems, scoreSheet);

        // Update draft with scored answers, then submit
        submission.updateDraft(result.getScoredAnswers(), result.getTotalScore(), cmd.getComment());
        submission.submit();
        submissionRepository.save(submission);

        // Load project for weights
        ReviewProject project = projectRepository.findById(reviewCase.getProjectId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewProject", reviewCase.getProjectId()));
        ProjectVersion version = project.getCurrentVersion();

        // Complete rereview with weighted final score
        reviewCase.completeRereview(
                result.getTotalScore(),
                version.getInitialReviewWeight(),
                version.getRereviewWeight());
        caseRepository.save(reviewCase);

        eventPublisher.publish(new RereviewSubmittedEvent(
                this, actor.getUserId(), actor.getUserName(), reviewCase.getHospitalId(),
                reviewCase.getCaseId(),
                String.format("{\"rereviewScore\":%s,\"finalScore\":%s}",
                        result.getTotalScore(), reviewCase.getFinalScore())));
    }
}
```

```
    private static final String REREVIEWER_ID = "rereviewer-1";

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        caseRepo = new InMemoryReviewCaseRepository();
        submissionRepo = new InMemoryReviewSubmissionRepository();
        projectRepo = new InMemoryReviewProjectRepository();

        eventPublisher = new CapturingDomainEventPublisher();

    private ActorContext rereviewerActor() {
        return new ActorContext(REREVIEWER_ID, "ReReviewer",
                EnumSet.of(DomainRole.REREVIEWER), Optional.of(HOSPITAL_ID));

    private void seedProject() {
        // Use reconstitute to seed project with scoring config (threshold=80, 50/50 weights)
        ReviewProject project = ReviewProject.reconstitute(
                PROJECT_ID, HOSPITAL_ID, "Test Project", null, SCORE_SHEET_ID,
                null, ProjectStatus.ACTIVE, 1, true,
                new BigDecimal("80"), new BigDecimal("0.5"), new BigDecimal("0.5"));
        projectRepo.save(project);
    }

    private void seedScoreSheet() {
        ScoreSheetDefinition ss = ScoreSheetDefinition.createDraft(SCORE_SHEET_ID, PROJECT_ID);
        ScoreSheetSection section = new ScoreSheetSection("sec-1", "Section 1");
        section.addItem(new ScoreItem("Q001", "Q001", "Bool Question", ScoreType.BOOLEAN,
                new BigDecimal("10"), new BigDecimal("1.0"),
                RequiredRule.ALWAYS_REQUIRED, null));
        section.addItem(new ScoreItem("Q002", "Q002", "Range Question", ScoreType.RANGE,
                new BigDecimal("20"), new BigDecimal("0.5"),
                RequiredRule.OPTIONAL, null));
        ss.addSection(section);
        ss.publishVersion();
        scoreSheetRepo.save(ss);
    }

    private void seedRereviewInProgressCase() {
        ReviewCase rc = ReviewCase.createFromSampling(
                CASE_ID, "b1", PROJECT_ID, HOSPITAL_ID, "SK-001", MedicalRecordType.OUTPATIENT);
        rc.assignReviewer("reviewer-1", LocalDateTime.now());
        rc.startInitialReview("sub-init", SCORE_SHEET_ID);
        rc.completeInitialReview(new BigDecimal("90"), new BigDecimal("80"));
        // score 90 > threshold 80 → PENDING_REREVIEW
        rc.assignRereviewer(REREVIEWER_ID, LocalDateTime.of(2026, 6, 30, 23, 59));
        rc.startRereview(REREVIEWER_ID);
        caseRepo.save(rc);
    }

    private void seedRereviewDraftWithAnswers() {
        ReviewSubmission draft = ReviewSubmission.createRereviewDraft(
                SUBMISSION_ID, CASE_ID, REREVIEWER_ID);
        List<AnswerItem> answers = Arrays.asList(
                AnswerItem.ofScored("Q001", "true", new BigDecimal("10.0")),
                AnswerItem.ofScored("Q002", "15", new BigDecimal("7.5"))
        );
        draft.updateDraft(answers, new BigDecimal("17.5"), "rereview comment");
        submissionRepo.save(draft);
    }

    @Test
    void execute_happyPath_shouldCloseWithWeightedScore() {
        seedProject();
        seedScoreSheet();
        seedRereviewInProgressCase();
        seedRereviewDraftWithAnswers();

        SubmitRereviewCommand cmd = new SubmitRereviewCommand();
        cmd.setCaseId(CASE_ID);
        cmd.setSubmissionId(SUBMISSION_ID);
        // Don't pass answers — use existing draft answers

        useCase.execute(rereviewerActor(), cmd);

        ReviewCase saved = caseRepo.findById(CASE_ID).orElseThrow();
        assertEquals(CaseStatus.CLOSED, saved.getStatus());
        assertNotNull(saved.getFinalScore());
        assertNotNull(saved.getClosedAt());

        // finalScore = initialScore(90) * 0.5 + rereviewScore * 0.5
        // rereviewScore = Q001(10*1.0=10) + Q002(15*0.5=7.5) = 17.5
        // finalScore = 90*0.5 + 17.5*0.5 = 45 + 8.75 = 53.75
        assertEquals(0, saved.getFinalScore().compareTo(new BigDecimal("53.75")));

        ReviewSubmission sub = submissionRepo.findById(SUBMISSION_ID).orElseThrow();
        assertEquals(SubmissionStatus.SUBMITTED, sub.getStatus());
        assertTrue(eventPublisher.events.size() >= 1);
    }

    @Test

        seedProject();
        seedScoreSheet();
        seedRereviewInProgressCase();
        seedRereviewDraftWithAnswers();

        SubmitRereviewCommand cmd = new SubmitRereviewCommand();
        cmd.setCaseId(CASE_ID);
        cmd.setSubmissionId(SUBMISSION_ID);

        ActorContext wrongActor = new ActorContext("someone-else", "Other",
                EnumSet.of(DomainRole.REREVIEWER), Optional.of(HOSPITAL_ID));
        assertThrows(Exception.class, () -> useCase.execute(wrongActor, cmd));
    }

    @Test
    void execute_nonRereviewer_shouldThrow() {
        seedProject();
        seedScoreSheet();
        seedRereviewInProgressCase();
        seedRereviewDraftWithAnswers();

        SubmitRereviewCommand cmd = new SubmitRereviewCommand();
        cmd.setCaseId(CASE_ID);
        cmd.setSubmissionId(SUBMISSION_ID);

        ActorContext reviewer = new ActorContext(REREVIEWER_ID, "Reviewer",
                EnumSet.of(DomainRole.REVIEWER), Optional.of(HOSPITAL_ID));
        assertThrows(UnauthorizedException.class, () -> useCase.execute(reviewer, cmd));
    }
}
```

```
package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.testfixture;

import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewStage;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewSubmission;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewSubmissionRepository;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

public class InMemoryReviewSubmissionRepository implements ReviewSubmissionRepository {
    public final Map<String, ReviewSubmission> store = new LinkedHashMap<>();

    @Override
    public void save(ReviewSubmission submission) {
        store.put(submission.getSubmissionId(), submission);
    }

    @Override
    public Optional<ReviewSubmission> findById(String submissionId) {
        return Optional.ofNullable(store.get(submissionId));
    }

    @Override
    public List<ReviewSubmission> findByCaseIdAndStage(String caseId, ReviewStage stage) {
        return store.values().stream()
                .filter(s -> caseId.equals(s.getCaseId()) && s.getStage() == stage)
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    @Override
    public Optional<ReviewSubmission> findLatestByCaseIdAndStage(String caseId, ReviewStage stage) {
        List<ReviewSubmission> matching = findByCaseIdAndStage(caseId, stage);
        return matching.isEmpty() ? Optional.empty() : Optional.of(matching.get(matching.size() - 1));
    }

    @Override
    public List<ReviewSubmission> findAllByCaseId(String caseId) {
        return store.values().stream()
                .filter(s -> caseId.equals(s.getCaseId()))
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }
}
```
