public class ReviewCaseController {

    private final AssignReviewCaseUseCase assignUseCase;
    private final ReassignReviewCaseUseCase reassignUseCase;
    private final CancelReviewCaseUseCase cancelUseCase;
    private final ReturnInitialReviewUseCase returnUseCase;
    private final ReopenInitialReviewUseCase reopenUseCase;
    private final StartInitialReviewUseCase startInitialReviewUseCase;
    private final SaveInitialReviewDraftUseCase saveInitialReviewDraftUseCase;
    private final SubmitInitialReviewUseCase submitInitialReviewUseCase;
    private final ReviseInitialReviewUseCase reviseInitialReviewUseCase;
    private final GetRevisionHistoryUseCase getRevisionHistoryUseCase;

    public ReviewCaseController(AssignReviewCaseUseCase assignUseCase,
                                 ReassignReviewCaseUseCase reassignUseCase,
                                 CancelReviewCaseUseCase cancelUseCase,
                                 ReturnInitialReviewUseCase returnUseCase,
                                 ReopenInitialReviewUseCase reopenUseCase,
                                 StartInitialReviewUseCase startInitialReviewUseCase,
                                 SaveInitialReviewDraftUseCase saveInitialReviewDraftUseCase,
                                 SubmitInitialReviewUseCase submitInitialReviewUseCase,
                                 ReviseInitialReviewUseCase reviseInitialReviewUseCase,
                                 GetRevisionHistoryUseCase getRevisionHistoryUseCase) {
        this.assignUseCase = assignUseCase;
        this.reassignUseCase = reassignUseCase;
        this.cancelUseCase = cancelUseCase;
        this.returnUseCase = returnUseCase;
        this.reopenUseCase = reopenUseCase;
        this.startInitialReviewUseCase = startInitialReviewUseCase;
        this.saveInitialReviewDraftUseCase = saveInitialReviewDraftUseCase;
        this.submitInitialReviewUseCase = submitInitialReviewUseCase;
        this.reviseInitialReviewUseCase = reviseInitialReviewUseCase;
        this.getRevisionHistoryUseCase = getRevisionHistoryUseCase;
    }

    @PostMapping("/{caseId}/assign-reviewer")
    public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<Void>> assignReviewer(
            @CurrentActor ActorContext actor,
            @PathVariable String caseId,
            @Valid @RequestBody AssignReviewerRequest request) {
        assignUseCase.execute(actor, caseId, request.getReviewerId(), request.getDueAt());
        return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.ok(null));
    }

    @PostMapping("/{caseId}/reassign-reviewer")
    public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<Void>> reassignReviewer(
            @CurrentActor ActorContext actor,
            @PathVariable String caseId,
            @Valid @RequestBody ReassignReviewerRequest request) {
        reassignUseCase.execute(actor, caseId, request.getReviewerId(), request.getDueAt());
        return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.ok(null));
    }

    @PostMapping("/{caseId}/cancel")
    public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<Void>> cancel(
            @CurrentActor ActorContext actor,
            @PathVariable String caseId,
            @Valid @RequestBody CancelReviewCaseRequest request) {
        cancelUseCase.execute(actor, caseId, request.getReason());
        return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.ok(null));
    }

    @PostMapping("/{caseId}/return")
    public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<Void>> returnCase(
            @CurrentActor ActorContext actor,
            @PathVariable String caseId,
            @Valid @RequestBody ReturnReviewCaseRequest request) {
        returnUseCase.execute(actor, caseId, request.getReason());
        return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.ok(null));
    }

    @PostMapping("/{caseId}/reopen")
    public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<Void>> reopen(
            @CurrentActor ActorContext actor,
            @PathVariable String caseId) {
        reopenUseCase.execute(actor, caseId);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.ok(null));
    }

    // --- B3b endpoints ---

    @PostMapping("/{caseId}/start-initial-review")
    public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<StartInitialReviewResponse>> startInitialReview(
            @CurrentActor ActorContext actor,
            @PathVariable String caseId) {
        String submissionId = startInitialReviewUseCase.execute(actor, caseId);
        return ResponseEntity
                .status(HttpStatus.CREATED)
                .body(ApiResponse.ok(new StartInitialReviewResponse(submissionId)));
    }

    @PostMapping("/{caseId}/initial-review/save-draft")
    public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<SaveDraftResponse>> saveInitialReviewDraft(
            @CurrentActor ActorContext actor,
            @PathVariable String caseId,
            @Valid @RequestBody SaveInitialReviewDraftRequest request) {
        List<AnswerInput> answers = request.getAnswers().stream()
                .filter(Objects::nonNull)
                .map(dto -> new AnswerInput(dto.getItemId(), dto.getAnswerValue()))
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
        BigDecimal totalScore = saveInitialReviewDraftUseCase.execute(
                actor, caseId, answers, request.getComment());
        return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.ok(new SaveDraftResponse(totalScore)));
    }

    @PostMapping("/{caseId}/initial-review/submit")
    public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<Void>> submitInitialReview(
            @CurrentActor ActorContext actor,
            @PathVariable String caseId) {
        submitInitialReviewUseCase.execute(actor, caseId);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.ok(null));
    }

    // --- B3c endpoints ---

    @PostMapping("/{caseId}/submissions/{submissionId}/revise")
    public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<RevisionResultResponse>> reviseInitialReview(
            @CurrentActor ActorContext actor,
            @PathVariable String caseId,
            @PathVariable String submissionId,
            @Valid @RequestBody ReviseInitialReviewRequest request) {
        List<AnswerInput> answers =
                request.getAnswers().stream()
                        .filter(Objects::nonNull)
                        .map(dto -> new AnswerInput(dto.getItemId(), dto.getAnswerValue()))
                        .collect(Collectors.toList());
        RevisionResult result = reviseInitialReviewUseCase.execute(
                actor, caseId, submissionId, answers, request.getComment());
        return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.ok(new RevisionResultResponse(
                result.getNewSubmissionId(), result.getRevisionNo(),
                result.getTotalScore(), result.getStatus())));
    }

    @GetMapping("/{caseId}/revision-history")
    public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<RevisionHistoryResponse>> getRevisionHistory(
            @CurrentActor ActorContext actor,
            @PathVariable String caseId) {
        List<ReviewSubmission> submissions =
                getRevisionHistoryUseCase.execute(actor, caseId);
        List<SubmissionSummaryDto> dtos = submissions.stream()
                .map(s -> new SubmissionSummaryDto(
                        s.getSubmissionId(), s.getStage().name(), s.getReviewerId(),
                        s.getStatus().name(), s.getRevisionNo(), s.getTotalScore(),
                        s.getComment(), s.getSubmittedAt(), s.getSupersededBySubmissionId()))
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
        return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.ok(new RevisionHistoryResponse(caseId, dtos)));
    }
}

package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import java.util.Base64;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Generates unsigned test JWTs for @SpringBootTest integration tests.
 * The service does not re-verify the JWT signature (gateway already did),
 * so a fake signature is accepted.
 */
public class TestTokenFactory {

    private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();
    public static final String DEFAULT_HOSPITAL_ID = "H001";

    /** Returns a JWT with HOSPITAL_MANAGER role and default hospitalId (H001). */
    public static String hospitalManagerToken() {
        return hospitalManagerToken(DEFAULT_HOSPITAL_ID);
    }

    /** Returns a JWT with HOSPITAL_MANAGER role and specified hospitalId. */
    public static String hospitalManagerToken(String hospitalId) {
        return buildToken("u-test-01", "Test Manager", hospitalId,
                Map.of("role_name", "hospital_manager", "enabled", true));
    }

    /** Returns a JWT with SYSTEM_ADMIN role and specified hospitalId. */
    public static String systemAdminToken(String hospitalId) {
        return buildToken("u-admin-01", "Test Admin", hospitalId,
                Map.of("role_name", "system_admin", "enabled", true));
    }

    /** Returns a JWT with SYSTEM_ADMIN role and default hospitalId (H001). */
    public static String systemAdminToken() {
        return systemAdminToken(DEFAULT_HOSPITAL_ID);
    }

    /** Returns a JWT with an unknown role (no DomainRole match). */
    public static String unknownRoleToken() {
        return buildToken("u-unknown", "Unknown Role User", null,
                Map.of("role_name", "unknown_role", "enabled", true));
    }

    /** Returns a JWT with REVIEWER role and specified userId + hospitalId. */
    public static String reviewerToken(String userId, String hospitalId) {
        return buildToken(userId, "Test Reviewer", hospitalId,
                Map.of("role_name", "reviewer", "enabled", true));
    }

    /** Returns a JWT with REVIEWER role, default userId and hospitalId. */
    public static String reviewerToken() {
        return reviewerToken("reviewer-1", DEFAULT_HOSPITAL_ID);
    }

    private static String buildToken(String userId, String userName,
                                     String hospitalId, Map<String, Object> role) {
        try {
            String header = base64url(MAPPER.writeValueAsString(
                    Map.of("alg", "RS512", "typ", "JWT")));

            // Build user object — use LinkedHashMap to allow null values
            Map<String, Object> userObj = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            userObj.put("user_id", userId);
            userObj.put("user_name", userName);
            userObj.put("user_role", new Object[]{role});
            if (hospitalId != null) {
                userObj.put("hospital_id", hospitalId);
            }
            String tzUserJson = MAPPER.writeValueAsString(Map.of("user", userObj));

            String payloadJson = MAPPER.writeValueAsString(Map.of(
                    "iss", "api-gateway",
                    "tz-user", tzUserJson
            ));
            String payload = base64url(payloadJson);

            return header + "." + payload + ".test-sig";
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Failed to build test token", e);
        }
    }

    private static String base64url(String json) {
        return Base64.getUrlEncoder().withoutPadding().encodeToString(json.getBytes());
    }
}

package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.interfaces.rest.dto;

import javax.validation.Valid;
import javax.validation.constraints.NotBlank;
import javax.validation.constraints.NotNull;
import javax.validation.constraints.Size;
import java.util.List;

public class SaveInitialReviewDraftRequest {

    @NotNull(message = "answers must not be null")
    @Valid
    private List<AnswerInputDto> answers;

    private String comment;

    public List<AnswerInputDto> getAnswers() {
        return answers;
    }

        }

        public String getItemId() {
            return itemId;
        }

        public void setItemId(String itemId) {
            this.itemId = itemId;
        }

        public String getAnswerValue() {
            return answerValue;
        }

        public void setAnswerValue(String answerValue) {
            this.answerValue = answerValue;
        }
    }

# Task 18: Create ReviseRereviewUseCase

You are implementing **Task 18** of the B4 (Re-review Operations & Closure) plan for a Quality Inspection system.

## What this does

The rereview revision use case. Per D-021, CLOSED cases are allowed rereview revision (not CANCELLED). It creates a new revision of the rereview submission and recalculates the weighted final score. This is the "append-only revision" pattern — old submission is marked SUPERSEDED, new revision is directly SUBMITTED.

## Working directory

```
cd /Users/tsengeagle/source/quality-inspection/services/quality-inspection-service
```

## Files to create

1. `src/main/java/com/tzuchi/his/quality/inspection/application/reviewcase/command/ReviseRereviewCommand.java`
2. `src/main/java/com/tzuchi/his/quality/inspection/application/reviewcase/ReviseRereviewUseCase.java`
3. `src/test/java/com/tzuchi/his/quality/inspection/application/reviewcase/ReviseRereviewUseCaseTest.java`

## TDD workflow

1. Write the command DTO
2. Write failing tests
3. Implement the use case
4. Run tests: `./gradlew test --tests "*.ReviseRereviewUseCaseTest"`
5. Run full suite: `./gradlew test`
6. Commit

## ⚠️ CRITICAL API CORRECTIONS — the plan has many wrong signatures. Use these:

### ActorContext constructor (application.common package)
```java
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.ActorContext;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.DomainRole;
// Constructor:
new ActorContext("userId", "userName", EnumSet.of(DomainRole.REREVIEWER), Optional.of("H001"))
```

### ReviewSubmission.createRevision — STATIC method, 5 args, creates DIRECTLY SUBMITTED revision
```java
ReviewSubmission revision = ReviewSubmission.createRevision(
    newSubmissionId,     // String
    oldSubmission,       // ReviewSubmission (must be SUBMITTED)
    scoredAnswers,       // List<AnswerItem>
    totalScore,          // BigDecimal
    comment              // String
);
```

### After creating revision, mark old submission superseded:
```java
oldSubmission.markSuperseded(newSubmissionId);
submissionRepo.save(oldSubmission);
submissionRepo.save(revision);
```

### ScoreCalculationService — use this, not scoreSheet.calculateScore()

## Use case logic flow

1. `actor.requireRole(DomainRole.REREVIEWER)`
2. Load ReviewCase, validate actor is the assigned rereviewer
3. Load old ReviewSubmission by cmd.getSubmissionId()
4. Load ScoreSheetDefinition via `reviewCase.getScoreSheetVersionRef()`
5. Build raw AnswerItem list from cmd answers
6. Calculate scores via `ScoreCalculationService.calculate(rawItems, scoreSheet)`
7. Create revision: `ReviewSubmission.createRevision(newId, oldSubmission, scoredAnswers, totalScore, comment)`
8. Mark old submission superseded: `oldSubmission.markSuperseded(newId)`
9. Save both old and new submissions
10. Load ReviewProject, get weights from `getCurrentVersion()`
11. `reviewCase.updateFinalScoreForRereview(result.getTotalScore(), version.getInitialReviewWeight(), version.getRereviewWeight())`
12. Save case
13. Publish `RereviewRevisedEvent`

```java
package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase;

import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.ActorContext;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.DomainEventPublisher;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.DomainRole;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase.command.SubmitRereviewCommand;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.DomainRuleViolationException;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.ResourceNotFoundException;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.project.ProjectVersion;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.project.ReviewProject;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.project.ReviewProjectRepository;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCase;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCaseRepository;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.event.RereviewSubmittedEvent;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.AnswerItem;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewSubmission;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewSubmissionRepository;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.scoresheet.ScoreSheetDefinition;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.scoresheet.ScoreSheetRepository;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

@Service
public class SubmitRereviewUseCase {
    private final ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository;
    private final ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository;
    private final ReviewProjectRepository projectRepository;
    private final ScoreSheetRepository scoreSheetRepository;
    private final DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher;
    private final ScoreCalculationService scoreCalculationService;

    public SubmitRereviewUseCase(ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository,
                                  ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository,
                                  ReviewProjectRepository projectRepository,
                                  ScoreSheetRepository scoreSheetRepository,
                                  DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher,
                                  ScoreCalculationService scoreCalculationService) {
        this.caseRepository = caseRepository;
        this.submissionRepository = submissionRepository;
        this.projectRepository = projectRepository;
        this.scoreSheetRepository = scoreSheetRepository;
        this.eventPublisher = eventPublisher;
        this.scoreCalculationService = scoreCalculationService;
    }

    @Transactional
    public void execute(ActorContext actor, SubmitRereviewCommand cmd) {
        actor.requireRole(DomainRole.REREVIEWER);
        ReviewCase reviewCase = caseRepository.findById(cmd.getCaseId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewCase", cmd.getCaseId()));
        if (reviewCase.getRereviewerAssignment() == null
                || !actor.getUserId().equals(reviewCase.getRereviewerAssignment().getReviewerId())) {
            throw new DomainRuleViolationException("NOT_ASSIGNED_REREVIEWER",
                    "Only the assigned rereviewer can submit this rereview");
        }
        ReviewSubmission submission = submissionRepository.findById(cmd.getSubmissionId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewSubmission", cmd.getSubmissionId()));
        ScoreSheetDefinition scoreSheet = scoreSheetRepository
                .findById(reviewCase.getScoreSheetVersionRef())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ScoreSheetDefinition", reviewCase.getScoreSheetVersionRef()));
        List<AnswerItem> currentAnswers = cmd.getAnswers() != null ? cmd.getAnswers() : submission.getAnswerSet();
        List<AnswerItem> rawItems = currentAnswers.stream()
                .map(a -> AnswerItem.ofRaw(a.getItemId(), a.getAnswerValue()))
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
        ScoreResult result = scoreCalculationService.calculate(rawItems, scoreSheet);
        submission.updateDraft(result.getScoredAnswers(), result.getTotalScore(), cmd.getComment());
        submission.submit();
        submissionRepository.save(submission);
        ReviewProject project = projectRepository.findById(reviewCase.getProjectId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewProject", reviewCase.getProjectId()));
        ProjectVersion version = project.getCurrentVersion();
        reviewCase.completeRereview(result.getTotalScore(), version.getInitialReviewWeight(), version.getRereviewWeight());
        caseRepository.save(reviewCase);
        eventPublisher.publish(new RereviewSubmittedEvent(
                this, actor.getUserId(), actor.getUserName(), reviewCase.getHospitalId(),
                reviewCase.getCaseId(),
                String.format("{\"rereviewScore\":%s,\"finalScore\":%s}", result.getTotalScore(), reviewCase.getFinalScore())));
    }
}
```

```java
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;

class SubmitRereviewUseCaseTest {
    private InMemoryReviewCaseRepository caseRepo;
    private InMemoryReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepo;
    private InMemoryReviewProjectRepository projectRepo;
    private InMemoryScoreSheetRepository scoreSheetRepo;
    private CapturingDomainEventPublisher eventPublisher;
    private SubmitRereviewUseCase useCase;

    private static final String CASE_ID = "c1";
    private static final String SUBMISSION_ID = "sub-r1";
    private static final String PROJECT_ID = "p1";
    private static final String HOSPITAL_ID = "H001";
    private static final String SCORE_SHEET_ID = "ss-1";
    private static final String REREVIEWER_ID = "rereviewer-1";

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        caseRepo = new InMemoryReviewCaseRepository();
        submissionRepo = new InMemoryReviewSubmissionRepository();
        projectRepo = new InMemoryReviewProjectRepository();
        scoreSheetRepo = new InMemoryScoreSheetRepository();
        eventPublisher = new CapturingDomainEventPublisher();
        ScoreCalculationService scoreCalcService = new ScoreCalculationService();
        useCase = new SubmitRereviewUseCase(caseRepo, submissionRepo, projectRepo, scoreSheetRepo, eventPublisher, scoreCalcService);
    }

    private ActorContext rereviewerActor() {
        return new ActorContext(REREVIEWER_ID, "ReReviewer", EnumSet.of(DomainRole.REREVIEWER), Optional.of(HOSPITAL_ID));
    }

    private void seedProject() {
        ReviewProject project = ReviewProject.reconstitute(
                PROJECT_ID, HOSPITAL_ID, "Test Project", null, SCORE_SHEET_ID,
                null, ProjectStatus.ACTIVE, 1, true,
                new BigDecimal("80"), new BigDecimal("0.5"), new BigDecimal("0.5"));
        projectRepo.save(project);
    }

    private void seedScoreSheet() {
        ScoreSheetDefinition ss = ScoreSheetDefinition.createDraft(SCORE_SHEET_ID, PROJECT_ID);
        ScoreSheetSection section = new ScoreSheetSection("sec-1", "Section 1");
        section.addItem(new ScoreItem("Q001", "Q001", "Bool Question", ScoreType.BOOLEAN,
                new BigDecimal("10"), new BigDecimal("1.0"), RequiredRule.ALWAYS_REQUIRED, null));
        section.addItem(new ScoreItem("Q002", "Q002", "Range Question", ScoreType.RANGE,
                new BigDecimal("20"), new BigDecimal("0.5"), RequiredRule.OPTIONAL, null));
        ss.addSection(section);
        ss.publishVersion();
        scoreSheetRepo.save(ss);
    }

    private void seedRereviewInProgressCase() {
        ReviewCase rc = ReviewCase.createFromSampling(CASE_ID, "b1", PROJECT_ID, HOSPITAL_ID, "SK-001", MedicalRecordType.OUTPATIENT);
        rc.assignReviewer("reviewer-1", LocalDateTime.now());
        rc.startInitialReview("sub-init", SCORE_SHEET_ID);
        rc.completeInitialReview(new BigDecimal("90"), new BigDecimal("80"));
        rc.assignRereviewer(REREVIEWER_ID, LocalDateTime.of(2026, 6, 30, 23, 59));
        rc.startRereview(REREVIEWER_ID);
        caseRepo.save(rc);
    }

    private void seedRereviewDraftWithAnswers() {
        ReviewSubmission draft = ReviewSubmission.createRereviewDraft(SUBMISSION_ID, CASE_ID, REREVIEWER_ID);
        List<AnswerItem> answers = Arrays.asList(
                AnswerItem.ofScored("Q001", "true", new BigDecimal("10.0")),
                AnswerItem.ofScored("Q002", "15", new BigDecimal("7.5")));
        draft.updateDraft(answers, new BigDecimal("17.5"), "rereview comment");
        submissionRepo.save(draft);
    }

    @Test
    void execute_happyPath_shouldCloseWithWeightedScore() {
        seedProject(); seedScoreSheet(); seedRereviewInProgressCase(); seedRereviewDraftWithAnswers();
        SubmitRereviewCommand cmd = new SubmitRereviewCommand();
        cmd.setCaseId(CASE_ID); cmd.setSubmissionId(SUBMISSION_ID);
        useCase.execute(rereviewerActor(), cmd);
        ReviewCase saved = caseRepo.findById(CASE_ID).orElseThrow();
        assertEquals(CaseStatus.CLOSED, saved.getStatus());
        assertEquals(0, saved.getFinalScore().compareTo(new BigDecimal("53.75")));
        ReviewSubmission sub = submissionRepo.findById(SUBMISSION_ID).orElseThrow();
        assertEquals(SubmissionStatus.SUBMITTED, sub.getStatus());
        assertTrue(eventPublisher.events.size() >= 1);
    }

    @Test
    void execute_wrongActor_shouldThrow() {
        seedProject(); seedScoreSheet(); seedRereviewInProgressCase(); seedRereviewDraftWithAnswers();
        SubmitRereviewCommand cmd = new SubmitRereviewCommand();
        cmd.setCaseId(CASE_ID); cmd.setSubmissionId(SUBMISSION_ID);
        ActorContext wrongActor = new ActorContext("someone-else", "Other", EnumSet.of(DomainRole.REREVIEWER), Optional.of(HOSPITAL_ID));
        assertThrows(Exception.class, () -> useCase.execute(wrongActor, cmd));
    }

    @Test
    void execute_nonRereviewer_shouldThrow() {
        seedProject(); seedScoreSheet(); seedRereviewInProgressCase(); seedRereviewDraftWithAnswers();
        SubmitRereviewCommand cmd = new SubmitRereviewCommand();
        cmd.setCaseId(CASE_ID); cmd.setSubmissionId(SUBMISSION_ID);
        ActorContext reviewer = new ActorContext(REREVIEWER_ID, "Reviewer", EnumSet.of(DomainRole.REVIEWER), Optional.of(HOSPITAL_ID));
        assertThrows(UnauthorizedException.class, () -> useCase.execute(reviewer, cmd));
    }
}
```

## Test scenarios to cover

1. **Happy path (CLOSED case)**: Seed a CLOSED case (case went through full flow: initial review → rereview → closed). Create a revision of the rereview submission with new answers. Verify:
   - Old submission is SUPERSEDED
   - New revision is SUBMITTED with revisionNo = 2
   - Case finalScore is recalculated with updated rereview score
   - Case status remains CLOSED (D-021)
   - RereviewRevisedEvent published

2. **Wrong actor**: Someone other than the assigned rereviewer tries to revise → throw DomainRuleViolationException

3. **Non-rereviewer role**: Actor doesn't have REREVIEWER role → throw UnauthorizedException

## Test seeding pattern for CLOSED case with submitted rereview

The case must go through the full lifecycle to reach CLOSED:
```java
ReviewCase rc = ReviewCase.createFromSampling(CASE_ID, "b1", PROJECT_ID, HOSPITAL_ID, "SK-001", MedicalRecordType.OUTPATIENT);
rc.assignReviewer("reviewer-1", LocalDateTime.now());
rc.startInitialReview("sub-init", SCORE_SHEET_ID);
rc.completeInitialReview(new BigDecimal("90"), new BigDecimal("80")); // → PENDING_REREVIEW
rc.assignRereviewer(REREVIEWER_ID, LocalDateTime.of(2026, 6, 30, 23, 59));
rc.startRereview(REREVIEWER_ID); // → REREVIEW_IN_PROGRESS
rc.completeRereview(new BigDecimal("70"), new BigDecimal("0.5"), new BigDecimal("0.5")); // → CLOSED
caseRepo.save(rc);

// Seed the submitted rereview submission (old submission that will be revised)
ReviewSubmission sub = ReviewSubmission.createRereviewDraft(SUBMISSION_ID, CASE_ID, REREVIEWER_ID);
List<AnswerItem> oldAnswers = Arrays.asList(
    AnswerItem.ofScored("Q001", "true", new BigDecimal("10.0")),
    AnswerItem.ofScored("Q002", "10", new BigDecimal("5.0")));
sub.updateDraft(oldAnswers, new BigDecimal("15.0"), "original comment");
sub.submit(); // → SUBMITTED
submissionRepo.save(sub);
```

## Use case implementation

Simple query — filters rereview submissions for a case, sorted by revisionNo ascending:

```java
package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase;

import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.ActorContext;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase.query.GetRereviewRevisionHistoryQuery;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewStage;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewSubmission;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewSubmissionRepository;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

@Service
@Transactional(readOnly = true)
public class GetRereviewRevisionHistoryUseCase {

    private final ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository;

    public GetRereviewRevisionHistoryUseCase(ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository) {
        this.submissionRepository = submissionRepository;
    }

    public List<ReviewSubmission> execute(ActorContext actor, GetRereviewRevisionHistoryQuery query) {
        // Any authenticated role can query — visibility enforced at API/UI layer
        return submissionRepository.findAllByCaseId(query.getCaseId()).stream()
                .filter(s -> s.getStage() == ReviewStage.REREVIEW)
                .sorted(Comparator.comparingInt(ReviewSubmission::getRevisionNo))
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }
}
```

## Test scenarios

1. **Returns only rereview submissions**: Seed both initial and rereview submissions. Verify only REREVIEW stage returned.
2. **Returns revisions in order**: Seed a submitted rereview + a revision. Verify sorted by revisionNo.
3. **Empty case**: No submissions at all → returns empty list.

## Test reference — follow SubmitRereviewUseCaseTest seeding patterns

For seeding a SUBMITTED rereview:
```java
ReviewSubmission rereview1 = ReviewSubmission.createRereviewDraft("sub-r1", "c1", "rereviewer-1");
List<AnswerItem> answers = Arrays.asList(AnswerItem.ofScored("Q001", "true", new BigDecimal("10")));
rereview1.updateDraft(answers, new BigDecimal("10"), "comment");
rereview1.submit();
submissionRepo.save(rereview1);
```

For seeding a revision (using static createRevision):
```java
ReviewSubmission revision = ReviewSubmission.createRevision(
    "sub-r2", rereview1,
    Arrays.asList(AnswerItem.ofScored("Q001", "false", new BigDecimal("0"))),
    new BigDecimal("0"), "revised comment");
rereview1.markSuperseded("sub-r2");
submissionRepo.save(rereview1);
submissionRepo.save(revision);
```

For seeding an initial review submission (to verify it's excluded):
```java
ReviewSubmission initial = ReviewSubmission.createInitialDraft("sub-1", "c1", "reviewer-1", "ss-1");
initial.updateDraft(Arrays.asList(AnswerItem.ofScored("Q001", "true", new BigDecimal("10"))), new BigDecimal("10"), null);
initial.submit();
submissionRepo.save(initial);
```

Current file content:
```java
package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import java.util.Base64;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public class TestTokenFactory {

    private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();
    public static final String DEFAULT_HOSPITAL_ID = "H001";

    public static String hospitalManagerToken() {
        return hospitalManagerToken(DEFAULT_HOSPITAL_ID);
    }

    public static String hospitalManagerToken(String hospitalId) {
        return buildToken("u-test-01", "Test Manager", hospitalId,
                Map.of("role_name", "hospital_manager", "enabled", true));
    }

    public static String systemAdminToken(String hospitalId) {
        return buildToken("u-admin-01", "Test Admin", hospitalId,
                Map.of("role_name", "system_admin", "enabled", true));
    }

    public static String systemAdminToken() {
        return systemAdminToken(DEFAULT_HOSPITAL_ID);
    }

    public static String unknownRoleToken() {
        return buildToken("u-unknown", "Unknown Role User", null,
                Map.of("role_name", "unknown_role", "enabled", true));
    }

    public static String reviewerToken(String userId, String hospitalId) {
        return buildToken(userId, "Test Reviewer", hospitalId,
                Map.of("role_name", "reviewer", "enabled", true));
    }

    public static String reviewerToken() {
        return reviewerToken("reviewer-1", DEFAULT_HOSPITAL_ID);
    }

    private static String buildToken(String userId, String userName,
                                     String hospitalId, Map<String, Object> role) {
        try {
            String header = base64url(MAPPER.writeValueAsString(
                    Map.of("alg", "RS512", "typ", "JWT")));
            Map<String, Object> userObj = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            userObj.put("user_id", userId);
            userObj.put("user_name", userName);
            userObj.put("user_role", new Object[]{role});
            if (hospitalId != null) {
                userObj.put("hospital_id", hospitalId);
            }
            String tzUserJson = MAPPER.writeValueAsString(Map.of("user", userObj));
            String payloadJson = MAPPER.writeValueAsString(Map.of(
                    "iss", "api-gateway",
                    "tz-user", tzUserJson
            ));
            String payload = base64url(payloadJson);
            return header + "." + payload + ".test-sig";
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Failed to build test token", e);
        }
    }

    private static String base64url(String json) {
        return Base64.getUrlEncoder().withoutPadding().encodeToString(json.getBytes());
    }
}
```

```java
// --- B4 Rereview Endpoints ---

@PostMapping("/{caseId}/close-without-rereview")
public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<Void>> closeWithoutRereview(
        @CurrentActor ActorContext actor,
        @PathVariable String caseId) {
    CloseWithoutRereviewCommand cmd = new CloseWithoutRereviewCommand();
    cmd.setCaseId(caseId);
    closeWithoutRereviewUseCase.execute(actor, cmd);
    return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.ok(null));
}

@PostMapping("/{caseId}/send-to-rereview")
public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<Void>> sendToRereview(
        @CurrentActor ActorContext actor,
        @PathVariable String caseId) {
    SendToRereviewCommand cmd = new SendToRereviewCommand();
    cmd.setCaseId(caseId);
    sendToRereviewUseCase.execute(actor, cmd);
    return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.ok(null));
}

@PostMapping("/{caseId}/assign-rereviewer")
public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<Void>> assignRereviewer(
        @CurrentActor ActorContext actor,
        @PathVariable String caseId,
        @RequestBody @Valid AssignRereviewerRequest request) {
    AssignRereviewerCommand cmd = new AssignRereviewerCommand();
    cmd.setCaseId(caseId);
    cmd.setRereviewerId(request.getRereviewerId());
    cmd.setDueAt(request.getDueAt());
    assignRereviewerUseCase.execute(actor, cmd);
    return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.ok(null));
}

@PostMapping("/{caseId}/reassign-rereviewer")
public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<Void>> reassignRereviewer(
        @CurrentActor ActorContext actor,
        @PathVariable String caseId,
        @RequestBody @Valid ReassignRereviewerRequest request) {
    ReassignRereviewerCommand cmd = new ReassignRereviewerCommand();
    cmd.setCaseId(caseId);
    cmd.setRereviewerId(request.getRereviewerId());
    cmd.setDueAt(request.getDueAt());
    reassignRereviewerUseCase.execute(actor, cmd);
    return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.ok(null));
}

@PostMapping("/{caseId}/start-rereview")
public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<Void>> startRereview(
        @CurrentActor ActorContext actor,
        @PathVariable String caseId) {
    StartRereviewCommand cmd = new StartRereviewCommand();
    cmd.setCaseId(caseId);
    startRereviewUseCase.execute(actor, cmd);
    return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.ok(null));
}

@PutMapping("/{caseId}/rereview-draft")
public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<Void>> saveRereviewDraft(
        @CurrentActor ActorContext actor,
        @PathVariable String caseId,
        @RequestBody @Valid SaveRereviewDraftRequest request) {
    SaveRereviewDraftCommand cmd = new SaveRereviewDraftCommand();
    cmd.setCaseId(caseId);
    cmd.setSubmissionId(request.getSubmissionId());
    if (request.getAnswers() != null) {
        cmd.setAnswers(request.getAnswers().stream()
                .filter(Objects::nonNull)
                .map(a -> AnswerItem.ofRaw(a.getItemId(), a.getAnswerValue()))
                .collect(Collectors.toList()));
    }
    cmd.setTotalScore(request.getTotalScore());
    cmd.setComment(request.getComment());
    saveRereviewDraftUseCase.execute(actor, cmd);
    return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.ok(null));
}

@PostMapping("/{caseId}/submit-rereview")
public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<Void>> submitRereview(
        @CurrentActor ActorContext actor,
        @PathVariable String caseId,
        @RequestBody @Valid SubmitRereviewRequest request) {
    SubmitRereviewCommand cmd = new SubmitRereviewCommand();
    cmd.setCaseId(caseId);
    cmd.setSubmissionId(request.getSubmissionId());
    if (request.getAnswers() != null) {
        cmd.setAnswers(request.getAnswers().stream()
                .filter(Objects::nonNull)
                .map(a -> AnswerItem.ofRaw(a.getItemId(), a.getAnswerValue()))
                .collect(Collectors.toList()));
    }
    cmd.setComment(request.getComment());
    submitRereviewUseCase.execute(actor, cmd);
    return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.ok(null));
}

@PostMapping("/{caseId}/revise-rereview")
public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<Void>> reviseRereview(
        @CurrentActor ActorContext actor,
        @PathVariable String caseId,
        @RequestBody @Valid ReviseRereviewRequest request) {
    ReviseRereviewCommand cmd = new ReviseRereviewCommand();
    cmd.setCaseId(caseId);
    cmd.setSubmissionId(request.getSubmissionId());
    if (request.getAnswers() != null) {
        cmd.setAnswers(request.getAnswers().stream()
                .filter(Objects::nonNull)
                .map(a -> AnswerItem.ofRaw(a.getItemId(), a.getAnswerValue()))
                .collect(Collectors.toList()));
    }
    cmd.setComment(request.getComment());
    reviseRereviewUseCase.execute(actor, cmd);
    return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.ok(null));
}

@GetMapping("/{caseId}/rereview-revisions")
public ResponseEntity<ApiResponse<RevisionHistoryResponse>> getRereviewRevisionHistory(
        @CurrentActor ActorContext actor,
        @PathVariable String caseId) {
    GetRereviewRevisionHistoryQuery query = new GetRereviewRevisionHistoryQuery();
    query.setCaseId(caseId);
    List<ReviewSubmission> submissions = getRereviewRevisionHistoryUseCase.execute(actor, query);
    List<SubmissionSummaryDto> dtos = submissions.stream()
            .map(s -> new SubmissionSummaryDto(
                    s.getSubmissionId(), s.getStage().name(), s.getReviewerId(),
                    s.getStatus().name(), s.getRevisionNo(), s.getTotalScore(),
                    s.getComment(), s.getSubmittedAt(), s.getSupersededBySubmissionId()))
            .collect(Collectors.toList());
    return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.ok(new RevisionHistoryResponse(caseId, dtos)));
}
```

## ⚠️ CRITICAL NOTES

1. **AnswerItem.ofRaw()** — The controller should map request DTO `AnswerInputDto` → `AnswerItem.ofRaw(itemId, answerValue)` for the B4 commands. The commands take `List<AnswerItem>`.

2. **SaveRereviewDraftCommand** takes `List<AnswerItem> answers` + `BigDecimal totalScore` + `String comment`. Note: the use case's internal `updateDraft()` takes these 3 args.

3. **SubmitRereviewCommand** takes `List<AnswerItem> answers` + `String comment`. The use case handles scoring via ScoreCalculationService internally.

4. **ReviseRereviewCommand** takes `List<AnswerItem> answers` + `String comment`. The use case handles scoring via ScoreCalculationService internally.

5. The existing `@CurrentActor` annotation resolves `ActorContext` from the JWT in the `api-key` header. All existing endpoints put `@CurrentActor ActorContext actor` as the first parameter.

6. The return type for `getRereviewRevisionHistory` reuses `RevisionHistoryResponse` and `SubmissionSummaryDto` — both already exist.

7. **SubmissionSummaryDto constructor** takes 9 args: `(submissionId, stage, reviewerId, status, revisionNo, totalScore, comment, submittedAt, supersededBySubmissionId)`.

8. The existing controller pattern for `@CurrentActor`: it's always the first parameter in method signatures.

package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import java.util.Base64;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Generates unsigned test JWTs for @SpringBootTest integration tests.
 * The service does not re-verify the JWT signature (gateway already did),
 * so a fake signature is accepted.
 */
public class TestTokenFactory {

    private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();
    public static final String DEFAULT_HOSPITAL_ID = "H001";

    /** Returns a JWT with HOSPITAL_MANAGER role and default hospitalId (H001). */
    public static String hospitalManagerToken() {
        return hospitalManagerToken(DEFAULT_HOSPITAL_ID);
    }

    /** Returns a JWT with HOSPITAL_MANAGER role and specified hospitalId. */
    public static String hospitalManagerToken(String hospitalId) {
        return buildToken("u-test-01", "Test Manager", hospitalId,
                Map.of("role_name", "hospital_manager", "enabled", true));
    }

    /** Returns a JWT with SYSTEM_ADMIN role and specified hospitalId. */
    public static String systemAdminToken(String hospitalId) {
        return buildToken("u-admin-01", "Test Admin", hospitalId,
                Map.of("role_name", "system_admin", "enabled", true));
    }

    /** Returns a JWT with SYSTEM_ADMIN role and default hospitalId (H001). */
    public static String systemAdminToken() {
        return systemAdminToken(DEFAULT_HOSPITAL_ID);
    }

    /** Returns a JWT with an unknown role (no DomainRole match). */
    public static String unknownRoleToken() {
        return buildToken("u-unknown", "Unknown Role User", null,
                Map.of("role_name", "unknown_role", "enabled", true));
    }

    /** Returns a JWT with REVIEWER role and specified userId + hospitalId. */
    public static String reviewerToken(String userId, String hospitalId) {
        return buildToken(userId, "Test Reviewer", hospitalId,
                Map.of("role_name", "reviewer", "enabled", true));
    }

    /** Returns a JWT with REVIEWER role, default userId and hospitalId. */
    public static String reviewerToken() {
        return reviewerToken("reviewer-1", DEFAULT_HOSPITAL_ID);
    }

    /** Returns a JWT with REREVIEWER role, default userId and hospitalId. */
    public static String rereviewerToken() {
        return rereviewerToken("rereviewer-1", DEFAULT_HOSPITAL_ID);
    }

    /** Returns a JWT with REREVIEWER role and specified userId + hospitalId. */
    public static String rereviewerToken(String userId, String hospitalId) {
        return buildToken(userId, "Test ReReviewer", hospitalId,
                Map.of("role_name", "rereviewer", "enabled", true));
    }

    private static String buildToken(String userId, String userName,
                                     String hospitalId, Map<String, Object> role) {
        try {
            String header = base64url(MAPPER.writeValueAsString(
                    Map.of("alg", "RS512", "typ", "JWT")));

            // Build user object — use LinkedHashMap to allow null values
            Map<String, Object> userObj = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            userObj.put("user_id", userId);
            userObj.put("user_name", userName);
            userObj.put("user_role", new Object[]{role});
            if (hospitalId != null) {
                userObj.put("hospital_id", hospitalId);
            }
            String tzUserJson = MAPPER.writeValueAsString(Map.of("user", userObj));

            String payloadJson = MAPPER.writeValueAsString(Map.of(
                    "iss", "api-gateway",
                    "tz-user", tzUserJson
            ));
            String payload = base64url(payloadJson);

            return header + "." + payload + ".test-sig";
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Failed to build test token", e);
        }
    }

    private static String base64url(String json) {

            @CurrentActor ActorContext actor,

        List<AnswerInput> answers = request.getAnswers().stream()
                .filter(Objects::nonNull)
                .map(dto -> new AnswerInput(dto.getItemId(), dto.getAnswerValue()))
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
        BigDecimal totalScore = saveInitialReviewDraftUseCase.execute(
                actor, caseId, answers, request.getComment());
        return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.ok(new SaveDraftResponse(totalScore)));
    }

            @CurrentActor ActorContext actor,

        List<AnswerInput> answers =

                        .map(dto -> new AnswerInput(dto.getItemId(), dto.getAnswerValue()))
                        .collect(Collectors.toList());
        RevisionResult result = reviseInitialReviewUseCase.execute(
                actor, caseId, submissionId, answers, request.getComment());
        return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.ok(new RevisionResultResponse(
                result.getNewSubmissionId(), result.getRevisionNo(),
                result.getTotalScore(), result.getStatus())));
    }

                        s.getStatus().name(), s.getRevisionNo(), s.getTotalScore(),
                        s.getComment(), s.getSubmittedAt(), s.getSupersededBySubmissionId()))
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
        return ResponseEntity.ok(ApiResponse.ok(new RevisionHistoryResponse(caseId, dtos)));
    }

        if (request.getAnswers() != null) {
            cmd.setAnswers(request.getAnswers().stream()

package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.infrastructure.persistence.reviewcase;

import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.MedicalRecordType;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCase;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCaseRepository;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewerAssignment;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

@Repository
public class ReviewCaseRepositoryImpl implements ReviewCaseRepository {

    private final ReviewCaseJpaRepository jpa;

    public ReviewCaseRepositoryImpl(ReviewCaseJpaRepository jpa) {
        this.jpa = jpa;
    }

    @Override
    public void save(ReviewCase reviewCase) {
        jpa.save(toEntity(reviewCase));
    }

    @Override
    public void saveAll(List<ReviewCase> cases) {
        jpa.saveAll(cases.stream().map(this::toEntity).collect(Collectors.toList()));
    }

    @Override
    public Optional<ReviewCase> findById(String caseId) {
        return jpa.findById(caseId).map(this::toDomain);
    }

    private ReviewCase toDomain(ReviewCaseEntity e) {
        ReviewerAssignment assignment = null;
        if (e.getReviewerId() != null && e.getReviewerAssignedAt() != null) {
            assignment = new ReviewerAssignment(e.getReviewerId(), e.getReviewerAssignedAt());
        }

        ReviewerAssignment rereviewerAssignment = null;
        if (e.getRereviewerId() != null && e.getRereviewerAssignedAt() != null) {
            rereviewerAssignment = new ReviewerAssignment(e.getRereviewerId(), e.getRereviewerAssignedAt());
        }

        MedicalRecordType mrt = null;
        if (e.getMedicalRecordType() != null) {
            mrt = MedicalRecordType.valueOf(e.getMedicalRecordType());
        }

        return ReviewCase.reconstitute(
                e.getCaseId(), e.getBatchId(), e.getProjectId(), e.getHospitalId(),
                e.getSourceCaseKey(), mrt,
                e.getStatus(), assignment, e.getDueAt(),
                e.getCancelReason(), e.getReturnReason(), e.getCancelledAt(), e.getClosedAt(),
                e.isRereviewRequired(), e.getFinalScore(), e.getFinalConclusion(),
                e.getLatestInitialSubmissionId(), e.getRuleSnapshotRef(), e.getScoreSheetVersionRef(),
                rereviewerAssignment, e.getRereviewerDueAt(), e.getInitialReviewScore());
    }

    private ReviewCaseEntity toEntity(ReviewCase rc) {
        ReviewCaseEntity e = new ReviewCaseEntity();
        e.setCaseId(rc.getCaseId());
        e.setBatchId(rc.getBatchId());
        e.setProjectId(rc.getProjectId());
        e.setHospitalId(rc.getHospitalId());
        e.setSourceCaseKey(rc.getSourceCaseKey());
        e.setMedicalRecordType(rc.getMedicalRecordType() != null ? rc.getMedicalRecordType().name() : null);
        e.setStatus(rc.getStatus());

        if (rc.getReviewerAssignment() != null) {
            e.setReviewerId(rc.getReviewerAssignment().getReviewerId());
            e.setReviewerAssignedAt(rc.getReviewerAssignment().getAssignedAt());
        }
        e.setDueAt(rc.getDueAt());
        e.setCancelReason(rc.getCancelReason());
        e.setReturnReason(rc.getReturnReason());
        e.setCancelledAt(rc.getCancelledAt());
        e.setClosedAt(rc.getClosedAt());
        e.setRereviewRequired(rc.isRereviewRequired());
        e.setFinalScore(rc.getFinalScore());
        e.setFinalConclusion(rc.getFinalConclusion());
        e.setLatestInitialSubmissionId(rc.getLatestInitialSubmissionId());
        e.setRuleSnapshotRef(rc.getRuleSnapshotRef());
        e.setScoreSheetVersionRef(rc.getScoreSheetVersionRef());

        if (rc.getRereviewerAssignment() != null) {
            e.setRereviewerId(rc.getRereviewerAssignment().getReviewerId());
            e.setRereviewerAssignedAt(rc.getRereviewerAssignment().getAssignedAt());
        }
        e.setRereviewerDueAt(rc.getRereviewerDueAt());
        e.setInitialReviewScore(rc.getInitialReviewScore());
        return e;
    }
}

package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase;

import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.ActorContext;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.DomainEventPublisher;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.DomainRole;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase.command.StartRereviewCommand;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.ResourceNotFoundException;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCase;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.ReviewCaseRepository;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.event.RereviewStartedEvent;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewSubmission;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewSubmissionRepository;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.util.UUID;

@Service
public class StartRereviewUseCase {

    private final ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository;
    private final ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository;
    private final DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher;

    public StartRereviewUseCase(ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository,
                                 ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository,
                                 DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher) {
        this.caseRepository = caseRepository;
        this.submissionRepository = submissionRepository;
        this.eventPublisher = eventPublisher;
    }

    @Transactional
    public void execute(ActorContext actor, StartRereviewCommand cmd) {
        actor.requireRole(DomainRole.REREVIEWER);
        ReviewCase reviewCase = caseRepository.findById(cmd.getCaseId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewCase", cmd.getCaseId()));
        // Domain method validates actor is the assigned rereviewer
        reviewCase.startRereview(actor.getUserId());
        ReviewSubmission rereviewDraft = ReviewSubmission.createRereviewDraft(
                UUID.randomUUID().toString(), cmd.getCaseId(), actor.getUserId());
        submissionRepository.save(rereviewDraft);
        caseRepository.save(reviewCase);
        eventPublisher.publish(new RereviewStartedEvent(
                this, actor.getUserId(), actor.getUserName(), reviewCase.getHospitalId(),
                reviewCase.getCaseId(),
                String.format("{\"submissionId\":\"%s\"}", rereviewDraft.getSubmissionId())));
    }
}

        actor.requireRole(DomainRole.REREVIEWER);

        ReviewCase reviewCase = caseRepository.findById(cmd.getCaseId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewCase", cmd.getCaseId()));

        // Validate actor is the assigned rereviewer
        if (reviewCase.getRereviewerAssignment() == null
                || !actor.getUserId().equals(reviewCase.getRereviewerAssignment().getReviewerId())) {
            throw new DomainRuleViolationException("NOT_ASSIGNED_REREVIEWER",
                    "Only the assigned rereviewer can submit this rereview");
        }

        ReviewSubmission submission = submissionRepository.findById(cmd.getSubmissionId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewSubmission", cmd.getSubmissionId()));

        // Load score sheet for scoring
        ScoreSheetDefinition scoreSheet = scoreSheetRepository
                .findById(reviewCase.getScoreSheetVersionRef())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ScoreSheetDefinition",
                        reviewCase.getScoreSheetVersionRef()));

        // Get current answers (from command if provided, else from draft)
        List<AnswerItem> currentAnswers = cmd.getAnswers() != null
                ? cmd.getAnswers()
                : submission.getAnswerSet();

        // Calculate scores server-side
        List<AnswerItem> rawItems = currentAnswers.stream()
                .map(a -> AnswerItem.ofRaw(a.getItemId(), a.getAnswerValue()))
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
        ScoreResult result = scoreCalculationService.calculate(rawItems, scoreSheet);

        // Update draft with scored answers, then submit
        submission.updateDraft(result.getScoredAnswers(), result.getTotalScore(), cmd.getComment());
        submission.submit();
        submissionRepository.save(submission);

        // Load project for weights
        ReviewProject project = projectRepository.findById(reviewCase.getProjectId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewProject", reviewCase.getProjectId()));
        ProjectVersion version = project.getCurrentVersion();

        // Complete rereview with weighted final score
        reviewCase.completeRereview(
                result.getTotalScore(),
                version.getInitialReviewWeight(),
                version.getRereviewWeight());
        caseRepository.save(reviewCase);

        eventPublisher.publish(new RereviewSubmittedEvent(
                this, actor.getUserId(), actor.getUserName(), reviewCase.getHospitalId(),
                reviewCase.getCaseId(),
                String.format("{\"rereviewScore\":%s,\"finalScore\":%s}",
                        result.getTotalScore(), reviewCase.getFinalScore())));
    }
}

package com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase;

import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.ActorContext;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.DomainEventPublisher;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.common.DomainRole;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.application.reviewcase.command.ReviseRereviewCommand;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.DomainRuleViolationException;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.common.ResourceNotFoundException;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.project.ProjectVersion;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.project.ReviewProject;

import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.reviewcase.submission.ReviewSubmissionRepository;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.scoresheet.ScoreSheetDefinition;
import com.tzuchi.his.quality.inspection.domain.scoresheet.ScoreSheetRepository;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * Use case: Revise a submitted rereview.
 * Per D-021, CLOSED cases are allowed rereview revision (not CANCELLED).
 * Creates a new revision of the rereview submission and recalculates the weighted final score.
 * This is the "append-only revision" pattern — old submission is marked SUPERSEDED,
 * new revision is directly SUBMITTED.
 */
@Service
public class ReviseRereviewUseCase {
    private final ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository;
    private final ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository;
    private final ReviewProjectRepository projectRepository;
    private final ScoreSheetRepository scoreSheetRepository;
    private final DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher;
    private final ScoreCalculationService scoreCalculationService;

    public ReviseRereviewUseCase(ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository,
                                  ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository,
                                  ReviewProjectRepository projectRepository,
                                  ScoreSheetRepository scoreSheetRepository,
                                  DomainEventPublisher eventPublisher,
                                  ScoreCalculationService scoreCalculationService) {
        this.caseRepository = caseRepository;
        this.submissionRepository = submissionRepository;
        this.projectRepository = projectRepository;
        this.scoreSheetRepository = scoreSheetRepository;
        this.eventPublisher = eventPublisher;
        this.scoreCalculationService = scoreCalculationService;
    }

    @Transactional
    public void execute(ActorContext actor, ReviseRereviewCommand cmd) {
        // 1. Require REREVIEWER role
        actor.requireRole(DomainRole.REREVIEWER);

        // 2. Load ReviewCase and validate actor is the assigned rereviewer
        ReviewCase reviewCase = caseRepository.findById(cmd.getCaseId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewCase", cmd.getCaseId()));

        if (reviewCase.getRereviewerAssignment() == null
                || !actor.getUserId().equals(reviewCase.getRereviewerAssignment().getReviewerId())) {
            throw new DomainRuleViolationException("NOT_ASSIGNED_REREVIEWER",
                    "Only the assigned rereviewer can revise this rereview");
        }

        // 3. Load old ReviewSubmission by submissionId
        ReviewSubmission oldSubmission = submissionRepository.findById(cmd.getSubmissionId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewSubmission", cmd.getSubmissionId()));

        // 4. Load ScoreSheetDefinition via reviewCase.getScoreSheetVersionRef()
        ScoreSheetDefinition scoreSheet = scoreSheetRepository
                .findById(reviewCase.getScoreSheetVersionRef())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ScoreSheetDefinition", reviewCase.getScoreSheetVersionRef()));

        // 5. Build raw AnswerItem list from cmd answers
        List<AnswerItem> rawItems = cmd.getAnswers().stream()
                .map(a -> AnswerItem.ofRaw(a.getItemId(), a.getAnswerValue()))
                .collect(Collectors.toList());

        // 6. Calculate scores via ScoreCalculationService
        ScoreResult result = scoreCalculationService.calculate(rawItems, scoreSheet);

        // 7. Create revision using static method
        String newSubmissionId = "sub-rev-" + UUID.randomUUID().toString();
        ReviewSubmission revision = ReviewSubmission.createRevision(
                newSubmissionId,
                oldSubmission,
                result.getScoredAnswers(),
                result.getTotalScore(),
                cmd.getComment());

        // 8. Mark old submission superseded
        oldSubmission.markSuperseded(newSubmissionId);

        // 9. Save both old and new submissions
        submissionRepository.save(oldSubmission);
        submissionRepository.save(revision);

        // 10. Load ReviewProject and get weights from getCurrentVersion()
        ReviewProject project = projectRepository.findById(reviewCase.getProjectId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewProject", reviewCase.getProjectId()));
        ProjectVersion version = project.getCurrentVersion();

        // 11. Update case final score for rereview (D-021: CLOSED cases allowed)
        reviewCase.updateFinalScoreForRereview(
                result.getTotalScore(),
                version.getInitialReviewWeight(),
                version.getRereviewWeight());

        // 12. Save case
        caseRepository.save(reviewCase);

        // 13. Publish RereviewRevisedEvent
        eventPublisher.publish(new RereviewRevisedEvent(
                this,
                actor.getUserId(),
                actor.getUserName(),
                reviewCase.getHospitalId(),
                reviewCase.getCaseId(),
                String.format("{\"newSubmissionId\":\"%s\",\"oldSubmissionId\":\"%s\",\"rereviewScore\":%s,\"finalScore\":%s}",
                        newSubmissionId, cmd.getSubmissionId(), result.getTotalScore(), reviewCase.getFinalScore())));
    }
}

@Service
public class SaveRereviewDraftUseCase {

    private final ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository;
    private final ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository;

    public SaveRereviewDraftUseCase(ReviewCaseRepository caseRepository,
                                     ReviewSubmissionRepository submissionRepository) {
        this.caseRepository = caseRepository;
        this.submissionRepository = submissionRepository;
    }

    @Transactional
    public void execute(ActorContext actor, SaveRereviewDraftCommand cmd) {
        actor.requireRole(DomainRole.REREVIEWER);
        ReviewCase reviewCase = caseRepository.findById(cmd.getCaseId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewCase", cmd.getCaseId()));
        if (reviewCase.getRereviewerAssignment() == null
                || !actor.getUserId().equals(reviewCase.getRereviewerAssignment().getReviewerId())) {
            throw new DomainRuleViolationException("NOT_ASSIGNED_REREVIEWER",
                    "Only the assigned rereviewer can save this draft");
        }
        ReviewSubmission submission = submissionRepository.findById(cmd.getSubmissionId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("ReviewSubmission", cmd.getSubmissionId()));
        submission.updateDraft(
                cmd.getAnswers() != null ? cmd.getAnswers() : Collections.emptyList(),
                cmd.getTotalScore() != null ? cmd.getTotalScore() : BigDecimal.ZERO,
                cmd.getComment());
        submissionRepository.save(submission);
    }
}

### Key Domain Rules for Tests

2. **sendToRereview()**: Only from `INITIAL_REVIEW_COMPLETED`. Status → PENDING_REREVIEW.

4. **reassignRereviewer()**: Same guard as assignRereviewer.
5. **startRereview(actorUserId)**: Only from `PENDING_REREVIEW`. Checks actor is the assigned rereviewer (throws DomainRuleViolationException → 422 if wrong user). Changes status → REREVIEW_IN_PROGRESS. The use case also creates a ReviewSubmission draft via `ReviewSubmission.createRereviewDraft()`.

7. **updateFinalScoreForRereview()**: Recalculates finalScore (for revision on CLOSED case — D-021).

```java
q001.setItemId("Q001");

ScoreItemEntity q002 = new ScoreItemEntity();
q002.setItemId("Q002");
q002.setCode("Q002");
q002.setTitle("Range Question");
```
